The authors suggest that unexplained rising maternal AFP in pregnancy may signal recurrence.

pmid-9443010.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の1症例について、経膣カラードプラ・パルスドプラ超音波検査の所見を報告した症例報告です。化学療法後にβ-hCGが陰性となった時点でも、子宮血流の増加と低拡張期血流が持続していました。経時的な経膣カラードプラ超音波検査は化学療法のモニタリングや残存腫瘍の検出に有用で、PSTTの診断精度向上に役立つと結論づけています。
pmid-9443010.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with placental site trophoblastic tumor evaluated by transvaginal color and pulsed Doppler sonography. Serial imaging showed marked uterine vascularity with low-resistance diastolic flow that persisted after chemotherapy, even though beta-hCG had become negative. The authors conclude that serial transvaginal color Doppler sonography is valuable for monitoring chemotherapy and detecting residual tumor, and may improve the accuracy of PSTT diagnosis.

pmid-9443030.summary_ja: 1970〜1991年にクラクフ腫瘍センターで治療された純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫22例の後方視的検討です。病期Iが大半で、14例が術後化学療法を受けました。5年無病生存率は全体で81.8%、病期Iで93.8%、病期II・IIIで50%でした。グレード1は全例治癒しましたが、グレード3の2例は死亡しています。
pmid-9443030.summary_en: This retrospective series from the Center of Oncology in Krakow reviewed 22 women treated for pure immature ovarian teratoma between 1970 and 1991. Most patients had stage I disease, and 14 received postoperative chemotherapy. Five-year NED survival was 81.8% overall, 93.8% for stage I, and 50% for stages II and III. All grade 1 patients were cured, but two grade 3 patients died. All six stage Ia patients treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy were cured.

pmid-9443566.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、胎盤部結節）の組織学的特徴を総説する。病期分類は持続例にのみ適用すべきとし、FIGO、NIH、WHOスコア、TNMの各分類を比較している。いずれの分類も高リスク患者の同定が可能であると述べる。
pmid-9443566.summary_en: This review classifies gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), covering complete and partial hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. It describes their histologic features and notes that persistent disease after moles is rare. Staging should be applied only to persistent cases. The review compares the FIGO, NIH, WHO scoring, and TNM staging systems, all of which can identify high-risk patients.

pmid-9443568.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学的背景を概説する。胞状奇胎では父親由来DNAの過剰の程度が組織像の差を生む。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や絨毛癌は正常妊娠、流産、胞状奇胎後に生じ、起源妊娠を反映した遺伝的組成を示す。分子生物学的手法により起源判定が可能になったと述べる。
pmid-9443568.summary_en: This review examines the genetic basis of gestational trophoblastic diseases. Complete and partial hydatidiform moles show varying degrees of excess paternal DNA, which shapes their histopathologic forms. Placental site trophoblastic tumors and choriocarcinomas can arise after normal pregnancy, abortion, or molar pregnancy, so their genetic composition reflects the gestation of origin. Molecular methods now allow determination of gestational versus non-gestational origin.

pmid-9443570.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌を、本来侵襲性を持つ絨毛細胞の悪性転化として論じる。正常の絨毛は着床時に制御された浸潤を示すが、絨毛癌では制限なく増殖し転移する。腫瘍は父親由来の異種DNAを含むという特異性があり、移植免疫や遺伝学の理解が必要だと述べる。
pmid-9443570.summary_en: This review discusses gestational choriocarcinoma as a malignant transformation of trophoblast. Trophoblasts normally show controlled invasion during implantation and are shed into maternal circulation, but in choriocarcinoma they grow without limit and metastasize. The tumor uniquely contains paternal, foreign DNA. Studying it requires understanding graft rejection, immunology, genetics, and the mechanisms of invasion and metastasis.

pmid-9443571.summary_ja: 胎盤部の絨毛外（中間型）トロホブラストに由来する病変を総説する。過剰胎盤部、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、胎盤部結節を対象に、臨床・病理学的特徴、鑑別診断、治療、予後因子を扱う。中間型トロホブラストの起源と定義についても論じている。
pmid-9443571.summary_en: This review covers trophoblastic lesions of the placental site, which arise from extravillous intermediate trophoblast. It addresses the exaggerated placental site, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. Clinical and pathologic features, differential diagnosis, treatment, and prognostic factors are discussed, after an account of the origin and definition of intermediate trophoblast.

pmid-9443572.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療を概説する。境界悪性の胞状奇胎から高度侵襲性の絨毛癌まで幅広い病態を含む。過去45年間に開発された化学療法レジメンは、個々のリスクに応じて調整できる。統合的管理により、現在では死亡例はわずかであると述べる。
pmid-9443572.summary_en: This review describes management of gestational trophoblastic disease, which spans from borderline-malignant hydatidiform mole to highly aggressive choriocarcinoma. Historically many women died, but chemotherapy regimens developed over the past 45 years can be tailored to each patient's risk of resistance. The author argues that integrated management has made GTD a success story in oncology, with few deaths today.

pmid-9443573.summary_ja: 158例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の臨床病理学的特徴を報告する。内訳は完全胞状奇胎110例、侵入奇胎13例、絨毛癌32例などである。搔爬後に約64％が自然退縮し、36％が持続性または転移性となった。完全寛解率は約91％で、血清hCGの連続測定と専門施設での治療を推奨する。
pmid-9443573.summary_en: This report describes 158 cases of gestational trophoblastic disease, including 110 complete moles, 13 invasive moles, 32 choriocarcinomas, and placental site lesions. About 64 percent regressed spontaneously after curettage, while 36 percent became persistent or metastatic, most often to the lung. Complete remission was about 91 percent. Serial serum hCG monitoring is recommended, and persistent disease should be treated at specialized centers.

pmid-9443575.summary_ja: 27例の完全胞状奇胎と9例の持続例を対象に、c-erbB-2の増幅と発現を後方視的研究として検討した。増幅・発現とDNA過倍数性を併せ持つ例は増殖が高く、転移を伴うなど侵襲性が強かった。XY核型は絨毛癌と進行例の胞状奇胎2例で認められた。
pmid-9443575.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated c-erbB-2 oncogene amplification and expression in 27 complete hydatidiform moles and 9 persistent gestational trophoblastic disease cases. Tumors with c-erbB-2 amplification and expression combined with DNA hyperploidy showed higher proliferation and more aggressive behavior, including metastases. An XY karyotype was found in a choriocarcinoma and in two advanced moles with hyperploidy.

pmid-9443576.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌が子宮頸部扁平上皮癌と誤診された2症例を報告する。1例は産後の絨毛癌で、メトトレキサート療法にもかかわらず肺転移により死亡した。もう1例は多剤併用化学療法により完全寛解に至った。非典型的な頸部搔爬標本では絨毛癌を疑い、hCGの免疫組織化学が有用だと述べる。
pmid-9443576.summary_en: This case report describes two women with gestational choriocarcinoma initially misdiagnosed as cervical squamous cell carcinoma. One died after postpartum choriocarcinoma with diffuse pulmonary metastases despite methotrexate. The other achieved complete remission after radical hysterectomy and multiagent chemotherapy. The authors advise considering choriocarcinoma for atypical cervical curettage specimens and note that hCG immunohistochemistry is helpful.

pmid-9449027.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、糖尿病妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のα・βサブユニットの糖鎖とペプチド構造を比較した研究。悪性疾患では高分岐型糖型が増加し、βサブユニットの変化は正常妊娠から胞状奇胎、絨毛癌へと段階的に増加した。腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの理解に関連する知見である。
pmid-9449027.summary_en: This study compared the carbohydrate and peptide structures of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) purified from normal pregnancy, diabetic pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. Hyperglycosylated and hyperbranched glycoforms of both alpha and beta subunits increased in malignant disease, and beta-subunit oligosaccharide changes rose stepwise from normal pregnancy to hydatidiform mole to choriocarcinoma. Peptide-bond nicking also increased with malignancy. The authors suggest these subunit-specific glycosylation patterns reflect local protein structure effects on Golgi processing enzymes, and may be relevant to hCG as a tumour marker.

pmid-9451341.summary_ja: オーストラリアGeelong地域の15年間で、胚細胞腫瘍61例を後方視的に検討した研究。発生率は男性10万人あたり年間約4例、がん特異的生存率は95%であった。セミノーマは30%を占め、非セミノーマより進行期で受診する傾向があった。三次施設外でも良好な予後で管理可能と結論づけている。
pmid-9451341.summary_en: This 15-year retrospective review from the Geelong region of Victoria, Australia, identified 61 patients with germ cell neoplasm. The incidence was about four cases per 100,000 men per year, with cancer-specific survival of 95%. Seminoma accounted for 30% of cases, and seminoma patients presented at later stages than those with non-seminoma. The authors conclude that the increasing incidence has an excellent prognosis and can be managed outside a tertiary referral centre.

pmid-9455863.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍または対側精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)を有する男性14例を対象に、抗がん治療前の精液所見、血清ホルモン値、精巣容積を検討した。10例は正常または低下した精子濃度を示し、4例は無精子症であった。血清FSHは精子濃度と負の相関を示した。精巣がんでも妊孕性が保たれうるため、精子凍結保存を含む生殖医学的評価を提供すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-9455863.summary_en: This study assessed fertility in 14 men with bilateral testicular tumour, unilateral tumour with contralateral carcinoma in situ, or a tumour in a single testis, before further anticancer treatment. Ten of 14 had normal or reduced sperm concentrations, and four were azoospermic. Serum FSH correlated negatively with sperm concentration, and testicular volume correlated positively with semen parameters in CIS-affected testes. The authors conclude that testicular cancer does not necessarily preclude fertility, so andrological evaluation and sperm cryopreservation should be offered before treatment.

pmid-9455864.summary_ja: セミノーマで精巣摘除と放射線療法を受ける前に精子凍結保存を希望した夫婦で、夫は受診時に無精子症であった。摘除したセミノーマ精巣から精子を採取し、顕微授精(ICSI)に用いた。凍結融解胚移植により臨床的妊娠に至り、出産に至った。閉塞性無精子症の新たな原因であり、ICSIで治療に成功したと報告している。
pmid-9455864.summary_en: In a couple seeking sperm cryopreservation before orchidectomy and radiotherapy for seminoma, the husband was found to be azoospermic. Sperm was retrieved from the removed seminoma-bearing testis and used for intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI). Frozen-thawed embryos were transferred, resulting in a clinical pregnancy and a live birth. The authors describe this as a new aetiology of obstructive azoospermia successfully treated with ICSI.

pmid-9458520.summary_ja: 腹痛を訴えた23歳男性の馬蹄腎に生じた腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍内の骨組織を腎杯結石と誤認し、体外衝撃波砕石術と経皮的砕石術を試みたが奏効しなかった。奇形腫内に発生した原発性カルチノイドであった。馬蹄腎など先天性腎発生異常を有する例で多いと指摘している。
pmid-9458520.summary_en: A 23-year-old man presented with abdominal pain, and a renal tumour was found in a horseshoe kidney. Bone within the mass was initially mistaken for a calyceal stone, leading to unsuccessful shock-wave and percutaneous lithotripsy. The tumour was a primary carcinoid arising within a teratoma. The authors note that this unusual tumour is over-represented in patients with horseshoe kidney and other congenital renal developmental defects.

pmid-9465624.summary_ja: 胸部X線異常を指摘された25歳男性。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で前縦隔の嚢胞性病変を認め、嚢胞性奇形腫が疑われた。開胸手術で右葉胸腺とともに摘出され、病理学的に嚢胞変性を伴うセミノーマと診断された。術後に20Gyの放射線療法を施行し、術後33か月で明らかな再発は認めていない。縦隔セミノーマが極端な嚢胞変性を来しうると述べている。
pmid-9465624.summary_en: A 25-year-old man had an abnormal shadow on chest radiography. CT and MRI showed a cystic anterior mediastinal lesion with irregular nodules, initially suspected to be a cystic teratoma. Surgery through an antero-axillary thoracotomy removed the lesion along with the right thymic lobe. Pathology revealed seminoma with extensive cystic degeneration. Postoperative irradiation of 20 Gy was given, and no apparent recurrence was seen 33 months after surgery. The authors suggest mediastinal seminomas may undergo marked cystic degeneration, unlike the usual solid pattern.

pmid-9473736.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性がん患者の腫瘍浸潤リンパ球から、HLA-A2拘束性かつ腫瘍特異的な細胞傷害性T細胞株を樹立した報告です。自己腫瘍細胞やHLA-A2陽性の癌細胞株を傷害しましたが、HLA-A2陰性の標的は傷害しませんでした。腫瘍局所に特異的なT細胞が存在することが示唆され、T細胞を用いた免疫療法への応用が期待されます。
pmid-9473736.summary_en: This study established an HLA-A2-restricted, tumor-specific CD8-positive cytotoxic T lymphocyte line from interleukin-2-activated tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes of a patient with testicular embryonal cancer. The CTL lysed autologous tumor cells and HLA-A2-positive adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma lines, but not HLA-A2-negative targets. The findings suggest that tumor-specific cytotoxic T cells exist at the tumor site of testicular embryonal cancer, supporting the potential of T cell-based immunotherapy.

pmid-9474880.summary_ja: 正常の栄養膜細胞の分化経路と、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各病変がどの分化段階の異常に対応するかを解説した総説です。新たな栄養膜マーカー、特にホルマリン固定後も抗原性を保つ抗体の、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の研究と鑑別診断における有用性を論じています。病理診断の実務への応用も示されています。
pmid-9474880.summary_en: This review describes normal trophoblast differentiation, including the pathways to villous syncytiotrophoblast and extravillous intermediate trophoblast, and how gestational trophoblastic lesions correspond to specific differentiation stages. It highlights newer trophoblastic markers, especially antibodies that recognize formalin-resistant epitopes, and their value in the study and differential diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9486052.summary_ja: 左肺動脈に原発した絨毛癌の1例の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で肺塞栓症が疑われましたが、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)により肺動脈閉塞が腫瘍性であることが確認されました。肺動脈原発腫瘍は稀で塞栓症と誤診されやすく、手術や根治的化学療法の機会を逃す恐れがあると警告しています。
pmid-9486052.summary_en: A patient with primary choriocarcinoma of the left pulmonary artery was initially suspected of having pulmonary embolism based on CT. Positron emission tomography confirmed the neoplastic nature of the arterial obstruction. The authors emphasize that primary pulmonary artery tumors are rare and can be mistaken for thromboembolism, potentially leading to withheld surgery or potentially curative chemotherapy.

pmid-9487440.summary_ja: 36歳の経産婦に生じた原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告です。正常と思われた子宮内妊娠の28週で妊娠中出血を来し、のちに続発性の産後出血を呈しました。原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌は極めて稀ですが、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の多い地域では、経産婦の出血の局所原因として考慮すべきと提言しています。
pmid-9487440.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with primary cervical choriocarcinoma who presented with antepartum haemorrhage at 28 weeks of gestation and later with secondary postpartum haemorrhage, despite an apparently normal intrauterine pregnancy. The authors note that primary cervical choriocarcinoma is very rare and suggest it be considered as a possible local cause of obstetric haemorrhage in parous women, especially in regions where gestational trophoblastic disease is common.

pmid-9491658.summary_ja: 8歳女児に生じた膀胱奇形腫の症例報告です。膀胱鏡検査で診断され、病理組織学的に確定しました。完全切除が可能で、4年間のフォローアップで再発は認められていません。膀胱奇形腫は文献上1例のみの報告であり、インドおよびアジアからの初の報告であると述べています。小児の膀胱奇形腫は極めて稀です。
pmid-9491658.summary_en: This case report describes an eight-year-old girl with a teratoma of the bladder, diagnosed by cystoscopy and confirmed histopathologically. Complete surgical excision was achieved, and no recurrence was observed at four years of follow-up. The authors note that this is the first reported case from India and the Asian continent, and that only one such case had previously been described in the literature.

pmid-9491659.summary_ja: 23歳女性の症例報告である。胞状奇胎の除去から5か月後に、妊娠性絨毛癌の硬膜外転移による脊髄圧迫症状で受診した。胞状奇胎除去後はフォローアップを受けておらず、それまで無症状であった。従来の化学療法に良好な反応を示した。本例は、胞状奇胎後のフォローアップの重要性を示している。
pmid-9491659.summary_en: Case report of a 23-year-old woman with spinal cord compression caused by an extradural metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma. She had undergone evacuation of a hydatidiform mole five months earlier, after which she was asymptomatic and did not attend follow-up. She responded well to conventional chemotherapy, illustrating the risk of metastatic disease when postmolar surveillance is missed.

pmid-9491665.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の血清中胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）を、ELISA法とRIA法で比較した研究である。PLAPはセミノーマの管理における信頼性の高い腫瘍マーカーである。両法の相関は良好で、ELISA法の感度、特異度、精度、正確性、再現性はRIA法と同等以上であった。ELISA法は臨床検査への応用が期待される。
pmid-9491665.summary_en: Compares enzyme-linked immunoassay (ELISA) and radioimmunoassay (RIA) for measuring placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in the serum of patients with seminoma. PLAP is established as a reliable tumor marker in seminoma management. The two methods correlated well, and ELISA matched or exceeded RIA in sensitivity, specificity, precision, accuracy and reproducibility, suggesting ELISA is a suitable alternative for routine clinical measurement.

pmid-9491667.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の10歳女児の症例報告である。BEP化学療法で成功裏に治療されたが、治療終了から29か月後にAML-M5（t(11;19)(q23;p13)）を発症した。累積投与量はエトポシド2000 mg/m2、シスプラチン400 mg/m2であった。エトポシドと治療関連白血病の関連について文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-9491667.summary_en: Case report of a 10-year-old girl with ovarian germ cell tumor successfully treated with BEP chemotherapy, who developed AML-M5 with t(11;19)(q23;p13) 29 months after stopping therapy. Her cumulative doses were 2000 mg/m2 of etoposide and 400 mg/m2 of cisplatin. The authors review the association between etoposide and therapy-related leukemia, highlighting a late complication of germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-9496388.summary_ja: 大量化学療法と幹細胞支持後に進行した難治性胚細胞腫瘍への化学療法について、9施設の後方視的多施設研究である。47例中17例（36%）で寛解が得られたが、持続的完全寛解はまれであった。中央生存期間は26週であった。多変量解析では、パクリタキセルとイホスファミドによる治療のみが独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-9496388.summary_en: Retrospective multicenter study from the Austrian Study Group on Urologic Oncology of 47 patients given chemotherapy for germ cell tumors that progressed after high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support. Remission occurred in 36%, but sustained complete remission was rare, and median survival was 26 weeks. Paclitaxel combined with ifosfamide was the only independent prognostic factor for survival on multivariate analysis.

pmid-9503468.summary_ja: 卵巣粘液性腫瘍458例を解析し、奇形腫を13例（2.8%）、ブレンナー腫瘍を8例（1.7%）に認めた。40歳未満では奇形腫の割合が高く、50歳以上ではブレンナー腫瘍が多かった。多くの病変で両成分の移行や混在が確認された。奇形腫やブレンナー腫瘍は、粘液性腫瘍の発生に一部寄与すると考えられる。
pmid-9503468.summary_en: Clinicopathologic study of 458 ovarian mucinous tumors, of which 13 (2.8%) were associated with teratomas and 8 (1.7%) with Brenner tumors. Teratomas were more frequent in patients under 40, and Brenner tumors in those 50 or older. Histologic transitions or intimate admixtures of the two elements were found in many lesions. The authors conclude that teratomas and Brenner tumors contribute modestly to the histogenesis of mucinous tumors, especially in younger and older patients respectively.

pmid-9526584.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ患者299例を後方視的に解析し、予防的な所属リンパ節への放射線療法の費用対効果を検討したものです。5年全生存率は99%、10年無病生存率は96%で、照射野内での再発はなかった一方、晩期の重篤な放射線障害4例と二次悪性腫瘍9例(3%)が認められました。監視療法との費用比較も行われています。
pmid-9526584.summary_en: This retrospective Milan study of 299 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma compared outcomes and costs of prophylactic radiotherapy to regional lymph nodes. Five-year overall survival was 99% and 10-year disease-free survival 96%, with a recurrence rate of 2.3%, and no relapses occurred within irradiated fields. Acute toxicity was modest, but four serious late radiation sequelae and nine second malignancies (3%) were observed. The authors also estimated National Health Service costs of surveillance versus prophylactic irradiation, framing the debate on wait-and-see policy.

pmid-9540399.summary_ja: 南アフリカの1施設で、病期II精巣がん患者20例を後方視的に検討し、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる初回化学療法の効果と毒性を評価しました。非バルキー型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の70%で完全奏効が得られ、全例が生存していました。一方、バルキー型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では生存率が52%にとどまりました。バルキー型セミノーマ5例は全例生存しており、初回化学療法が治療の第一選択であると結論づけています。
pmid-9540399.summary_en: This South African retrospective review of 20 consecutive patients with stage 2 testicular cancer evaluated primary chemotherapy with four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or low-dose radiotherapy for residual disease. Among patients with non-bulky NSGCT, 70% achieved complete response, with 100% survival at median 60 months. Bulky NSGCT had poor outcomes, with 52% survival, while all five bulky seminoma patients survived. Toxicity was modest. The authors conclude that primary chemotherapy is the treatment of choice.

pmid-9715542.summary_ja: 25歳男性の左側腹部腫瘤例で、超音波検査とCTにより骨成分を含む後腹膜腫瘤が確認されました。摘出標本には歯や四肢芽を伴う構造があり、胎児内胎児か後腹膜奇形腫かという長年の論争を取り上げています。Willisの基準で脊椎軸の有無が重要視される点を含め、文献的考察が行われています。
pmid-9715542.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with a left abdominal mass, and imaging showed an echogenic retroperitoneal lesion containing bone. At surgery, a large encapsulated retroperitoneal mass contained a specimen with a bony cephalic end, embedded teeth, two limb buds, skin with appendages and a coelomic cavity. The authors discuss the long-standing controversy over whether such lesions represent fetus in fetu or retroperitoneal teratoma, noting Willis's criterion requiring a vertebral axis. They review reports in which fetus in fetu was diagnosed without a vertebral axis.

pmid-21590013.summary_ja: 細胞膜結合型尿中トリプシンインヒビター（UTI）が腫瘍浸潤を制御するかを検討した基礎研究。絨毛癌由来のSMT-cc1細胞は内因性にUTIを産生し、外因性UTIは浸潤を用量依存的に抑制した。白血病細胞U937のUTIは血清由来と考えられた。抗UTI抗体は濃度依存的に二相性の作用を示し、膜結合型UTIがタンパク分解を調節すると考えられた。
pmid-21590013.summary_en: This study examines whether cell membrane-associated urinary trypsin inhibitor (UTI) is produced endogenously by tumor cells and regulates their invasion. It uses human choriocarcinoma SMT-cc1 cells and U937 leukemia cells. SMT-cc1 cells appear to synthesize UTI endogenously, whereas UTI on U937 cells likely derives from serum. Exogenous UTI inhibits Matrigel invasion by SMT-cc1 cells in a dose-dependent manner, and anti-UTI antibody has biphasic effects. The authors conclude that membrane-bound UTI may regulate proteolysis and limit excessive matrix degradation during tumor invasion.

pmid-9056427.summary_ja: マウスF9奇形癌細胞を壁側内胚葉へ分化させた際のrRNA転写制御を調べた研究である。分化に伴いrRNA合成が低下し、RNAポリメラーゼI転写因子の減少が関与していた。主題は腫瘍生物学ではなくrRNA遺伝子の制御であり、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍への関連は間接的である。
pmid-9056427.summary_en: This study examined ribosomal RNA transcription in mouse F9 teratocarcinoma cells induced to differentiate into parietal endoderm by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP. rRNA synthesis and transcription rates fell during differentiation, linked to reduced DNA binding and amounts of the RNA polymerase I factors E1BF/Ku and UBF. The work uses murine embryonal carcinoma-derived cells as a differentiation model and focuses on rRNA gene regulation rather than tumour biology. Relevance to human germ cell tumours is therefore indirect.

pmid-9057102.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞において、レチノイン酸がCGRPの自己分泌系に与える影響を調べた研究である。レチノイン酸処理によりCGRPのmRNAと分泌が低下し、CGRPへの応答性も減弱した。増殖に関わる自己分泌ループを抑制しつつ分化を誘導することが示された。マウス細胞の研究であり、ヒトへの関連は間接的である。
pmid-9057102.summary_en: This study examined how retinoic acid affects the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) autocrine system in mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. CGRP mRNA and secretion fell within days of retinoic acid treatment, and responsiveness to CGRP decreased. This accompanied differentiation into primitive parietal endoderm-like cells. The authors conclude that retinoic acid suppresses the CGRP autocrine loop that drives F9 proliferation while inducing differentiation. The work uses murine cells, so relevance to human germ cell tumours is indirect.

pmid-9062580.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞と体細胞の細胞融合ハイブリッドを、細胞分化およびX染色体活性の研究ツールとして提示した基礎研究。胎児性癌細胞は奇形癌の幹細胞であり、融合した分化体細胞のゲノムを再プログラムして多能性を回復させる能力を示す。臨床的な腫瘍管理ではなく発生生物学的な内容であるため、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床への関連は限定的である。
pmid-9062580.summary_en: This short report describes murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell-somatic cell hybrids as experimental tools for studying cell differentiation and X chromosome activity. EC cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinomas, can reprogram the genomes of fused differentiated somatic cells and restore genetic pluripotency. The work addresses basic developmental biology rather than clinical tumor management, so its relevance to germ cell tumor care is limited.

pmid-9085275.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌(EC)細胞ハイブリッドを用いて、分化前後のXist発現をRT-PCRで解析したものである。未分化細胞ではXist発現はなく、全てのX染色体が活性化していた。レチノイン酸による分化誘導後はXistが発現し、Xist対立遺伝子の両方が発現していたことから、X不活性化は無作為に生じることが示された。腫瘍疾患そのものではなく、発生モデルとしてECを用いた研究である。
pmid-9085275.summary_en: This study examines X-chromosome inactivation in hybrid embryonic carcinoma (EC) cells, using RT-PCR to measure Xist expression before and after differentiation. Undifferentiated hybrid cells showed no Xist expression, indicating all X chromosomes were active. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation produced Xist expression comparable to female primary cells. Polymorphism analysis showed both Xist alleles were expressed, supporting random X inactivation during in vitro differentiation. EC cells serve as a developmental model rather than as a study of germ cell tumor disease.

pmid-9125195.summary_ja: ヒトLIF受容体(D因子受容体)の4種類のcDNAを肝臓cDNAライブラリーから単離し、膜貫通領域の直前に終止コドンを生じるスプライシング変異を同定した。絨毛癌細胞株NJGでも受容体mRNAが発現し、その培養上清から分子量160 kDaの可溶性受容体が検出された。絨毛癌は可溶性受容体の産生源として用いられており、主題は受容体の分子生物学である。
pmid-9125195.summary_en: This study identified four human cDNAs encoding the receptor for D-factor/LIF, with alternative splicing that introduces a premature termination codon before the transmembrane domain. The receptor mRNAs were detected in human liver, placenta, and the choriocarcinoma cell line NJG. Conditioned medium from NJG cells contained a native soluble D-factor/LIF receptor of about 160 kDa, with a dissociation constant of 7.8 nM. The choriocarcinoma line mainly serves as a source of the soluble receptor, so germ cell tumor content is limited.

pmid-9134503.summary_ja: ヒトのオーファン受容体GCNF/RTRのcDNAをクローニングし発現を解析した。精巣で最も高発現し、胚性幹細胞や胎児性癌細胞でも高発現していた。レチノイン酸による胎児性癌細胞の分化誘導に伴い発現が低下した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、基礎研究の細胞モデルとして胎児性癌細胞株を用いた研究である。
pmid-9134503.summary_en: This study cloned the human orphan receptor GCNF/RTR and characterised its expression. GCNF/RTR is most abundant in testis and highly expressed in embryonic stem cells and embryonal carcinoma cells, but repressed in their differentiated derivatives. Retinoic acid induced differentiation of mouse F9 and human NT2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells with downregulation of GCNF/RTR. The receptor is proposed to regulate gene expression in early embryogenesis and spermatogenesis. Embryonal carcinoma lines serve as a basic research model rather than as clinical tumours.

pmid-9164954.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞F9に対する非MHC拘束性の拒絶機構を解析した免疫学研究。C57BL/6系マウスではNK1+ CD4-CD8- αβT細胞が蓄積し、IL-4を産生して腫瘍拒絶に関与していた。抗NK1.1抗体や抗IL-4抗体で感受性が増すことが示された。胎児性癌は腫瘍モデルとして用いられており、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-9164954.summary_en: Mice of the C57BL/6 background resist F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells regardless of MHC haplotype, through a non-MHC-restricted mechanism. NK1+ CD4-CD8- alphabeta T cells accumulate in resistant mice, produce IL-4, and their depletion or IL-4 neutralization makes mice susceptible. Resistant tumors show IL-4-dependent macrophage infiltration and necrosis. The study characterizes a minor T-cell subset with antitumor function in vivo, using embryonal carcinoma as a model system rather than a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-9168806.summary_ja: マウスの胎児性癌細胞株F9を、レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで壁側内胚葉へ分化させ、インテグリンの発現変化を解析した。表面のβ1インテグリンは減少し、α6はα6Bからα6Aへ発現が移行した。2つのα6アイソフォームは異なる役割を持つと考察されている。
pmid-9168806.summary_en: This study examined how integrin expression changes as murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate into parietal endoderm after treatment with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP. Differentiation reduced surface beta-1 integrin, with post-translational control preceding transcriptional control, and shifted alpha-6 isoform expression from alpha-6B toward alpha-6A. Immunofluorescence showed beta-1 and alpha-6B relocating from cell-cell contacts to focal contacts. The authors suggest that the two alpha-6 isoforms play distinct roles during differentiation.

pmid-9202179.summary_ja: 臨床で用いられる鉄キレート薬デフェロキサミンが、胎児性癌F9細胞の可逆的な分化を誘導することを示した。分化はFe3+イオンの前処理で消失し、鉄キレートが機序であると示唆された。増殖抑制とアポトーシスも認められた。本研究は培養細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-9202179.summary_en: Deferoxamine, a clinically used iron chelator, induced reversible differentiation of embryonal carcinoma F9 cells, similar to sodium butyrate, unlike hinokitiol and dithizone. Differentiation was abolished by preincubation with Fe3+ ions, indicating that iron chelation is the mechanism. Treatment also inhibited proliferation and caused apoptosis within colonies. This is a cell-line study suggesting that iron chelation may modulate embryonal carcinoma cell behavior.

pmid-9202205.summary_ja: 未分化の胎児性癌F9細胞ではLIFによるAPRE依存性の転写活性化が認められず、レチノイン酸で分化させると応答が回復した。JAKやSTATのタンパク質量とリン酸化は両状態で同等であった。活性型Rasは応答を部分的に回復させた。STAT3とAPREの結合には、Rasによって部分的に補われる未知の共役活性化過程が必要と考えられる。
pmid-9202205.summary_en: In undifferentiated F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, leukemia inhibitory factor failed to activate an APRE-luciferase reporter, whereas retinoic acid-differentiated cells responded strongly. JAK and STAT protein levels and phosphorylation were similar in both states, so the block lies elsewhere. Activated Ras partially restored responsiveness, but dominant-negative Ras did not block signaling in differentiated cells. The authors propose an unknown coactivation process, partly compensated by Ras, is needed for STAT3-APRE binding.

pmid-9225124.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞におけるプロテインキナーゼC(PKC)のアイソザイム発現を、子宮内膜腺癌細胞HEC-1Bと比較した研究です。JEG-3ではα、δ、εの発現が欠如し、ホルボールエステル(TPA)による増殖促進は見られませんでした。AP-1活性は約10倍に上昇しました。増殖能はAP-1の誘導性よりPKCの発現パターンを反映すると結論づけています。臨床の絨毛癌を対象とした研究ではありません。
pmid-9225124.summary_en: Analyzes protein kinase C (PKC) isoform expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells and compares it with HEC-1B endometrial adenocarcinoma cells. JEG-3 lacked PKC alpha, delta, and epsilon, and did not proliferate in response to phorbol ester (TPA), though AP-1 activity rose about tenfold. HEC-1B cells showed enhanced proliferation and a smaller AP-1 response. The authors conclude that the PKC isoform pattern, rather than AP-1 inducibility, better reflects proliferative potential. The study concerns cell signaling in a cell line, not clinical choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9284765.summary_ja: 妊娠初期・後期のヒト胎盤と絨毛癌由来JEG3細胞におけるFasリガンド(FasL)の発現を検討した研究です。両者でmRNAとタンパク質が検出され、免疫組織化学では栄養膜細胞に局在しました。浸潤する栄養膜によるFasL介在性のリンパ球アポトーシスが、胎児半同種移植片の免疫寛容に寄与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-9284765.summary_en: This study examined Fas ligand (FasL) expression in first and third trimester human placentas and in JEG3 choriocarcinoma cells. FasL mRNA and protein were detected in both, and immunohistochemistry localized FasL to trophoblasts. The authors propose that FasL-mediated lymphocyte apoptosis by invading trophoblasts contributes to the immune privilege of the fetal semi-allograft. The choriocarcinoma cells are used as a comparison model alongside normal placenta.

pmid-9290157.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3、BeWo、JArを用いて、低酸素によるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の抑制機構を検討した研究です。低酸素下ではhCG分泌が67〜81%低下し、その程度は酸素濃度に依存しました。メトトレキサートによるhCG分泌増加も低酸素下では逆転し、β-hCG mRNAはほぼ検出限界まで低下しました。低酸素下でのhCG分泌低下の主因はβ-hCG mRNAの減少であると結論づけています。
pmid-9290157.summary_en: This study tested whether the choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3, BeWo, and JAr can model hypoxia-mediated repression of hCG. Hypoxia reduced hCG secretion by 67 to 81 percent, depending on oxygen level and cell line. Under hypoxia, the stimulatory effect of methotrexate on hCG was reversed, with beta-hCG mRNA falling to near-undetectable levels. The authors conclude that downregulation of beta-hCG mRNA is the main cause of reduced hCG release under hypoxia.

pmid-9305907.summary_ja: レチノイン酸によるP19マウス胎児性癌細胞の分化に、Gα12およびGα13が必須であることを示した。アンチセンスRNAによる抑制は細胞の脱着とアポトーシスを促進し、活性型変異体の発現は内胚葉への分化や胚性表現型の消失を促した。P19細胞は臨床腫瘍ではなく発生研究のモデルとして用いられている。
pmid-9305907.summary_en: This study shows that Gα12 and Gα13 heterotrimeric G-protein subunits are needed for retinoic acid-induced differentiation of P19 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells. Antisense knockdown promotes detachment and apoptosis, while constitutively active forms drive differentiation toward endoderm or loss of the embryonal phenotype. P19 cells serve as a developmental model rather than a clinical tumor model. The work concerns signaling in embryonal carcinoma cells but not germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-9305908.summary_ja: レチノイン酸はP19胎児性癌細胞においてJNKを持続的に活性化し、ERKやp38は変化させなかった。活性型Gα12/Gα13もJNKを活性化し、優性抑制型JNK1は活性化と内胚葉分化の両方を阻害した。JNKがGα12/13の下流で分化に必要であることを示した。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-9305908.summary_en: Retinoic acid induces sustained c-Jun amino-terminal kinase (JNK) activation in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, with no change in ERK1/2 or p38 MAPK. Constitutively active Gα12 and Gα13 likewise activate JNK. A dominant-negative JNK1 blocks both activation and endodermal differentiation, establishing JNK as a downstream effector of Gα12/13 required for retinoic acid-induced differentiation. As in the companion study, P19 is an in vitro developmental model, not a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-9328347.summary_ja: 本研究は、胚性転写因子Oct-3/4がJAr絨毛癌細胞においてhCGα鎖遺伝子の発現を抑制することを示した。抑制はプロモーター領域を介して起こり、安定発現により内因性のhCGα mRNAとタンパク質が70～80%減少した。絨毛癌細胞株を用いたhCG遺伝子制御の研究であり、患者や臨床管理は扱っていない。
pmid-9328347.summary_en: This study shows that the embryonic transcription factor Oct-3/4 silences expression of the hCG alpha-subunit gene in JAr human choriocarcinoma cells, in addition to the previously reported beta-subunit silencing. Repression acts through the promoter without direct binding to the main silencing site, and stable expression reduces endogenous hCG alpha mRNA and protein by 70-80%. The authors propose that falling Oct-3/4 levels allow coordinated hCG gene activation as trophoblast forms. The work concerns hCG gene regulation in a cell line rather than patients or clinical management.

pmid-9334233.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌細胞株P19におけるNa+/H+アンチポーターの役割を検討したものです。阻害剤Hoe 694で分化が消失し、アンチポーター欠損細胞では増殖と神経様細胞への分化が低下しました。再導入により能力が回復し、細胞内pH調節が増殖と分化の両方に必要であることが示されました。臨床研究ではなく基礎研究です。
pmid-9334233.summary_en: This study examines the Na+/H+ antiporter in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a widely used model cell line. Blocking the antiporter with the inhibitor Hoe 694 abolished retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Antiporter-deficient P19 cells showed reduced growth and impaired neuronal-like differentiation, and reintroducing the antiporter restored these abilities. The findings indicate that intracellular pH regulation through this transporter is needed for both proliferation and differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells. The work is basic cell biology rather than clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-9352024.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清から精製した3～5kDaの免疫抑制因子の機能を検討した。in vitroではヒト混合リンパ球反応を抑制し、in vivoではマウス同種免疫応答を抑制した。本因子は生殖免疫学や移植領域への応用が示唆され、絨毛癌の治療に関するものではない。
pmid-9352024.summary_en: This study investigates a low-molecular-weight (3-5 kDa) immunosuppressive factor purified from supernatants of the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line. The fraction suppressed human mixed lymphocyte reactions in vitro, induced suppressor cell activity in peripheral blood lymphocyte cultures, and suppressed murine allogeneic responses in a popliteal lymph node assay in vivo. The authors suggest the factor may be relevant to reproductive immunology and transplantation rather than to choriocarcinoma treatment.

pmid-9352625.summary_ja: 本研究はP19胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸処理および凝集培養で神経分化させ、MASH-1、MATH-1、neuroD、NSCL-2の遺伝子発現を検討した。MASH-1、neuroD、NSCL-2は一過性に強く誘導され、MATH-1の増加は軽度であった。マウス胚の神経系発生と類似した順序を示した。胚細胞腫瘍そのものの生物学を扱う研究ではない。
pmid-9352625.summary_en: This study examined transient expression of four basic helix-loop-helix transcription factors (MASH-1, MATH-1, neuroD, NSCL-2) during retinoic acid-induced and aggregation-induced neural differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. RT-PCR and HPLC analysis showed that MASH-1, neuroD and NSCL-2 mRNA were strongly induced, peaking at days 3-5, while MATH-1 increased slightly. MAP2 rose alongside, plateauing by day 5. The temporal order resembled that of mouse embryonic nervous system development. The work uses P19 cells as a neurogenesis model rather than investigating germ cell tumour biology directly.

pmid-9367635.summary_ja: 本論文はマウスt複合体に関連する細胞表面糖蛋白ESGpの性状を解析した。ESGpは初期胚と胎児性癌細胞株に発現する。部分的な配列解析と生化学的比較から、マウスLAMP-1と相同であることが示された。Northern法では単一の転写産物、Southern法では少なくとも2つの相同遺伝子が示唆された。ESGp/LAMP-1はt致死性アレルにより糖鎖修飾が異なる可能性がある。
pmid-9367635.summary_en: This paper characterizes ESGp, a cell surface glycoprotein linked to the mouse t-complex and expressed in early embryos and embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Limited sequencing and biochemical comparisons show that ESGp is homologous to mouse LAMP-1 in core size, sulfation, phosphorylation and proteolytic resistance. Northern blotting detected a single transcript, while Southern analysis suggested at least two homologous LAMP-1 genes. ESGp/LAMP-1 may be differentially glycosylated depending on the t-lethal allele.

pmid-9509113.summary_ja: 10歳女児に生じた舌外側部の先天性類皮嚢腫の診断と治療を報告した症例報告である。口腔内の真の類皮嚢腫は稀な疾患である。舌の胚発生中における本嚢腫の発生機序に関する諸説も概説されている。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫とみなされることもあり、胚細胞腫瘍としての分類には議論がある。
pmid-9509113.summary_en: Case report of a congenital dermoid cyst of the lateral tongue body in a 10-year-old girl, describing its diagnosis and management. True dermoid cysts of the oral cavity are rare, usually presenting as midline swellings of the floor of the mouth. The paper also reviews theories of pathogenesis during tongue embryogenesis. Because dermoid cysts are sometimes regarded as mature teratomas, their classification as germ cell tumors is debated, though this lesion is best viewed as developmental.

pmid-9349774.summary_ja: 胎児内胎児は、ある胎児が別の胎児に包含される稀な病態で、通常は良性である。本報告では、包含された胎児の切除後に悪性再発を認めた症例を記載している。悪性腫瘍の組織型は抄録に記載されていない。胎児内胎児は奇形腫関連の病態とされ、胚細胞腫瘍との関連は組織型に依存する。
pmid-9349774.summary_en: A case of fetus-in-fetu, a rare condition in which one fetus is enclosed within another, is described. Such occurrences are usually benign. This report describes a malignant recurrence after resection of the enclosed fetus. The abstract does not specify the histologic type of the malignancy. Fetus-in-fetu is generally regarded as a teratoma-related entity, so its relevance to germ cell tumors depends on histology that is not reported in the abstract.

pmid-10946695.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の画像所見と病理所見の対応を示す総説。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌などを対象とし、超音波検査による胞状奇胎の早期検出や、血清β-hCG測定の重要性を解説する。
pmid-10946695.summary_en: This review correlates radiologic and pathologic findings in gestational trophoblastic disease, which includes complete and partial hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic disease. Serum beta-hCG is central to diagnosis, and ultrasonography is essential for early detection of hydatidiform mole, typically showing a heterogeneous central mass with anechoic spaces. Invasive mole may show myometrial invasion, and choriocarcinoma appears as a heterogeneous uterine mass reflecting necrosis and hemorrhage. Imaging is most helpful in early disease and in recurrent or unclear cases.

pmid-21224167.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に補助放射線療法を受けた病期I・IIA・IIBの精巣セミノーマ61例の後方視的研究。平均75か月の観察で全生存率は93%、がん特異的生存率は100%であった。再発率は5%で、大半は照射野外での再発だった。長期的な重大な治療合併症は少なく、補助放射線療法は依然有効と結論づけている。
pmid-21224167.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 61 patients with stage I, IIA, or IIB testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant radiation therapy after orchiectomy over 15 years. Doses ranged from 2,000 to 4,000 cGy, and protocols were modified in 13 patients based on lymphangiography or CT findings. With a mean follow-up of 75 months, overall survival was 93% and cause-specific survival was 100%. Recurrence occurred in 5%, mostly outside the radiation field. Long-term treatment complications were not significant apart from lymphangiography-related complications in 24%. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy remains effective.

pmid-21541584.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍26例（45腫瘍・成分）を対象に、p53発現と増殖活性（Ki-67・PCNA）を検討した研究。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍でp53陽性率と増殖指数が高く、侵襲性の高い組織型と相関した。臨床病期や転帰との明確な関連は、小規模なシリーズでは認められなかった。
pmid-21541584.summary_en: This study examined p53 protein expression and tumor proliferation (Ki-67 and PCNA) in 26 patients with seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, comprising 45 tumors or components. p53 positivity was high in embryonal carcinoma (91%) and yolk sac tumor (38%), while seminoma and most mature and immature teratomas were focally or rarely positive. Proliferation indices were highest in embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. p53 expression correlated with proliferation and aggressive histology but showed no clear relation to clinical stage or outcome in this small series.

pmid-21594324.summary_ja: 1979〜1992年に治療された79例のセミノーマ（うち病期I 62例）の治療成績と長期フォローアップを検討。平均観察期間は6.0年で、病期I患者の大半は精巣摘除術後に平均33Gyの放射線療法を受けた。再発は3例（5%）で、いずれも救済治療により奏効し、評価可能な60例は全例が無病生存している。
pmid-21594324.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 79 seminoma patients treated between 1979 and 1992, including 62 with stage I disease. Mean follow-up was 6.0 years. Most stage I patients received orchiectomy with adjuvant radiotherapy (mean 33 Gy), while a few underwent primary RPLND, chemotherapy, or surveillance. Three of the 62 stage I patients (5%) relapsed, and all were salvaged successfully. All 60 evaluable patients were alive without evidence of disease. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy remains the routine treatment for stage I seminoma, despite wait-and-watch or carboplatin approaches.

pmid-21594374.summary_ja: 高周波（レーダーやマイクロ波）被曝と精巣障害・精巣がんとの関連をレビューした総説。18歳男性で、レーダー被曝後に重度の乏精子症が生じ、その後セミノーマを発症した症例が報告されている。関連は未証明だが示唆的であり、施設従事者の防護強化を訴えている。
pmid-21594374.summary_en: A review of the association between radiofrequency exposure (radar and microwave) and testicular damage and cancer. The authors report a case of secondary severe oligospermia followed by seminoma in an 18-year-old man, probably induced by radar and microwave exposure. The link between radiofrequency and testicular cancer is considered unproven but suggestive, based on clinical and experimental data. The paper calls for alertness among medical teams at radar facilities and better protection for the workers there.

pmid-24057462.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で検出される腹部・骨盤内腫瘍と、その管理への影響を検討した研究。最も多く検出されるのは仙尾部奇形腫で、早期分娩や帝王切開が予後改善に必要な場合があるとしている。仙尾部奇形腫の診断は主に特定の妊娠管理につながると結論づけている。
pmid-24057462.summary_en: This paper reviews prenatal ultrasonographic detection of abdominal and pelvic tumors and its effect on management. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most commonly detected, followed by neuroblastoma and renal tumors. The authors conclude that diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma mainly leads to specific pregnancy monitoring, since early delivery or cesarean section may be needed to improve outcomes for the child or mother. Other tumors warrant investigation and intervention after birth.

pmid-24057550.summary_ja: 膵臓に発生する嚢胞性奇形腫は極めて稀で、これまで世界で11例しか報告されていない。本症例報告は生後4か月の女児における12例目である。抄録は簡潔で、画像所見、手術、組織学的所見、転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-24057550.summary_en: This case report describes a cystic teratoma of the pancreas, an extremely rare entity with only 11 prior cases in the world literature. The authors present the 12th case, in a 4-month-old girl. The abstract is brief and does not detail imaging, surgical management, histology, or outcome. Given its rarity, the report adds to the limited literature on extragonadal teratomas arising in unusual sites such as the pancreas.

pmid-24057562.summary_ja: 新生児期に気道閉塞で発症する口腔鼻咽頭奇形腫の3例を報告した1996年の小児外科論文。速やかな気道確保と早期切除が推奨され、悪性度が極めて低いため過度な侵襲手術は避けるべきと述べている。完全切除が必要で複数回の手術を要することもある。文献レビューを含む。
pmid-24057562.summary_en: This 1996 pediatric surgery report describes three patients with oronasopharyngeal teratomas, rare tumors typically presenting in the neonatal period with airway obstruction. The authors recommend prompt airway establishment and early excision. Complete resection is advised, possibly requiring multiple operations, while avoiding mutilating surgery given the very low malignant potential. The paper includes a literature review. Its brief abstract offers practical management guidance for this uncommon teratoma location.

pmid-24057563.summary_ja: 乳児の仙尾部奇形腫で胸椎中部まで脊柱管内に進展した1例の報告(1996年)。2期的手術で完全切除し、病理組織学により良性奇形腫と確認された。神経因性膀胱と便秘は自然に改善し、3年間のフォローアップで新たな神経症状はなかった。脊柱管を含む広範な奇形腫の手術計画には磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が重要であると強調している。
pmid-24057563.summary_en: This 1996 case report describes a 7-month-old boy with a giant thoracolumbosacral teratoma, a sacrococcygeal teratoma with unusually high intraspinal extension up to the mid-thoracic spine. The tumor was removed in two stages, with histology confirming a benign teratoma. Neurogenic bladder and constipation improved spontaneously. No new neurological deficits were recorded over three years of follow-up. The case illustrates the importance of MRI for planning surgery for extensive teratomas involving the spinal canal.

pmid-24057843.summary_ja: 本報告は、1982年から1992年に治療されたサウジアラビアの新生児5例の頸部奇形腫の系列である。全例が出生時に頸部腫瘤を呈し、3例は出生前に診断された。4例で外科的完全切除が行われ、1例は手術前に呼吸窮迫で死亡した。組織学的に3つの胚葉すべてが認められた。3～11年の経過観察で再発はなく、甲状腺機能と血清αフェトプロテインは正常であった。著者らは、出生前診断が気道関連の罹患率を低減し、手術が唯一の有効な治療法であると結論している。
pmid-24057843.summary_en: This 1996 Saudi Arabian series reports five neonates with cervical teratomas treated between 1982 and 1992. All presented with cervical masses at birth, and three were diagnosed antenatally. Surgical complete resection was performed in four patients, with one dying before surgery from respiratory distress. Histology showed all three germ layers. Over three to eleven years of follow-up, no recurrence occurred, and thyroid function and serum AFP were normal. The authors conclude that antenatal diagnosis reduces airway-related morbidity and that surgery is the only effective treatment.

pmid-37282297.summary_ja: 129/Sv-ter系マウスで胚細胞欠損と先天性精巣奇形腫を引き起こすter遺伝子を、他系統へ戻し交配して解析した1996年の研究。胚細胞欠損は両性に残存したが、精巣の奇形腫発生は第5世代以降に起こらなかった。奇形腫発生には遺伝的背景が関与し、ter遺伝子は卵巣奇形腫には関与しないと結論づけられた。
pmid-37282297.summary_en: This 1996 mouse genetics study examines the ter (teratoma) mutation, which causes germ cell deficiency and congenital testicular teratomas in 129/Sv-ter mice. Backcrossing the ter gene into C57BL/6J, LTXBJ and C3H/HeJ backgrounds showed germ cell deficiency persisted in both sexes, but testicular teratocarcinogenesis did not occur after the fifth backcross. Ovarian teratomas were absent in LTXBJ-ter females. The authors conclude that ter alone causes germ cell deficiency, while testicular teratoma formation depends on genetic background and ovarian teratomas are independent of the gene.

pmid-7490882.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者65例の血清・組織PLAP値を調べ、抗PLAPモノクローナル抗体をヌードマウスの腫瘍に投与した1996年の研究。抗PLAP抗体は7日間腫瘍内に残存し、シンチグラフィで明瞭に描出された。セミノーマのリンパ節転移の免疫学的検出に応用できる可能性が示唆された。ただし人での検証ではなく、異種移植モデルによる予備的な研究である。
pmid-7490882.summary_en: This 1996 study evaluated monoclonal antibodies against placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and liver alkaline phosphatase (LAP) in nude mice bearing HeLa Hep 2 tumors. The anti-PLAP antibody was retained in xenografts over seven days and clearly visualized tumors on scintigraphy, while anti-LAP cleared over time. Serum and tissue PLAP levels were also examined in 65 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. The authors suggest anti-PLAP antibody may enable immunodetection of seminoma lymph node metastases. The work is preliminary, using xenograft models rather than clinical imaging of patients.

pmid-8543595.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの純粋セミノーマ82例に対し、精巣摘除術後に補助療法としてカルボプラチン（400 mg/m²）を投与した。中央値24か月の観察期間で再発は1例のみであった。毒性は軽度で、骨髄毒性はほとんどなく、FSHの推移から性腺毒性も軽微であった。放射線療法と同等の効果が期待でき、無作為化試験での検証に値すると結論された。
pmid-8543595.summary_en: This study evaluated carboplatin 400 mg/m2 given after orchiectomy as adjuvant therapy in 82 patients with clinical stage I pure seminoma, as an alternative to abdominal radiotherapy. With a median follow-up of 24 months, only one relapse occurred. Toxicity was mild, with negligible myelotoxicity and minimal gonadal effects by FSH monitoring. The authors conclude carboplatin appears as effective as radiotherapy and merits randomized trials.

pmid-8557234.summary_ja: 子宮原発の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の再発症例を報告したものです。初回は子宮摘出術と化学療法で治療され、有糸分裂像は少数でしたが、約1年4か月後に卵巣転移が判明しました。追加の化学療法7コースで血清β-hCG値は低下しました。低い有糸分裂数の意義や電子顕微鏡所見、DNAフィンガープリント解析について考察しています。
pmid-8557234.summary_en: This report describes a recurrent placental site trophoblastic tumor of the uterus in a patient initially treated with hysterectomy and chemotherapy. The tumor had only two mitoses per 10 high-power fields, yet recurrence occurred as an ovarian metastasis, diagnosed by rising serum beta-hCG and elevated beta-hCG and hPL in cystic ovarian fluid. Seven further chemotherapy courses reduced serum beta-hCG. The authors discuss the prognostic significance of low mitotic counts, electron microscopic features, and DNA fingerprint analysis of the primary tumor.

pmid-8558664.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍105例を対象に、病理病期を予測する指標を検討した研究です。フローサイトメトリーによるG2M+S細胞分画が最も有用で、カットオフ41%で感度は71%でした。胎児性癌の体積やMIB-1染色は転移リスクの低い患者の同定に役立つ可能性があり、過剰治療の低減が期待されます。
pmid-8558664.summary_en: This study assessed whether nontraditional markers could predict pathological stage in 105 consecutive patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Flow cytometry showed that the G2M+S fraction of the aneuploid stemline was the most predictive parameter, with 71% sensitivity at a 41% cutoff. Low embryonal carcinoma volume and MIB-1 staining identified patients at very low metastatic risk. The authors conclude these markers could reduce unnecessary treatment morbidity.

pmid-8558665.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後も血清hCGまたはAFPが持続的に上昇していた臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍30例を検討しました。AFP上昇例の83%が再発して化学療法を要したのに対し、hCG上昇例では25%でした。AFPが持続的に上昇する場合は初回から化学療法を行うべきだと結論づけています。
pmid-8558665.summary_en: This study reviewed 30 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors whose serum hCG or AFP stayed elevated after orchiectomy and who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Of 6 patients with elevated AFP, 5 (83%) relapsed and needed chemotherapy, compared with 6 of 24 (25%) with elevated hCG. The authors recommend initial chemotherapy for persistent AFP elevation, while noting that many patients with elevated hCG were disease-free after surgery alone.

pmid-8558666.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍155例を対象とした単施設解析で、頸部転移は7例（4.5%）に認められ、発生頻度は病期と強く相関しました。化学療法後に残存頸部腫瘤があった3例の選択的頸部郭清では、2例に奇形腫成分が見つかり、1例は瘢痕と壊死でした。化学療法後の頸部腫瘤には根治的手術が推奨されており、残存腫瘍の除去と局所制御が目的です。
pmid-8558666.summary_en: This institutional analysis of 155 patients with testicular germ cell tumors found neck metastasis in 7 (4.5%), with incidence correlating with disease stage. Three patients with post-chemotherapy residual neck masses underwent selective neck dissection, revealing teratomatous elements in two and scar and necrosis in one. The authors recommend definitive surgery for post-chemotherapy neck masses to achieve local control and remove residual neoplastic or teratomatous tissue. The study supports surgical management as part of the overall treatment plan for these patients.

pmid-8560668.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に発生期の腎奇形および尿道下裂を伴う、これまで報告のなかった表現型を記述している。臨床および病理学的検討により、精巣腫瘍は散発例に類似していることが示された。5例の遺伝学的解析では、核型異常、ヘテロ接合性の消失、WT1のジンクフィンガーエクソンの変異は認められなかった。著者らは、この組み合わせはWT1とは別の遺伝子によって生じる独立した症候群であると提唱している。
pmid-8560668.summary_en: This study describes a previously unreported phenotype combining testicular germ cell tumors with developmental renal anomalies and urethral hypospadias. Clinical and pathologic review found that the testicular tumors resemble sporadic cases, and genetic analysis of five patients showed no karyotypic abnormality, loss of heterozygosity, or mutations in WT1 zinc finger exons. The authors propose that this combination is a discrete syndrome caused by a gene distinct from WT1.

pmid-8583612.summary_ja: 精巣原発純粋奇形腫の15例を15年間にわたり検討した後方視的研究です。追跡可能な14例中6例に後腹膜転移が生じ、一部では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分も含まれていました。病期Iでの再発は少なく、治療は他の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に準じるとされています。
pmid-8583612.summary_en: This retrospective review of 15 patients with primary pure testicular teratoma treated over 15 years examines natural history and management. Metastases developed in 6 of 14 followed-up patients, all confined to the retroperitoneum, and some metastases contained yolk sac tumour as well as teratoma. Relapse was uncommon in stage I patients under surveillance, but the authors conclude management should follow that of other nonseminomatous tumours, with an excellent prognosis.

pmid-8583614.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に、神経症状を来した例を解析した研究です。712例中4例（0.56%）に脊髄虚血が生じました。高齢、広範な郭清、先行治療、麻酔条件などが危険因子として挙げられています。
pmid-8583614.summary_en: This study reviews neurological deficits after post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) for nonseminomatous germ cell tumours, identified from a testis cancer database of 1,447 procedures. Spinal cord ischemia occurred in 4 of 712 patients (0.56%). Older age, extensive dissection, prior therapy and certain anesthetic parameters were suggested as risk factors, which could help identify high-risk patients and guide preventive measures.

pmid-8583615.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の160例を後方視的に解析した研究です。化学療法後に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた症例が対象です。精巣標本では43.7%が壊死・瘢痕、31.2%が純粋奇形腫、25%が残存胚細胞腫瘍でした。他部位で反応が見られても遅延精巣摘除術の必要性が示唆されています。
pmid-8583615.summary_en: This retrospective review examines delayed orchiectomy after systemic chemotherapy in 160 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who subsequently underwent orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Testicular specimens showed necrosis or scar in 43.7%, pure teratoma in 31.2%, and persistent germ cell cancer in 25%. Findings in retroperitoneal dissection specimens matched testicular findings in fewer than half of cases, supporting delayed orchiectomy even after apparent response at other sites.

pmid-8586108.summary_ja: 濾胞型の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の再発例に対しヨウ素131放射線療法を行った症例報告です。サイログロブリンの上昇で再発を検出し、6GBqの投与で30か月間にわたり完全寛解が得られました。分化型甲状腺癌と同様の治療法が推奨されています。
pmid-8586108.summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old woman with follicular-type malignant struma ovarii treated with thyroidectomy and surgical removal of the primary tumour, followed by ablative radioiodine therapy. Rising thyroglobulin led to detection of a relapse with suspected bladder infiltration, which showed radioiodine uptake on scanning. Treatment with 6 GBq iodine-131 produced complete regression, sustained over 30 months of follow-up. The authors recommend the regimen used for differentiated thyroid carcinoma.

pmid-8599013.summary_ja: 新生児・乳児に多い仙尾部の卵黄嚢癌（悪性仙尾部奇形腫）の画像所見を、治療経過に沿って検討した。悪性転化の危険は月齢とともに高まる。MRIは仙骨浸潤や転移の評価に優れ、線維化と再発腫瘍の鑑別にも有用である。治療効果や再発の判断に役立つ知見を示している。
pmid-8599013.summary_en: This imaging review describes sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumors (malignant sacrococcygeal teratomas) in neonates and infants, which are the most common solid tumors in this age group. It notes that malignant transformation risk rises with age, and that cross-sectional imaging now guides staging and chemotherapy response assessment. The authors emphasize MRI as superior for evaluating sacral invasion and metastases and distinguishing fibrotic change from recurrent tumor, helping clinicians judge therapy efficacy and recurrence.

pmid-8602651.summary_ja: 嚢胞性線維症を合併した精巣胎児性癌（病期III）の症例を報告した。両疾患の併存は約8000万分の1と推定される極めて稀な組み合わせである。嚢胞性線維症による精管の障害が、発生学的な共通基盤を示す可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-8602651.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with cystic fibrosis who was diagnosed with stage III testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors note that the co-occurrence of these two conditions is extremely rare, with an estimated probability of about 1 in 80 million. They suggest that involvement of the vas deferens in cystic fibrosis may reflect a shared embryologic basis that could help explain the pathogenesis of the association.

pmid-8604247.summary_ja: 精巣浸潤を伴う非ホジキンリンパ腫で血清hCG様物質が上昇するかを、デンマークの登録コホートで検討した。12例中2例で上昇し、精巣摘除後に正常化した。精巣リンパ腫でも上昇がみられることは、胚細胞腫瘍との鑑別で重要である。予後的意義や経過観察への有用性は未解明である。
pmid-8604247.summary_en: This study investigated whether testicular non-Hodgkin's lymphoma is associated with elevated serum hCG-like material (S-hCG-1), a marker otherwise used to suggest germ cell tumors. Among 12 registry cases with testicular involvement, two elderly patients with high-grade diffuse B-cell lymphoma had elevated levels, which normalized after hemiorchiectomy. The authors conclude that S-hCG-1 elevation is fairly common in testicular NHL, which matters for avoiding misdiagnosis of germ cell tumor. Prognostic significance and utility for monitoring remain unclear.

pmid-8606544.summary_ja: 精巣の病期I純粋セミノーマ332例を対象とした多施設後方視的研究です。精巣摘除術前のβ-hCG上昇と原発腫瘍の局所浸潤は、いずれも予後不良を示さないと結論されています。中央値50か月の観察で、ほぼ全例が無病生存しました。胸部再発の1例は救援化学療法で無病となっています。
pmid-8606544.summary_en: This multi-institutional retrospective review of 332 men with stage I pure seminoma of the testis examined whether an elevated preorchiectomy beta-hCG level or local tumor invasion affects prognosis. About 13% of evaluable patients had elevated beta-hCG, which normalized after orchiectomy. Almost all patients remained alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 50 months. One patient received salvage chemotherapy for a chest recurrence and remained disease-free. The authors conclude that neither finding predicts a poor prognosis in clinical stage I seminoma.

pmid-8607249.summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成と45,X/46,X,dic(Y)のモザイク核型を有する66歳女性の症例報告です。子宮摘出術と両側性腺摘除術などを受け、右側の異形性性腺からディスジャーミノーマが見つかりました。未治療の疾患の自然経過と早期評価の重要性を示し、二動原体Y染色体の分子特性も報告しています。
pmid-8607249.summary_en: This case report describes a 66-year-old woman with mixed gonadal dysgenesis and a 45,X/46,X,dic(Y) mosaic karyotype. She underwent hysterectomy, bilateral gonadectomy, and reconstructive procedures. Pathology identified a dysgerminoma in the right dysgenetic gonad. The authors describe the natural history of untreated disease and the importance of early evaluation. They also characterize the dicentric Y chromosome at the molecular level.

pmid-8607250.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍（胎児性癌）に対し、根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を受けた症例です。腫瘍が壁を貫いて浸潤していたため下大静脈を切除し、外部支持型PTFE人工血管で再建しました。開存性は画像検査で確認されました。外部支持型PTFEが下大静脈再建の第一選択と結論しています。
pmid-8607250.summary_en: This report describes a patient who underwent radical retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for metastatic embryonal carcinoma of the testis. Tumor resection required removal of the inferior vena cava because of transmural invasion. The vessel was replaced with an externally stented PTFE graft, and patency was confirmed by Doppler studies, duplex ultrasonography, and CT. The authors conclude that stented PTFE is currently the preferred graft for inferior vena caval replacement.

pmid-8607697.summary_ja: 無症状の肺腫瘤を経皮的針生検で非小細胞肺癌と診断された男性の症例報告です。左上葉切除術後の病理検査で原発性肺絨毛癌と確定しました。男性の原発性肺絨毛癌は極めて稀です。偶発的に発見された本疾患では外科的切除が適切な治療選択になりうると結論しています。
pmid-8607697.summary_en: This case report describes a man with an asymptomatic pulmonary mass initially diagnosed as non-small cell lung cancer by transthoracic needle biopsy. He underwent left upper lobectomy, and final pathology showed a primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, which is exceedingly rare in men. The authors conclude that surgical resection of an incidentally found primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, an extremely fatal malignancy, may be an appropriate treatment of choice.

pmid-8609154.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣がん32例の精巣摘除術標本、正常精巣組織、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍細胞株3種で幹細胞因子(SCF)とその受容体c-kitの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。セミノーマと奇形腫成分では高頻度に発現した一方、胎児性癌はほぼ陰性であった。SCF/c-kit系は正常精巣では精子形成の調節に関与し、非セミノーマ性腫瘍ではこの系が失われていると考えられた。
pmid-8609154.summary_en: This study examined stem-cell factor (SCF) and its receptor c-kit in 32 testicular cancer orchiectomy specimens, normal testis, and three non-seminomatous germ cell tumor cell lines. Most seminomas and teratomatous components expressed SCF and c-kit, whereas embryonal carcinoma was largely negative. Normal germ cells strongly expressed c-kit, and SCF localized to Sertoli cells. Exogenous SCF stimulated cell line growth only under serum-free conditions. The authors suggest the SCF/c-kit system regulates spermatogenesis and is lost in non-seminomatous tumors, with possible implications for treatment and male infertility.

pmid-8609693.summary_ja: 播種性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の39歳男性で、白金製剤併用化学療法と大量化学療法後に血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が再上昇した。化学療法抵抗性の単発肺病変を胸腔鏡下に切除し、残存腫瘍のため低用量経口エトポシドを投与したところ、腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。救済的切除と慢性経口エトポシド療法の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-8609693.summary_en: A 39-year-old man with disseminated extragonadal germ cell tumor had rising serum hCG after platinum-based chemotherapy, high-dose chemotherapy with autologous marrow rescue, and radical surgery. A solitary lung lesion refractory to further chemotherapy was resected by video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. Because viable tumor remained and hCG stayed slightly elevated, low-dose oral etoposide was given, normalizing the marker. The patient remained in complete remission for 3 years after diagnosis. The authors suggest salvage resection and chronic oral etoposide merit further study.

pmid-8610136.summary_ja: 成人精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の早期診断マーカーとして、血小板由来増殖因子αレセプター(PDGFRA)遺伝子の1.5kb転写産物を検討した。RT-PCRにより、セミノーマ18例と非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍11例、および上皮内癌を伴う精巣組織で検出され、非腫瘍性精巣組織や胎盤、精液では検出されなかった。低侵襲で精度の高い検出法となる可能性が示された。
pmid-8610136.summary_en: The authors examined a unique 1.5-kb transcript of the platelet-derived growth factor alpha-receptor (PDGFRA) gene, first identified in Tera-2 embryonal carcinoma cells, as a diagnostic marker. RT-PCR detected this transcript in all 18 seminomas and 11 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, and in testis parenchyma with carcinoma in situ. It was absent from normal parenchyma, placenta, and control semen. The findings suggest the transcript could serve as a highly selective, minimally invasive marker for detecting early testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-8611416.summary_ja: ノルウェーとスウェーデン南部の精巣がん患者を対象に家族性精巣がんを解析した。兄弟の標準化発生比(SIR)は10.2と高値で、家族性例は両側発生が多く、セミノーマの発症年齢も若かった。停留精巣の有病率に差はなく、遺伝的要因の重要性が示唆された。
pmid-8611416.summary_en: This study used questionnaires from 797 Norwegian and 178 Swedish testicular cancer patients treated in 1981-1991, identifying 56 with familial disease. Brothers of patients had a markedly elevated standardized incidence ratio of 10.2. Familial cases showed more bilateral tumors, and seminoma onset occurred earlier than in sporadic cases. Undescended testis prevalence did not differ between groups, suggesting different factors drive familial testicular cancer and undescended testis. Genetic factors may be more important than previously assumed.

pmid-8612081.summary_ja: 78歳女性の左卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例を報告し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で診断した。類皮嚢腫は閉経前女性に多い良性腫瘍であり、閉経後の本症例は非典型的であった。卵巣類皮嚢腫に一致するCT所見を整理し、画像診断におけるCTの役割を考察している。
pmid-8612081.summary_en: This case report describes a 78-year-old woman with a dermoid cyst of the left ovary, diagnosed on computed tomography. Dermoid cysts are common benign ovarian tumors, most often found in premenopausal women, so this diagnosis in a postmenopausal patient was unusual. The authors review CT findings consistent with ovarian dermoid cysts and discuss the role of CT as a diagnostic tool.

pmid-8612676.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌由来のNCR-G3細胞は、レチノイン酸処理で栄養外胚葉系譜へ分化する。本研究では、熱刺激のみで分化が誘導され、熱ショックタンパク質HSP90が一過性に誘導されること、サイトケラチンとヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の発現が増加することを示した。熱刺激による初期分化の新たな機能が示唆された。
pmid-8612676.summary_en: NCR-G3 cells, derived from a testicular embryonal carcinoma, differentiate into trophectoderm lineages upon retinoic acid exposure. This study found that heat alone triggers early differentiation: the heat shock protein HSP90 is transiently induced, and heat exposure increases cytokeratin and hCG expression. The authors propose that heat-like stress drives differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma cells into trophectoderm lineages, suggesting a previously unrecognized role for heat in early differentiation.

pmid-8612834.summary_ja: 非閉塞性無精子症で停留精巣の既往がある男性2例では、ICSIのための精巣内精子採取時に精巣セミノーマが偶然発見された。いずれも精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた。腫瘍の存在下でも受精と双胎妊娠が成立した。停留精巣歴のある無精子症患者では、セミノーマを除外するため病理組織学的評価のための検体提出が勧められている。
pmid-8612834.summary_en: Two men with nonobstructive azoospermia and a history of cryptorchidism were found to have testicular seminoma incidentally during testicular sperm extraction for ICSI. In both cases, the diagnosis was made on histopathology of the testicular biopsy, and the patients underwent orchiectomy with radiotherapy. Successful fertilization and a twin pregnancy were achieved despite the tumor. The authors recommend that testicular biopsy specimens from such men be sent for histopathology to exclude seminoma.

pmid-8617040.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍から横隔膜上リンパ節転移をきたした31例を後方視的に検討し、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）の進展様式を比較した。肺転移はNSGCTの40%に認めた。頸部と縦隔の同時病変はセミノーマで有意に多かった。奇形腫では血行性、セミノーマではリンパ行性の進展が重要であることが示唆された。
pmid-8617040.summary_en: This retrospective review of 31 patients with supradiaphragmatic nodal metastases from testicular germ cell tumours compared seminoma (11 patients) and non-seminomatous germ cell tumour (20 patients). Lung metastases were seen in 40% of NSGCT cases. Neck and mediastinal disease coexisted far more often in seminoma (55%) than in NSGCT (10%). The findings support haematogenous spread in teratoma and lymphatic spread in seminoma. NSGCT spread was more random, favouring paraoesophageal and subcarinal nodes.

pmid-8617489.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫25例のうち3例（12%）に良性前立腺組織が認められた。成熟卵巣奇形腫における前立腺組織は、これまでの文献で示されている以上に一般的である可能性がある。病理医が奇形腫の組織像を評価する際に、前立腺成分を予期せぬ所見として認識しておくことの重要性を示している。
pmid-8617489.summary_en: Benign prostatic tissue was identified in three of 25 benign cystic ovarian teratomas examined. The authors suggest that prostatic tissue in mature ovarian teratomas may be more common than the current literature indicates. The report highlights an incidental histologic finding in ovarian teratoma. Recognizing this pattern matters for pathologists, since prostatic elements can be an unexpected component of teratomatous differentiation.

pmid-8618292.summary_ja: 1975年から1995年に報告された免疫抑制患者の精巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した。低病期では精巣がんによる死亡はなかった。疾患特異的死亡率は後天性免疫不全症候群で6.1%、移植後患者で25%と、移植後で有意に高かった。治療の有害事象は一般集団と差がなく、組織型と病期に応じた標準治療を行うべきとしている。
pmid-8618292.summary_en: This retrospective review of testicular cancers in immunosuppressed patients covered reports from 1975 to 1995. Management followed standard concepts, and no patient with low-stage (A to B1) disease died of testis cancer. Cause-specific mortality was 6.1% in AIDS patients (4 of 66) versus 25% in post-transplant patients (5 of 20), a significant difference. Treatment toxicity was not increased. The authors conclude that these patients should be treated according to histology and stage using standard protocols.

pmid-8618293.summary_ja: 化学療法を受けていない低病期の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者を後方視的に解析し、精巣摘除術標本中の奇形腫成分が後腹膜奇形腫を予測することを示した。低病期非セミノーマの治療方針の決定では、過剰な治療（二重治療）を減らすため、この病理所見を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-8618293.summary_en: This retrospective study examined patients with clinical stage A, B, or B2 nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection without prior chemotherapy. The authors asked whether teratomatous elements in the orchiectomy specimen predict teratoma in the retroperitoneum. They found that teratomatous elements in the orchiectomy specimen do predict retroperitoneal teratoma. They conclude that orchiectomy pathology should be considered when choosing treatment for low-stage nonseminoma, so that unnecessary double therapy can be minimized.

pmid-8618397.summary_ja: 米国海軍医療センターで、シスプラチン併用療法により治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を15年間にわたりレビューし、治療成績と治療失敗例を検討した。若年男性に多い精巣がんについて、治療の成功率と失敗の要因を評価した研究である。
pmid-8618397.summary_en: This 15-year review from the National Naval Medical Center examined patients treated for germ cell testis cancer, the most common solid tumor in men aged 20 to 35. The center has used cisplatin-based protocols since their introduction. The study reviews treatment success in these patients and examines cases of treatment failure. The article highlights the clinical importance of this disease for physicians who care for young adults, including military personnel in the high-risk age group.

pmid-8618400.summary_ja: 化学療法後のセカンドルック手術の意義を、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍40例の後方視的解析で検討した。腫瘍マーカー高値例や、画像異常および奇形腫成分のない例では手術は不要であり、奇形腫成分があり画像異常が残存し、腫瘍マーカーが正常な例に限って実施を推奨すると結論づけている。
pmid-8618400.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 40 patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors who received various chemotherapy regimens after primary surgery, with a median follow-up of 8 years. Twenty-two underwent second-look laparotomy. Second-look surgery was not needed in patients with elevated tumor markers or without radiologic abnormalities and teratoma components in the primary tumor. The authors recommend second-look surgery only for patients with a teratoma component in the primary tumor, persistent imaging abnormalities, and normal tumor markers after chemotherapy.

pmid-8620450.summary_ja: 自然発生の精巣奇形腫を生じる129/Sv-Sl/+マウスを用いて、奇形腫幹細胞が胚細胞核抗原GCNA1を保持するかを免疫組織化学により検討した。受精後16.5日の初期奇形腫巣はGCNA1を強く発現していたが、19.5日までに発現が低下した。出生後の奇形腫細胞では発現が認められなかった。これらの所見は、精巣奇形腫が胚細胞に由来するという説を支持する。著者らは、GCNA1が初期の胚性腫瘍巣の同定に有用である可能性も示唆している。
pmid-8620450.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study used 129/Sv-Sl/+ mice, which develop spontaneous testicular teratomas, to examine whether teratoma stem cells retain the germ cell nuclear antigen GCNA1. Early teratoma foci at 16.5 days post coitum strongly expressed GCNA1, but expression declined by 19.5 days. Postnatal teratoma cells did not express it. The findings support a germ cell origin for testicular teratomas. The authors also suggest that GCNA1 could help identify early embryonic tumor foci.

pmid-8621221.summary_ja: シスプラチン感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株と耐性の膀胱がん細胞株を細胞融合させ、シスプラチン感受性の遺伝的基盤を検討した。融合細胞では耐性が不完全優性に伝わることが示され、化学療法感受性を制御する遺伝子の同定には発現クローニングが有用と結論づけている。
pmid-8621221.summary_en: This study tested whether cisplatin sensitivity in testicular germ cell tumor cells has a genetic basis, using somatic cell fusion. Cisplatin-sensitive testis tumor lines and cisplatin-resistant bladder cancer lines were fused with a sensitive reference line. Hybrids between sensitive lines were more resistant than their parents, and hybrids with resistant cells were intermediate. Resistance was therefore incompletely dominant. The authors conclude that cisplatin sensitivity is genetically determined and suggest that expression cloning could identify the genes involved.

pmid-8622082.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する30例を対象に、外科的切除前の陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の有用性を検討した。生存腫瘍はSUVが有意に高く（中央値8.81）、壊死・線維化や奇形腫との鑑別に有用だった。化学療法後切除の判断を補助しうると結論づけている。
pmid-8622082.summary_en: This study assessed whether FDG-PET can distinguish viable germ cell tumor from necrosis/fibrosis or teratoma in 30 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who had residual masses after chemotherapy and underwent PET before surgical resection. Viable tumor showed markedly higher standardized uptake values (median 8.81) than necrosis/fibrosis (2.86) or teratoma (3.07), while PET could not separate necrosis from teratoma. The authors conclude that PET can help identify residual viable carcinoma and guide decisions about postchemotherapy resection.

pmid-8623080.summary_ja: 1978～1992年に単施設で治療した精巣セミノーマ230例の後方視的解析である。術後放射線療法の10年全生存率は96.5%、病期Iの無病生存率は96.8%だった。病期IIBでは76.9%と低かった。副作用は軽微で、病期I、IIA、IIBでは放射線療法単独で良好な制御が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-8623080.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated postoperative radiotherapy in 230 men with pure testicular seminoma, mostly stage I, treated at one institution from 1978 to 1992. Ten-year overall survival was 96.5 percent, and disease-free survival for stage I was 96.8 percent, with lower control in stage IIB (76.9 percent). Recurrences and contralateral testicular tumors occurred in a small number of patients, and side effects were mild. The authors conclude that radiotherapy alone gives excellent control for stage I, IIA and IIB.

pmid-8623764.summary_ja: 非触知性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に伴う自己免疫性溶血性貧血の症例報告である。腫瘍摘出後に貧血は改善した。嚢胞内容液にも組織にも抗体や免疫グロブリンは確認されず、交差反応や嚢胞内での抗体産生という仮説は支持されなかった。自己免疫性溶血性貧血の女性では、画像診断による卵巣類皮嚢腫の検索を広く行うべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-8623764.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with autoimmune hemolytic anemia caused by a nonpalpable ovarian dermoid cyst, which resolved after tumor excision. The red cell autoantibody was an IgG directed against the Rh complex. Cyst fluid contained no detectable red cell autoantibodies or immunoglobulins, and histology showed few lymphocytes and plasma cells, with no immunoglobulin deposits. These findings argue against cross-reactivity and intracystic antibody production as mechanisms, so the authors stress wider use of imaging to find dermoid cysts in women with autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

pmid-8624259.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ組織を単一細胞浮遊液に分散させると、アポトーシスが急速に誘導されることを示した研究である。無傷の組織では大部分の症例でアポトーシス細胞は少なかったが、細胞浮遊液ではDNAラダーと最大85%のDNA断裂が認められた。p53とbcl-2は発現していなかった。ヒトセミノーマ細胞の体外培養にはアポトーシスの抑制が鍵になると考察している。
pmid-8624259.summary_en: The authors investigated whether mechanical dissociation of human seminoma tissue into single-cell suspensions triggers apoptosis, a major barrier to in vitro culture. Intact tumors showed few apoptotic cells in most cases, and DNA ladders were absent in 11 of 14 tumors. In contrast, all pure cell suspensions showed DNA ladders, and flow cytometry revealed DNA breaks in up to 85 percent of cells. p53 and bcl-2 were not expressed. Loss of the microenvironment appears to trigger rapid apoptosis, suggesting that blocking this pathway may be needed to culture seminoma cells.

pmid-8624900.summary_ja: 京都大学病院で治療した卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ12例の後方視的解析である。腹水細胞診は検査した10例中6例で陽性だった。腹腔内転移結節は12例中5例に認められ、多くは小さかった。腹腔内への漏出は従来の報告より多い可能性があり、早期病期でも術後化学療法の根拠になると述べている。
pmid-8624900.summary_en: This retrospective study of 12 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at Kyoto University Hospital examined the pattern of intraperitoneal spread. Ascitic cytology was positive in 6 of 10 tested cases, and 5 of 12 patients had intraperitoneal metastatic nodules, most of them small. Extraovarian spread did not correlate with symptom duration, serum LDH, tumor size, or ascitic volume. The authors suggest that intraperitoneal spillage may be more common than reported, supporting ascitic cytology, careful surgical inspection, and postsurgical chemotherapy even for apparently early-stage disease.

pmid-8624983.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、既知の精巣がんを有する20歳男性が心房細動で受診した症例を記述している。検査で左房に浸潤する肺転移が判明した。報告では精巣腫瘍の転移による心臓病変に関する現在の文献をレビューしている。精巣がんの若年患者において心腔内腫瘤が不整脈として現れうること、そして転移性疾患の評価を行うべきであることを強調している。
pmid-8624983.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with known testicular carcinoma who presented with atrial fibrillation. Investigation revealed a pulmonary metastasis invading the left atrium. The report reviews the current literature on cardiac involvement by testicular tumor metastases. It highlights that intracardiac masses in young patients with testicular cancer can present as arrhythmia and should prompt evaluation for metastatic disease.

pmid-8625243.summary_ja: 腹腔内精巣腫瘍の捻転はまれではあるが、停留精巣の既往を有する急性腹症の患者では考慮すべき病態である。本論文は新たな症例を報告するとともに、既報36例を文献的に検討したものである。組織型はセミノーマが最も多く、補助放射線療法が多く施行されていた。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は手術計画に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-8625243.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes torsion of intraabdominal testicular tumors, a rare presentation. Thirty-six previously reported cases were analyzed for histologic type, presenting symptoms, imaging, and adjuvant therapy. Seminoma was the most common type, followed by sarcoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma. Most seminoma patients received adjuvant radiation, while one choriocarcinoma patient received chemotherapy. The authors recommend considering torsion in patients with an acute abdomen and a history of cryptorchidism, and suggest preoperative CT to aid surgical planning.

pmid-8626100.summary_ja: 抵抗性妊娠性絨毛癌の2症例にタキソールを投与した報告である。前治療はEMACO療法および白金製剤を含む救援化学療法であった。両例で有意な反応がみられ、1例は脳と肝臓に再発して死亡した。もう1例はカルボプラチンとの併用で、開頭による脳病変の切除後に持続的な寛解を得た。化学療法抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛癌に対するタキソールの有用性が示唆される。
pmid-8626100.summary_en: Two women with resistant gestational choriocarcinoma, previously treated with EMACO and platinum-based salvage chemotherapy, received paclitaxel (Taxol). Both showed significant responses. One patient relapsed in the brain and liver and died. The other received paclitaxel combined with carboplatin and achieved sustained clinical and hormonal remission after craniotomy and resection of brain lesions. The report suggests paclitaxel may be an active agent for chemotherapy-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma, including cases with brain involvement.

pmid-8626104.summary_ja: 妊娠31週の32歳初産婦が、妊娠性絨毛癌の脳転移による大発作で発症した。化学療法により治療に成功し、母体と児はともに生存した。妊娠中に脳転移で発症し母子ともに救命された初めての報告とされる。治癒可能な疾患であるため、妊婦に非典型的な神経症状を認めた場合は転移性絨毛癌を念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-8626104.summary_en: A 32-year-old primigravida at 31 weeks of gestation presented with a grand mal seizure caused by cerebral metastases from gestational choriocarcinoma. She was successfully treated with chemotherapy, and both mother and child survived. The authors describe this as the first reported case of cerebral metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting during a viable pregnancy with survival of both. They emphasize that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in pregnant women with unusual neurological symptoms, since the disease is potentially curable.

pmid-8627820.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学および分子遺伝学的所見をまとめた総説である。大多数の症例にみられるi(12p)等染色体が中心的な特徴とされる。i(12p)を欠く腫瘍では、マスキングや余分な12p配列が報告されている。異数性化に続くi(12p)形成という発生モデルを提示し、関与遺伝子の同定は今後の課題とされる。
pmid-8627820.summary_en: This review summarizes cytogenetic and molecular findings in testicular germ cell tumors, including the i(12p) isochromosome that characterizes most cases. Tumors lacking i(12p) may show masking of this abnormality or extra 12p sequences on FISH and molecular analyses. The authors present a hypothetical model in which aneuploidization precedes i(12p) formation, and discuss how these findings might inform clinical, pathological, and basic research. The underlying genes remain largely undefined.

pmid-8629416.summary_ja: 36歳女性の左卵巣に生じた80mmの嚢胞性病変の症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診では脈絡叢細胞様の良性細胞集塊がみられた。切除により、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に隣接する上衣嚢胞と診断された。脳脊髄液の細胞診に不慣れな細胞検査士への注意喚起を目的としており、卵巣嚢胞性病変の診断上の落とし穴を示している。
pmid-8629416.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with an 80-mm left ovarian cystic lesion. Fine needle aspiration yielded clusters and rosettes of benign cells resembling choroid plexus cells. Surgical resection revealed an ependymal cyst adjacent to a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst). The authors report this rare entity of ovarian ependymal cysts to alert cytologists unfamiliar with cerebrospinal fluid cytopathology. The case highlights diagnostic pitfalls when evaluating cystic ovarian lesions.

pmid-8630281.summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍におけるp53遺伝子変異の有無を検討しました。胞状奇胎14例、侵入奇胎6例、絨毛癌8例、正常初期胎盤10例の計38検体で、エクソン5～8を直接シーケンスしましたが、変異は1例も認められませんでした。p53変異は稀か存在しないと考えられ、他の癌抑制遺伝子や異なる経路が関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-8630281.summary_en: This study examined whether mutations in the p53 tumour-suppressor gene occur in gestational trophoblastic tumours. Using amplification-based direct DNA sequencing, exons 5-8 were analysed in 14 hydatidiform moles, six invasive moles, eight choriocarcinomas, and ten normal early placentas. No mutations were detected in any of the 38 specimens. The authors conclude that p53 mutation is either absent or very rare in these tumours, suggesting that other tumour-suppressor genes or distinct pathways drive their malignant transformation.

pmid-8630961.summary_ja: 1981年から1994年に単施設でシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍51例を後方視的に検討しました。セミノーマ患者の無病生存率は94%と良好でした。非セミノーマでは、縦隔原発が後腹膜原発より予後不良でした。後腹膜腫瘍が精巣原発由来かどうかについても議論しています。
pmid-8630961.summary_en: This single-institution review analysed 51 adults with primary extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1981 and 1994. Thirty-five had nonseminomas and 16 pure seminomas, arising in the mediastinum and retroperitoneum. Seminoma patients had excellent survival, with 94% disease-free. Mediastinal nonseminomas fared worse than retroperitoneal ones. The authors question whether retroperitoneal tumors arise from occult testicular primaries, given metachronous testicular seminomas in three patients.

pmid-8631581.summary_ja: 1935年から1992年のコネチカット州のがん登録データを用いた記述疫学研究です。精巣がんの年齢調整発生率は3.5倍に増加し、セミノーマと非セミノーマともに若年成人で上昇しました。コホート効果が強く示唆され、今後も増加が続く可能性があります。既存の仮説だけでは十分に説明できず、リスク因子の大規模研究が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-8631581.summary_en: This descriptive epidemiological study of Connecticut cancer registry data from 1935 to 1992 shows that the age-adjusted incidence of testicular cancer rose 3.5-fold. Seminoma and nonseminoma rates have risen since the mid-1950s, most markedly in men aged 20-44 for seminoma and 15-34 for nonseminoma. Age-period-cohort modelling suggested a period effect for early seminoma increases but a strong birth-cohort effect for later cohorts. The authors argue the rise will likely continue and that proposed hypotheses cannot fully explain it, urging large analytical studies.

pmid-8632558.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に腫瘍マーカー上昇のみが認められた非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例に対し、初回化学療法の有効性を検討しています。16例はシスプラチン、4例はカルボプラチンによる治療を受けました。全例で腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、19例は無病生存を維持しました。後腹膜リンパ節郭清より化学療法が適切な選択肢と結論づけています。
pmid-8632558.summary_en: This study evaluated primary chemotherapy in 20 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors whose only evidence of disease after orchiectomy was elevated serum tumor markers. Most received cisplatin-based regimens, and tumor markers normalized in all patients. Nineteen of 20 remained disease-free for 18 to 116 months. The authors conclude that primary chemotherapy is a reasonable strategy in this biological-disease-only setting, rather than primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-8635143.summary_ja: 難治性または再発性の転移性胚細胞腫瘍54例に対し、シスプラチンとイホスファミドを基本とした救援VIP/VeIP療法を施行した報告です。完全寛解は44%で得られました。大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を併用した症例では無再発生存率が高い傾向を示しました。治癒率は約30%と推定され、無作為化試験による検証が必要とされています。
