The extragonadal trophoblastic origin was confirmed at autopsy, with hCG production and hCG-positive staining of tumor cells. Immunohistochemistry showed the tumor cells expressed epidermal growth factor (EGF) and its receptor. The authors suggest that EGF may act in an autocrine manner in primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, given its established roles in trophoblast proliferation and differentiation.

pmid-8575492.summary_ja: 精巣の低病期胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助療法の適応を、文献と施設データをもとに整理している。病期Iセミノーマには後腹膜への中等量照射が標準であり、病期IIセミノーマでは縦隔照射は廃止された。病期I非セミノーマには神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清と監視療法が標準とされ、高リスク例ではシスプラチン併用化学療法の2コース補助療法が検討されている。
pmid-8575492.summary_en: This review examines current indications for adjuvant therapy in low-stage testicular germ cell tumors, drawing on material from the National Cancer Institute in Milan and international papers. Moderate-dose retroperitoneal irradiation remains standard for stage I seminoma, while mediastinal irradiation has been abandoned in stage II seminoma. Nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and surveillance are standard for stage I nonseminoma, with two cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy under investigation for high-risk patients. Postoperative chemotherapy is mandatory only for bulky stage II nonseminoma.

pmid-8575738.summary_ja: 卵巣のストルマ性カルチノイドに高インスリン性低血糖と皮膚色素沈着を合併した症例を報告している。卵巣カルチノイドは神経ホルモンペプチドを発現しうるが、カルチノイド症候群以外の臨床症状はまれである。皮膚の色素沈着は腫瘍由来のα-MSHまたは類似ペプチドによると考えられている。この組み合わせを示した初めての報告とされる。
pmid-8575738.summary_en: This report describes a strumal carcinoid of the ovary associated with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia and cutaneous melanosis. The authors note that ovarian carcinoid tumors may express neurohormonal peptides, but clinical effects beyond carcinoid syndrome are rare, and non-islet cell tumors with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia are also uncommon. This is presented as the first recorded case of an ovarian strumal carcinoid with this combination. Skin hyperpigmentation is attributed to tumor-derived alpha-melanocyte stimulating hormone or a similar peptide.

pmid-8575740.summary_ja: 妊娠11週の胎盤に生じた上皮内絨毛癌の症例を報告している。5mmの腫瘍結節は栄養膜細胞の二相性増殖からなり、胎児成分は認められなかった。患者は掻爬後22か月で正常分娩し、無治療で32か月まで再発はみられなかった。絨毛癌が絨毛栄養膜に由来することを支持し、妊娠産物の詳細な顕微鏡的検索の重要性を強調している。
pmid-8575740.summary_en: A case of choriocarcinoma in situ arising in an 11-week gestational placenta is reported. Histology showed a 5 mm localized neoplastic trophoblastic nodule arising from stem villi and projecting into the intervillous space, composed of biphasic cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast, without fetal elements. The patient delivered a normal term infant 22 months after curettage and remained disease-free without therapy at 32 months. The findings support villous trophoblast as the origin of choriocarcinoma and emphasize thorough microscopic examination of products of conception.

pmid-8577967.summary_ja: 頭頸部の類皮嚢腫、類表皮嚢腫、奇形腫の画像と臨床像を比較している。類皮嚢腫と類表皮嚢腫は外胚葉由来の包含嚢胞であり、眼窩、頭蓋骨板間、頭蓋内などに生じうる。頭頸部奇形腫は胚細胞に由来する真の腫瘍で、複数の胚葉由来の組織を含む。乳児では未熟組織像を示しても生物学的に良性のことがあり、手術が第一選択で根治も期待できる。
pmid-8577967.summary_en: This review compares dermoids, epidermoids, and craniofacial teratomas of the head and neck. Dermoids and epidermoids are ectoderm-lined inclusion cysts, with dermoids containing adnexal structures, and they may occur in the orbit, diploic space, or intracranially. Craniofacial teratomas are true neoplasms derived from misplaced germ cells, containing tissues from multiple germ layers. They may present prenatally, at delivery, or postnatally with life-threatening mass effect. Although immature histology can occur, infant teratomas may be biologically benign. Surgery is the treatment of choice and may be curative.

pmid-8578983.summary_ja: 36歳男性で右精巣の無痛性腫大から純粋セミノーマと診断され、右鼡径精巣摘除術を施行。大動脈傍リンパ節腫大を認め、後腹膜転移に放射線療法を行い完全寛解が得られた。対側は停留精巣で、固定術後のMRSA感染により摘除を要した。
pmid-8578983.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with a right testicular mass was diagnosed with pure seminoma and underwent right inguinal orchiectomy. Imaging showed para-aortic lymphadenopathy, and the contralateral testis was undescended. Left orchiopexy was complicated by MRSA infection, requiring removal of the left testis. Radiation therapy to retroperitoneal metastatic nodes achieved complete remission. Pathology of the undescended testis showed germ cell atrophy without atypia.

pmid-8578991.summary_ja: 48歳男性で左腎細胞癌に対し根治的腎摘除術を施行後、左精巣腫大とhCGβ上昇を認め、根治的精巣摘除術を実施。未分化セミノーマ、臨床病期I。術後8か月無病。腎細胞癌が先行して発症した異時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初例と報告。
pmid-8578991.summary_en: A 48-year-old man with clear cell renal cell carcinoma underwent radical nephrectomy. During follow-up, a left testicular induration and elevated serum hCG beta subunit prompted radical orchiectomy. Pathology showed anaplastic seminoma confined to the testis, with clinical stage I disease and no retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. He remained disease-free at 8 months. The authors review 15 prior reported cases of this double cancer and note this is the first with renal cell carcinoma preceding testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-8579273.summary_ja: 生後1日の乳児で鼻尖部の先天性奇形腫を超音波検査により確認し、生後1日目に摘出。開いた上外側軟骨と下外側軟骨を一次的に縫合し、余剰皮膚は二期的に切除した。頭蓋顔面領域の先天性奇形腫は稀であり、鼻尖部奇形腫の初報告例である。
pmid-8579273.summary_en: An infant with a congenital teratoma at the nasal tip was identified by ultrasonography. The tumor was excised on day 1 of life, with primary apposition of the splayed upper and lower lateral cartilages. Redundant skin was removed in a second-stage procedure. The authors report this as the first described nasal tip teratoma, noting that congenital teratoma rarely occurs in the craniofacial region.

pmid-8583324.summary_ja: 在胎33週で出生した乳児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫（2,420g）に対し、静脈動脈ECMOと低体温低灌流法を併用して切除した。脱管後に頸動脈を端々吻合で再建し、出血量は550mLであった。ECMOは乳児の巨大腫瘍切除における一時的な心肺補助として有用かつ安全と結論づけている。
pmid-8583324.summary_en: A 33-week-gestation infant with a massive sacrococcygeal teratoma underwent resection using venoarterial ECMO combined with hypothermic hypoperfusion. The 2,420 g tumor was removed, and the carotid artery was reconstructed end-to-end after decannulation. Blood loss was 550 mL, and the infant recovered well with normal head ultrasonography at follow-up. The authors conclude ECMO is useful and safe for temporary cardiopulmonary support during resection of massive infant tumors.

pmid-8586515.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の30例に対し、サーベイランス、大動脈傍・同側骨盤リンパ節への放射線療法、化学療法（4コース）を病期に応じて組み合わせた。完全寛解は90%。中央値41.5か月の観察で27例が無病生存、2例死亡、1例は縦隔リンパ節腫大を残し生存。
pmid-8586515.summary_en: Thirty consecutive patients with germinal testis tumours were treated with a combined-modality approach: seven in surveillance, seven with radiotherapy to para-aortic and ipsilateral pelvic nodes, and sixteen receiving four courses of chemotherapy, with five undergoing residual mass resection. Complete remission was achieved in 90%. After median follow-up of 41.5 months, 27 patients remain disease-free, two died, and one is alive with enlarged mediastinal nodes.

pmid-8588272.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に、腫瘍マーカーが正常化しているにもかかわらず成熟奇形腫を含む後腹膜転移巣が増大する growing teratoma syndrome の3症例を報告する。外科的切除が治療の第一選択であり、6〜26か月のフォローアップで全例が無病生存している。
pmid-8588272.summary_en: Growing teratoma syndrome, in which metastatic masses containing mature teratoma enlarge during or after chemotherapy despite normalized tumor markers, is described in three patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. All metastases were retroperitoneal. Surgical resection was the treatment of choice, and all patients remained alive without disease at 6 to 26 months of follow-up.

pmid-8590362.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者で、絨毛癌と侵入奇胎を術前に鑑別するための改変診断スコアリングシステムをベトナムで評価した。後方視的解析122例と前向き解析151例で、JSOG法と比較した。改変法は絨毛癌に対する特異度が94.2%と高く、鑑別診断に有用であった。
pmid-8590362.summary_en: A Vietnamese clinical study evaluated a modified scoring system to preoperatively distinguish choriocarcinoma from invasive mole in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. A retrospective analysis of 122 patients was followed by a prospective evaluation of 151 surgical patients, comparing the JSOG system with the modified TUDU hospital system. The modified system showed high specificity (94.2%) for choriocarcinoma and a low false-negative rate, supporting its diagnostic value.

pmid-8592316.summary_ja: 妊娠15週の女性が敗血症性ショックを呈し、膿瘍が疑われる複雑な骨盤内腫瘤を認めた。開腹ではなく腹腔鏡下に類皮嚢腫を摘出し、血液培養で腸チフスと判明して抗菌薬で回復した。妊娠中の腹腔鏡手術の診断・治療における有用性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-8592316.summary_en: A pregnant woman at 15 4/7 weeks developed septic shock with a complex pelvic mass suspicious for abscess. A dermoid cyst was removed laparoscopically rather than by laparotomy, and blood cultures later revealed typhoid fever, to which she responded to antibiotics. She was discharged on postoperative day 10. The case supports laparoscopy during pregnancy for both diagnosis and treatment when performed with modern equipment.

pmid-8595132.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株4種で古典的HLAクラスIおよびHLA-Gの発現を解析した。NUC1とSCHは古典的クラスIを発現したがHLA-Gは発現せず、クラスI調節エレメントに結合する核内蛋白が確認された。インターフェロンγはNUC1でクラスI発現とその結合を増強した。
pmid-8595132.summary_en: Four choriocarcinoma cell lines were examined for classical HLA class I and HLA-G expression. NUC1 and SCH expressed classical class I but not HLA-G, while GCH1 and Jar expressed neither. Nuclear proteins binding the class I regulatory element were detected in NUC1 and SCH, and interferon-gamma enhanced both expression and binding in NUC1. The element contributes to classical HLA class I gene control in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-8597832.summary_ja: 生後8週の女児に発生した胃奇形腫を完全切除し、補助療法なしで1年後も無再発であった。3年後にホジキン病を発症し、両腫瘍の関連として初の報告と考えられる。胃奇形腫は稀で、女児新生児例としては4例目である。
pmid-8597832.summary_en: A gastric teratoma presenting as an exophytic tumor in an 8-week-old girl was completely excised, and she remained free of recurrence at one year without adjuvant treatment. Three years later she developed Hodgkin's disease, which the authors believe is the first recorded association between these tumors. Gastric teratomas are rare, and this is only the fourth such tumor in a female neonate.

pmid-8600080.summary_ja: 性交経験のない70歳女性の子宮内膜腺癌で、絨毛癌成分との融合像を示した症例報告である。免疫組織化学では、合胞体栄養膜細胞様および細胞性栄養膜細胞様の細胞と、一部の腺癌細胞にhCGの発現が認められた。類似の既報例を検討し、腫瘍の二重分化の機序と組織発生について考察している。
pmid-8600080.summary_en: A 70-year-old woman with no history of sexual intercourse had endometrial adenocarcinoma that merged with a choriocarcinomatous component. Immunohistochemistry showed hCG expression in syncytiotrophoblast-like and cytotrophoblast-like cells and in rare adenocarcinoma cells, supporting dual differentiation. The authors review similar previously reported cases and discuss the mechanisms of dual differentiation in tumors and their histogenesis.

pmid-8601523.summary_ja: 正常絨毛、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌におけるp53の免疫組織化学的発現を比較した研究である。p53は妊娠性絨毛癌と胞状奇胎で主に細胞性栄養膜細胞に発現し、合胞体栄養膜細胞は概ね陰性であった。完全胞状奇胎は部分胞状奇胎より発現が強く、増殖活性の高さを反映すると考えられた。p53発現は増殖を示すものであり悪性を示すものではないため、解釈には注意が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-8601523.summary_en: This study examined p53 immunohistochemical expression in normal trophoblasts, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and gestational choriocarcinoma. p53 was frequently expressed in gestational choriocarcinoma and in moles, mainly in cytotrophoblasts, while syncytiotrophoblasts were generally spared. Complete moles showed greater expression than partial moles, consistent with higher proliferative activity. p53 was also seen in normal trophoblasts, secretory endometrial glands, and decidua. The authors conclude that p53 expression reflects proliferation rather than malignancy and urge caution in its interpretation.

pmid-8607359.summary_ja: 1978年から1993年に単施設で診断された小児の腹部奇形腫17例の後方視的検討である。大半は後腹膜に発生し、胃奇形腫と停留精巣由来の1例を含んだ。主訴は腹部腫瘤と腹部膨満で、全例で切除が行われ、病理学的には良性であった。超音波検査は局在診断と診断に有用であり、稀ながら再発の可能性があるため長期フォローアップが必要と述べている。
pmid-8607359.summary_en: A retrospective review of 17 children with abdominal teratoma diagnosed at a single hospital from 1978 to 1993. Most tumors were retroperitoneal, with one gastric teratoma and one arising from an undescended testis. Presenting features were an abdominal mass and distention. All were resected, pathology was benign, and surgery was curative for most. One patient died suddenly the day after surgery. Ultrasonography helped localize and diagnose the tumors. The authors emphasize that long-term follow-up is necessary because recurrence, though rare, can occur.

pmid-8610772.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびBeWoに対するタキソールの抗増殖効果を検討した基礎研究である。1〜3 nmol/Lで増殖が50%抑制され、hCG分泌の増加と合胞体栄養膜様細胞への分化が認められた。エトポシドやメトトレキサートとの併用では拮抗的な増殖抑制を示した。難治性疾患での臨床試験に値すると結論づけている。
pmid-8610772.summary_en: This study tested Taxol (paclitaxel) on the human choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and BeWo. Taxol inhibited proliferation in a dose-related manner, with 1 to 3 nmol/L producing 50% growth reduction, and increased hCG secretion and syncytiotrophoblast-like differentiation. Combining Taxol with etoposide or methotrexate produced antagonistic growth inhibition. The authors conclude that Taxol is highly effective in choriocarcinoma cells and warrants clinical trials in refractory disease, while other agents should be evaluated for combination therapy.

pmid-8617580.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の進行性胚細胞腫瘍患者15例を対象としたトポテカンの第II相試験である。評価可能であった14例では完全奏効・部分奏効はみられなかった。主な毒性は骨髄抑制であった。最低白血球数の中央値は1.75/mm3、好中球数は1.55/mm3、血小板は20,500/mm3であった。トポテカンはシスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対して有効でないと結論づけている。
pmid-8617580.summary_en: A phase II trial of topotecan in 15 patients with advanced, cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. Of the 14 evaluable patients, none achieved a complete or partial response. Myelosuppression was the main toxicity, with median nadir leukocyte count 1.75 cells/mm3, neutrophil count 1.55 cells/mm3, hemoglobin 8.75 g/dl, and platelets 20,500 cells/mm3. The authors conclude that topotecan is not efficacious in the treatment of cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors.

pmid-8625105.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍22例におけるp53の異常を検討した。免疫組織化学では過剰発現はほとんど認められず、未熟奇形腫1例と卵黄嚢腫瘍2例で、一部の癌細胞に限局した核染色がみられた。凍結組織9例のSSCP解析および陽性例の塩基配列解析でも変異は検出されなかった。p53の変化は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に関与しない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8625105.summary_en: This study assessed p53 alterations in 22 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Immunohistochemistry showed no overexpression in most tumors, with only focal nuclear staining in a few cases, including one immature teratoma and two yolk sac tumors, in under 10% of malignant cells. SSCP analysis of exons 4-9 in nine frozen tumors detected no mutations, and direct sequencing of three focally positive tumors also found none. The authors conclude that p53 alteration may not be involved in ovarian germ cell tumor pathogenesis, suggesting other tumor suppressor or oncogene changes should be explored.

pmid-8625206.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術の検体からセミノーマの糖脂質組成を解析し、病期I非転移例、病期Iの再発例、病期II例で比較した。ガラクトシルグロボシド(Gb5)は非転移例12例すべてで検出され、転移例5例ではすべて欠如していた。Gb5の有無は転移能と相関し、特に病期Iのセミノーマの予後推定に有用である可能性が示された。症例数は少ない。
pmid-8625206.summary_en: This study analyzed glycosphingolipid composition in orchiectomy specimens of seminoma, comparing Stage I patients without metastasis, Stage I patients with later metastatic relapse, and Stage II patients with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis, after 44 months of follow-up. Galactosylgloboside (Gb5) was present in all 12 nonmetastatic seminomas but absent in all five metastatic seminomas. The authors conclude that Gb5 status correlates with metastatic potential and may aid prognostic estimation in seminoma, particularly for Stage I disease. Sample sizes were small.

pmid-8635004.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(胞状奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌)について、過去5年間の診断と治療の進歩をまとめたレビューである。完全奇胎と部分奇胎の分類、奇胎後のhCGフォローアップによる持続性腫瘍の早期発見の重要性を示した。高リスク転移性病変では、3剤併用療法からエトポシドを含む5剤併用療法へ移行し、寛解率は約50%から約70%に向上した。
pmid-8635004.summary_en: This review summarizes advances in gestational trophoblastic disease, including molar pregnancy, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and choriocarcinoma. It describes histopathologic and karyotypic classification of complete and partial moles and the importance of postmolar hCG follow-up for detecting persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor. For high-risk metastatic disease, it notes a shift from triple therapy with methotrexate, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide to a five-drug regimen including etoposide and vincristine. Remission rates improved from about 50% to 70%. The authors conclude that patients can anticipate normal reproductive function.

pmid-8644359.summary_ja: 直腸後部に発生した悪性奇形腫が、感染性の肛門周囲瘻として初発した症例報告である。仙骨前腔に生じる稀な腫瘍で、本症例は腹会陰式直腸切断術で治療された。慢性の肛門周囲瘻の背景に胚細胞腫瘍が潜むことがあり、同様の症状を示す患者ではこの診断を念頭に置く必要があると示された。
pmid-8644359.summary_en: This case report describes a malignant retrorectal teratoma that presented as an infected perianal sinus. Retrorectal teratomas are rare tumours arising in the presacral space, and the malignant form is uncommon. The patient was treated with abdominoperineal resection. The report highlights that a chronic infected perianal sinus may be the initial manifestation of an underlying presacral germ cell tumour, so clinicians should consider this diagnosis in such presentations.

pmid-8650748.summary_ja: 40歳のインド人女性で、性交後出血と陰性の子宮頸部細胞診を呈した原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告である。3年前の掻爬術後に絨毛細胞が子宮頸部へ着床し、その後悪性転化した可能性が考察されている。生殖年齢女性の不正出血では絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げ、早期のβ-hCG測定で診断と早期治療につなげるべきと強調されている。
pmid-8650748.summary_en: This report describes a 40-year-old Indian woman with primary cervical choriocarcinoma presenting with postcoital bleeding and negative cervical cytology. The authors propose that trophoblasts may have implanted in the cervix after a dilatation and curettage performed three years earlier, followed by malignant transformation, although a cervical pregnancy origin is also possible. They emphasize considering choriocarcinoma in women of reproductive age with abnormal bleeding, and note that a timely beta-hCG assay can confirm the diagnosis and enable early treatment.

pmid-8652247.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ患者42例を対象とした前向き第II相試験で、カルボプラチンとイホスファミドによる併用化学療法と選択的統合療法の有効性と有害事象を評価した。化学療法単独で71%が完全奏効し、統合療法を加えると91%が中央値35か月の観察で寛解を維持した。腎毒性や神経毒性は認められず、安全かつ有効な治療と結論づけられた。
pmid-8652247.summary_en: This prospective phase II study evaluated carboplatin and ifosfamide combination chemotherapy with selective consolidation in 42 evaluable patients with advanced seminoma. Complete remission was achieved in 71% after chemotherapy alone and in 24% after chemotherapy plus consolidation, and 91% remained in remission at a median follow-up of 35 months. No nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, ototoxicity, or haemorrhagic cystitis occurred. Some patients required transfusions for haematologic toxicity. The authors concluded that the regimen is safe and effective for advanced seminoma.

pmid-8652248.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に1年以上寛解を維持した精巣がん患者90例で、遅発性の血管毒性を評価した。37%にレイノー現象が出現し、ブレオマイシンの累積投与量やPVB療法が危険因子として同定された。心筋梗塞の発症例や拡張期血圧の上昇も認められ、生存者の長期フォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-8652248.summary_en: This study evaluated late vascular toxicity in 90 patients who had remained in complete remission for over one year after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular cancer. Raynaud's phenomenon developed in 37%, with cumulative bleomycin dose and use of bleomycin with vinblastine (PVB) identified as risk factors compared with etoposide-containing PEB. Two patients had myocardial infarction, and several had increased diastolic blood pressure. The authors conclude that Raynaud's phenomenon is the main late vascular toxicity and recommend prospective long-term follow-up of survivors.

pmid-8652249.summary_ja: 血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)のコンカナバリンA結合率により、胚細胞腫瘍由来と肝疾患由来のAFPを鑑別できるかを検討した。218検体の解析で、結合率15%をカットオフとすると感度98%、特異度100%で区別できた。フォローアップ中に軽度のAFP上昇がみられた際、腫瘍によるものか化学療法による肝障害を含む肝機能障害によるものかの判断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-8652249.summary_en: The authors assessed whether the concanavalin A (ConA) binding ratio of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) can distinguish AFP produced by germ cell tumours from that produced by liver disease. In 218 serum samples from GCT patients and patients with liver disease, a 15% ConA binding cut-off achieved 98% sensitivity and 100% specificity. The index may help determine whether a slight AFP rise during follow-up reflects tumour activity or liver dysfunction, including chemotherapy hepatotoxicity.

pmid-8655925.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌に伴う男性化徴候を呈し、剖検で確認された2例を報告する。両例ともhCGとテストステロンが高値で、卵巣には黄体化莢膜細胞と黄体細胞の過形成が認められた。化学療法と放射線療法を行ったが、いずれも死亡した。長期間のhCG刺激が莢膜細胞過形成を起こし、高テストステロン血症と男性化をもたらすと考察されている。
pmid-8655925.summary_en: Two autopsy-proven cases of virilization associated with metastatic choriocarcinoma are reported. Both women had markedly elevated hCG and testosterone, and autopsy showed luteinized theca cell and lutein cell hyperplasia in the ovaries. Both patients died despite chemotherapy and radiation therapy. The authors propose that prolonged hCG stimulation of the ovary causes theca cell hyperplasia, leading to hypertestosteronemia and virilization. The report highlights an unusual endocrine complication of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8669858.summary_ja: 原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍18例(セミノーマ8例、非セミノーマ10例)の臨床的検討である。好発部位は縦隔と後腹膜で、松果体に発生した症例も1例含まれる。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた17例中15例(83%)が完全寛解に至り、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は65%だった。部位や組織型による生存率の有意差は認められなかった。
pmid-8669858.summary_en: This clinical study examines 18 patients with primary extragonadal germ cell tumours, comprising eight seminomas and ten non-seminomas. Sites included the mediastinum, retroperitoneum, multiple lymph node sites, and pineal gland in one case. Seventeen patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy as initial treatment, and 83% achieved complete remission. Twelve of the responders remained relapse-free at a median follow-up of 82 months. Five-year overall survival was 65%, with no significant difference between mediastinal and retroperitoneal tumours or between seminoma and nonseminoma.

pmid-8674568.summary_ja: ハンガリーの大学病院で10年間に経験した小児・思春期の卵巣悪性腫瘍16例を後方視的に検討した。胚細胞腫瘍が11例を占め、内訳はディスジャーミノーマ6例、奇形腫4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例であった。温存手術に補助化学療法を併用することが推奨され、生存は腫瘍型と診断時の病期に大きく依存すると結論づけられた。
pmid-8674568.summary_en: A retrospective review of 16 malignant ovarian tumours in childhood and adolescence was conducted at a Hungarian university hospital over ten years. Eleven were germ cell tumours (six dysgerminomas, four teratomas, one endodermal sinus tumour), while the others included three epithelial tumours, one granulosa cell tumour, and one metastatic ovarian cancer. The authors recommend conservative surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, and note that survival depends mainly on tumour type and stage at diagnosis.

pmid-8687206.summary_ja: ナイジェリアのザリアで19年間に経験した仙尾部奇形腫の小児47例を後方視的に検討した。女児38例、男児9例で、大半(40例)がI型であり、60%は生後3か月以降に受診した。全例が入院後早期に手術を受け、1歳以上の症例では4例が悪性であった。
pmid-8687206.summary_en: This retrospective review describes 47 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma seen in Zaria, Nigeria, over 19 years, comprising 38 girls and 9 boys aged from 1 day to 5 years. Most tumours were type I (40 cases), and 60% presented after three months of age. All patients underwent surgery soon after admission. Four tumours in children over one year of age were malignant. The report describes the clinical presentation and classification of sacrococcygeal teratoma in a regional African paediatric setting.

pmid-8696173.summary_ja: 46XY核型を有する16歳の表現型女性の症例報告です。異形成性性腺の右側に性腺芽腫、左側に絨毛癌が発生していました。両腫瘍は同一の性腺内では共存していませんでした。細胞遺伝学的所見が判明した時点での両側性腺摘除の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-8696173.summary_en: A 16-year-old phenotypic female with a 46XY karyotype and dysgenetic gonads is described. The right gonad contained a gonadoblastoma and the left gonad a choriocarcinoma, and the two tumor cell types did not coexist in the same gonad. The authors emphasize that bilateral gonadectomy should be performed in 46XY females as soon as the cytogenetic findings are known. This is a rare association because choriocarcinoma is seldom seen in dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-8717221.summary_ja: 30歳男性の原発性後腹膜純粋絨毛癌の症例報告です。鎖骨上リンパ節生検で純粋絨毛癌と診断され、血清hCGβは700 ng/mlでした。VIP療法とBEP療法を行いましたが部分奏効にとどまりました。残存腫瘤の外科的切除後、術後15か月無病生存しています。強力な化学療法と積極的な残存腫瘤切除が推奨されています。
pmid-8717221.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with a supraclavicular lymph node biopsy showing pure choriocarcinoma, with multiple lung and mediastinal tumors and two retroperitoneal masses. Serum beta-hCG was 700 ng/ml with normal AFP, establishing primary retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma. He received two cycles of VIP followed by two cycles of BEP, with only partial response. Surgical resection of residual masses showed necrotic fibrous tissue, and he remained disease-free 15 months later. Intensive chemotherapy with aggressive residual resection is recommended.

pmid-8719847.summary_ja: 上皮内癌（CIS）、CISに伴う浸潤、浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍を有する症例と対照群の精巣における単核細胞浸潤の頻度を比較した研究です。浸潤は悪性変化の程度とともに増加し、悪性細胞のない対側精巣にも認められました。生後1年未満の乳児では高頻度でした。単核細胞浸潤と胚細胞腫瘍の関連が示唆されています。
pmid-8719847.summary_en: Mononuclear cell infiltrates were compared in testes from 45 men with carcinoma in situ alone, CIS with early or invasive germ cell tumor, 100 men dying suddenly, 146 boys, and 100 infertility patients. Infiltration increased with the severity of malignant change and was also seen in contralateral testes without malignant cells. It was frequent in testes of infants under one year old. The findings suggest an association between mononuclear cell infiltration and germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-8739731.summary_ja: 胎児が生存している状態で併存する妊娠性絨毛性疾患について、新たな分類を提示した。良性の胞状奇胎を初期段階、悪性度の高い絨毛癌を最終段階とする疾患連続体として捉えている。生存胎児を伴う妊娠における絨毛性疾患のスペクトラムを論じている。
pmid-8739731.summary_en: This study introduces a new classification of gestational trophoblastic disease coexisting with a living fetus or fetuses, termed sad fetus syndrome. Benign hydatid mole is the initial stage and highly malignant choriocarcinoma the final stage of this disease continuum. The authors propose that these categories represent a spectrum of trophoblastic disease within pregnancies that continue alongside a living fetus.

pmid-8747790.summary_ja: 分化マーカーであるプラスミノーゲンアクチベーター産生を指標に、各種キレート剤による胎児性癌F9細胞の分化誘導を検討した。ヒノキチオールとトロポロンは強力な誘導因子だったが、Fe2+およびFe3+との前処理で活性を失った。ジチゾンも分化を誘導したが、これもFe3+により阻害された。
pmid-8747790.summary_en: This study tested whether iron chelators induce differentiation of embryonal carcinoma F9 cells, using plasminogen activator production as a marker. Hinokitiol and tropolone were potent inducers, but their activity was lost after preincubation with Fe2+ or Fe3+ ions. Dithizone also induced differentiation, and this was inhibited by Fe3+. The authors conclude that intracellular iron chelation can trigger differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-8747942.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマ患者101例に対する低線量放射線療法の早期成績を報告する。総線量は30、25.5、20Gyで、標的体積は段階的に縮小された。低線量かつ小照射野で良好な生存率と再発のない生存が得られたが、悪心はより多く認められた。
pmid-8747942.summary_en: This study reports early outcomes of low-dose radiotherapy in 101 patients with stage I seminoma. Total doses of 30, 25.5, or 20 Gy were delivered to progressively smaller target volumes, moving from paraaortic, pelvic, and inguinal fields to paraaortic only. Low doses and smaller fields achieved excellent survival and freedom from recurrence, although nausea was more frequent.

pmid-8749714.summary_ja: レチノイン酸による胎児性癌P19細胞の分化誘導時のタンパク質合成とeIF-4Eリン酸化を検討した。添加後1時間以内にタンパク質合成は増加したが、eIF-4Eのリン酸化は変化しなかった。EGF誘導性のリン酸化はホスファターゼ活性により制御されていると考えられた。
pmid-8749714.summary_en: This study examined protein synthesis and eIF-4E phosphorylation during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Protein synthesis rose within an hour of retinoic acid treatment, yet eIF-4E phosphorylation remained unchanged. EGF-induced eIF-4E phosphorylation was present in P19 cells and appeared regulated by phosphatase activity. The authors conclude that differentiation-associated protein synthesis changes occur independently of eIF-4E phosphorylation.

pmid-8750131.summary_ja: 若年男性が急性肺塞栓症として入院したが、左室不全を伴わない局所性肺水腫を呈していた。原因は精巣絨毛癌による腫瘍性肺塞栓と、下大静脈の圧迫・血栓形成に伴う肺血栓塞栓症であった。希少な胚細胞腫瘍が心肺系の救急症状として発見された症例である。
pmid-8750131.summary_en: A young man was admitted with acute pulmonary embolism that presented as focal pulmonary edema without left ventricular failure. The cause was a testicular choriocarcinoma that involved the venous system, producing neoplastic pulmonary embolism. The tumor also compressed the inferior vena cava and caused thrombosis, leading to pulmonary thromboembolism. The report highlights two unusual features: localized pulmonary edema from pulmonary embolism, and neoplastic pulmonary embolism from a testicular germ cell tumor. It illustrates how a rare choriocarcinoma can first present as a cardiopulmonary emergency.

pmid-8750297.summary_ja: 妊娠23週で胎児仙尾部奇形腫が出生前超音波検査により診断された症例報告である。腫瘍により下部および上部尿路の拡張と急性膀胱拡張が生じた。胎児奇形腫では、繰り返し超音波評価を行うことの重要性が指摘されている。
pmid-8750297.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of a sacrococcygeal teratoma at 23 weeks of gestation. The tumor caused dilatation of both the lower and upper urinary tracts, including acute bladder distension. The authors stress that fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma need repeated serial ultrasonographic evaluation, since urinary tract complications may develop or progress between scans. The report is relevant to prenatal diagnosis and fetal management of this germ cell tumor.

pmid-8771152.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞PCC4 AZArLを用い、N,N-ジメチルアセトアミド(DMA)による分化誘導を培養系とマウス腫瘍モデルで検討した。DMAは神経上皮への分化を誘導したが、レチノイン酸より効果は弱く、肝臓やリンパ組織への毒性が用量を制限した。分化療法として標準療法の補助になる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8771152.summary_en: Researchers tested whether the polar solvent N,N-dimethyl acetamide (DMA) can induce differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells, first in culture using PCC4 AZArL cells and then in tumors grown in 129 mice. In vitro, a dose range of 0.1% to 0.15% produced a dose-dependent increase in differentiation. In vivo, DMA promoted differentiation mainly toward neuroepithelium, though less effectively than retinoic acid. Toxicity, mainly to liver and lymphoid tissue, limited the maximal dose. The authors suggest DMA-based differentiation therapy could be an adjunct to standard treatment.

pmid-8772822.summary_ja: 20歳女性の卵管外妊娠後に発生した卵管原発の妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告である。従来型の化学療法レジメンにより良好な治療反応を示した。卵管に生じる妊娠性絨毛癌は稀であり、標準的化学療法の有効性を示す症例である。
pmid-8772822.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma of the fallopian tube in a 20-year-old woman who presented after an ectopic tubal pregnancy. The tumor developed as a complication of the tubal pregnancy. The patient was treated with a conventional chemotherapy regimen and responded well. The report is notable because gestational choriocarcinoma arising in the fallopian tube is rare. It documents a favorable outcome with standard chemotherapy.

pmid-8804457.summary_ja: 若年男性が眼窩腫瘤と血清CEA、CA 19-9、CA50の著明な上昇を呈した。当初は低分化癌の転移と考えられたが、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍症候群を疑い胚細胞腫瘍として治療された。残存腫瘍の切除標本で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)免疫染色により胎児性癌と診断された。眼窩という稀な発生部位と消化器系腫瘍マーカーの上昇、そのマーカーの有用性について考察している。
pmid-8804457.summary_en: A young man presented with an orbital mass and markedly elevated serum CEA, CA 19-9 and CA50, initially suspected to be metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma. Suspecting extragonadal germ-cell cancer syndrome, the clinicians treated him as a germ-cell tumor. Resection of the residual orbital mass showed embryonal carcinoma by alpha-fetoprotein immunoperoxidase staining. The authors discuss the unusual orbital location, the marked elevation of gastrointestinal tumor markers, and the potential utility of these markers in such patients.

pmid-8808098.summary_ja: 30歳女性がGraves病と卵巣甲状腺腫の併存による甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した。CTで25cmの嚢胞性右卵巣腫瘤を認め、123Iシンチグラフィで左上腹部に集積を認めた。術前に抗甲状腺薬で治療後に手術が行われ、病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と確定した。卵巣甲状腺腫が甲状腺機能亢進を来しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-8808098.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman with coexisting Graves' disease and struma ovarii presented with hyperthyroidism and an abdominal mass. CT revealed a 25-cm predominantly cystic right ovarian mass, and iodine-123 scintigraphy showed intense uptake in the left upper abdomen. Preoperative antithyroid treatment preceded surgery, and pathology confirmed struma ovarii. The case illustrates how struma ovarii can cause thyrotoxicosis and complicate interpretation of thyroid-related uptake on scanning.

pmid-8815264.summary_ja: 22歳男性が健康診断の胸部X線で異常陰影を指摘された。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で後縦隔脂肪腫が疑われた。右開胸により腫瘍を摘出し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。縦隔奇形腫の頻度、成因、診断法について考察している。
pmid-8815264.summary_en: A 22-year-old man was found to have an abnormal shadow on a routine chest radiograph. Preoperative chest CT and MRI suggested a posterior mediastinal lipoma. Right thoracotomy resected the tumor completely, and histology revealed a mature teratoma. The authors review the incidence, etiology and diagnostic approach to mediastinal teratoma, emphasizing that imaging can mimic benign fatty tumors.

pmid-8819666.summary_ja: 妊娠と無関係に発生する極めて稀な悪性腫瘍、卵巣非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例を報告している。本腫瘍は単独でも、他の胚細胞腫瘍と併存しても発生しうる。本症例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴っており、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における絨毛癌成分の認識の重要性を示している。
pmid-8819666.summary_en: A case report describes nongestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary, an extremely rare malignant tumour that may occur alone or together with other germ cell tumours. The tumour coexisted with a mature cystic teratoma. The authors emphasize that this entity is rare and that clinicians and pathologists should recognize choriocarcinomatous components within ovarian germ cell neoplasms, because this can change management.

pmid-8821915.summary_ja: 25年間の単施設研究で原発性後腹膜腫瘍34例を解析した。胚細胞腫瘍が15例で最多であり、成熟奇形腫9例、未熟奇形腫2例、胎児性癌2例、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）2例を含む。残りは軟部組織腫瘍(主に肉腫)と神経芽腫などの交感神経系腫瘍であった。全体の70.6%が悪性腫瘍だった。
pmid-8821915.summary_en: This 25-year single-institution study analyzed 34 primary retroperitoneal tumours. Fifteen were germ cell tumours, including nine mature teratomas, two immature teratomas, two embryonal carcinomas and two dysgerminomas. The remaining cases comprised soft tissue tumours, mostly sarcomas, and sympathetic nervous system tumours such as neuroblastoma. About seventy percent of all retroperitoneal tumours were malignant, and germ cell tumours formed the largest histologic group.

pmid-8822330.summary_ja: 胎児水腫に対する胎児手術を総説し、死亡率の高い本疾患の病態と手術適応を検討している。対象は胎児胸部病変と仙尾部奇形腫の二つである。出生前診断の進歩により、非免疫性水腫へ進行しうる異常を早期に診断できるようになり、胎児手術の対象となりうる。
pmid-8822330.summary_en: This review examines fetal surgery for hydrops fetalis, a condition of abnormal fluid accumulation and edema with high mortality. It focuses on the pathophysiology and rationale for surgical correction of two conditions: fetal thoracic lesions, such as congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation, pulmonary sequestration and pleural effusion, and sacrococcygeal teratoma. Advances in prenatal ultrasonography allow earlier diagnosis of anomalies that may progress to nonimmune hydrops and fetal demise, making them candidates for intervention.

pmid-8826925.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の多くは血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を高値に示し、診断と治療効果判定に用いられる。本研究では等電点電気泳動で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者9例のAFP変異体を、妊婦5例および肝細胞癌5例と比較した。胚細胞腫瘍では一貫した特異的なバンドパターンが認められ、治療中の総AFPと悪性由来AFPは並行して変化した。
pmid-8826925.summary_en: Many nonseminomatous germ cell tumors produce elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein, which is used for diagnosis and monitoring. This study used isoelectric focusing and immunoblotting to examine AFP variants in nine patients with nonseminomatous GCTs, five pregnant women and five patients with hepatocellular carcinoma. Patients with GCTs showed a consistent, distinct pattern of AFP bands, different from HCC and late pregnancy. Serial sampling showed that total and malignant AFP levels changed in parallel during treatment.

pmid-8838372.summary_ja: 若年女性で9年の間隔をおいて両側卵巣に成熟奇形腫が生じ、2回目の切除時に大網に腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた。免疫組織化学染色で、奇形腫と腹膜結節はグリア・神経マーカーを発現していた。マクロファージが栄養因子を放出し、神経成分の腹腔内着床と長期生存を助けると考察している。マクロファージが多いことが両部位で特徴的であった。未熟奇形腫由来のインプラントが成熟組織像を示す理由の説明にもなりうる。
pmid-8838372.summary_en: A young woman developed mature ovarian teratomas in both ovaries over nine years. The second tumor was accompanied by gliomatosis peritonei, with glial implants in the greater omentum. Immunohistochemistry showed glial (GFAP, vimentin), neuronal (NSE), and hematopoietic (CD68, CD20) markers in the teratoma and omental nodules, with macrophages prominent at both sites. The authors propose that macrophage-derived trophic factors allow neural elements of ovarian teratomas to implant in the peritoneum and survive for years, possibly explaining the mature histology of implants even when derived from immature teratomas.

pmid-8882547.summary_ja: 生後9か月の中国人女児が殿部の大きな腫瘤で受診し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が上昇していた。単純X線、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で充実性で不均一な仙骨前腫瘤を認めた。腹会陰式に切除され、仙尾部奇形腫と診断された。多剤併用化学療法に良好に反応した。画像診断の役割を中心に記載している。
pmid-8882547.summary_en: A nine-month-old Chinese girl presented with a large buttock mass and elevated serum AFP. Plain radiography, CT and MRI showed a solid, heterogeneous presacral mass. The tumor was excised via an abdominoperineal approach and diagnosed as sacrococcygeal teratoma. The patient responded well to multiagent chemotherapy. The report focuses on the imaging features of this pediatric germ cell tumor and the role of radiologic evaluation in its diagnosis and management.

pmid-8927432.summary_ja: 嚢胞性成熟奇形腫から発生したとみられる卵巣原発悪性黒色腫の稀な1例である。文献上の報告は8例のみである。転移性黒色腫や他の原発性卵巣腫瘍との鑑別が重要となる。免疫組織化学と超微細構造の検討により診断し、文献レビューを併せて報告している。奇形腫内の予期せぬメラニン細胞性変化にも注意が必要である。
pmid-8927432.summary_en: The authors report a rare primary malignant melanoma of the ovary, a tumour reported in only eight cases, each arising within a cystic mature teratoma. The lesion must be distinguished from metastatic melanoma and from other primary ovarian tumours. Using immunohistochemistry and ultrastructural examination, the authors characterised the tumour and reviewed the literature. The case highlights the need for careful pathological evaluation of ovarian teratomas showing unexpected melanocytic transformation, and the importance of excluding metastatic disease before diagnosing a primary ovarian melanoma.

pmid-8927576.summary_ja: 胎盤から発生した奇形腫の症例を報告し、既報16例を文献的に概観している。組織像、鑑別診断、発生機序を検討した。著者らは胎盤奇形腫を無形の胎児組織ではなく真の腫瘍と考えている。極めて稀な疾患であり、中国からの報告はこれまでにない。胎盤関連病変の理解に寄与する報告である。
pmid-8927576.summary_en: This report describes a case of teratoma arising from the placenta, a very rare entity. The authors review sixteen previously reported cases since Morville first described the condition in 1925, discussing histological features, differential diagnosis, and pathogenesis. They argue that placental teratoma is a true neoplasm rather than an amorphous fetal mass. The rarity of the condition is emphasised, and no case had previously been reported from China. The paper contributes to understanding this unusual placental lesion within the broader spectrum of placental-site and gestational disease.

pmid-8935151.summary_ja: 後腹膜腔に発生した悪性奇形腫の症例を報告する。成人の後腹膜奇形腫は稀で、良性と悪性があり、発生部位と異なる組織から構成される。1937年以降の既報39例と今回の症例を合わせた40例中、悪性は10例(25%)であった。成人後腹膜奇形腫の悪性度に関する知見を提供する。
pmid-8935151.summary_en: The authors present a case of malignant teratoma arising in the retroperitoneal space. Retroperitoneal teratomas are rare in adults and may be benign or malignant, composed of tissues foreign to the site of origin. A literature search identified 39 previously reported cases since 1937. Among the 40 cases including this one, only ten (25%) were malignant. The report adds to the limited literature on adult retroperitoneal teratomas and their malignant potential, and highlights how infrequent malignant transformation is at this site.

pmid-9050563.summary_ja: 右傍直腸および仙骨前部に発生した良性骨盤後腹膜類皮嚢腫の、腹腔鏡下摘出の初報とされる症例である。後腹膜腫瘍は稀でしばしば悪性となり、診断も難しい。医原性腸瘤の予防のため、腹腔鏡下縫合と修正McCall法による子宮直腸窩形成術を行った。慎重に選択された良性後腹膜腫瘍では腹腔鏡手術を考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-9050563.summary_en: The authors describe what they believe is the first laparoscopic removal of a benign pelvic retroperitoneal dermoid cyst, located in the right pararectal and presacral areas. Retroperitoneal tumours are rare, often malignant, and difficult to diagnose, with significant surgical morbidity. Iatrogenic enterocele was prevented by laparoscopic suturing and a modified McCall culdoplasty. The excellent outcome suggests that laparoscopic management should be considered for carefully selected benign retroperitoneal tumours. The report supports minimally invasive surgery for selected benign lesions in this unusual location.

pmid-9050607.summary_ja: 良性類皮嚢腫12例を腹腔鏡下に摘出した連続症例であり、全例で術中の内容物漏出があった。無菌性腹膜炎のリスクから腹腔鏡下摘出を避ける術者も多いが、本研究では術後に腹膜炎関連の合併症は認められなかった。十分な洗浄を行えば、術中漏出は合併症と関連しないと結論している。
pmid-9050607.summary_en: This series reports twelve benign dermoid cysts removed laparoscopically, with intraoperative spillage in every case. Spillage is often cited as a reason to avoid laparoscopic removal because of the risk of aseptic peritonitis, yet no patient developed peritonitis-related morbidity. The authors managed spillage with copious lavage and concluded that intraoperative spillage is not associated with morbidity provided vigorous lavage is performed. The findings support laparoscopic excision as a reasonable approach for benign dermoid cysts with appropriate intraoperative irrigation.

pmid-9118380.summary_ja: 精巣がんの病期分類について、胸部CTの必要性、低病期非セミノーマにおける腹部CTの後腹膜転移診断精度、原発巣の血管侵襲や胎児性癌成分割合の有用性を検討した1995年の報告。腹部CTは偽陰性率が高く、組織学的因子が病期予測に有用であることを示す。
pmid-9118380.summary_en: This 1995 review summarizes the authors' studies on staging testicular cancer. They asked whether chest CT is needed for all patients, how accurately contemporary abdominal CT detects retroperitoneal metastases in stage I nonseminoma, and whether primary tumor features can predict stage. Vascular invasion and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma predicted correct stage in 86% of patients, and a neural network improved this to 92%. The authors conclude that chest staging should depend on histology and retroperitoneal status, and that abdominal CT still misses microscopic metastases.

pmid-9457986.summary_ja: 性腺異形成症例に対する腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術の報告。男性偽半陰陽では、異形性性腺から性腺芽細胞腫やディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が生じうるため予防的摘出が広く行われ、腹腔鏡下手術が適切な管理法として提案されている。
pmid-9457986.summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic removal of gonads in a patient with gonadal dysgenesis. Prophylactic gonadectomy is widely accepted in male pseudohermaphroditism because dysgenetic gonads can undergo malignant change, including gonadoblastoma or dysgerminoma. The authors suggest that laparoscopic gonadectomy is the optimal management approach for patients with dysgenetic gonads. The abstract is brief and focuses on surgical technique and the rationale for risk-reducing surgery rather than on outcomes or long-term follow-up.

pmid-7477788.summary_ja: 原発性頭蓋内扁平上皮癌の2症例を報告。1例は右小脳橋角部の類表皮嚢腫の悪性転化、もう1例は中頭蓋窩の類皮嚢腫（初回切除の9年後）から発生した扁平上皮癌である。文献的考察と発生機序を検討。胚細胞由来の類皮嚢腫を母地とする点で、関連性は境界的。
pmid-7477788.summary_en: Two cases of primary intracranial squamous cell carcinoma are described. One arose through malignant transformation of a right cerebellopontine angle epidermoid cyst, and the other developed in a middle fossa dermoid cyst nine years after initial resection. The authors review the literature on this rare entity and discuss its pathogenesis. The dermoid cyst is a germ cell-derived lesion, so the paper is borderline for this site's scope because the tumor studied is a squamous carcinoma arising in intracranial cysts.

pmid-7493627.summary_ja: レチノイン酸による分化誘導中の胎児性癌細胞株PCC4.aza1Rで、トランスポゾン関連RNAであるEC-1を同定した研究。EC-1 mRNAはレチノイン酸により低下し、分化細胞では検出されなかった。マウスでは精巣に限局して発現し、RARシグナルを介して抑制される。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではなく、基礎的な細胞生物学研究である。
pmid-7493627.summary_en: This study used embryonal carcinoma PCC4.aza1R cells during retinoic acid-induced differentiation and identified a transposon-related transcript, EC-1. EC-1 mRNA declines with retinoic acid at concentrations as low as 0.1 nM and is absent in differentiated cells. It is also expressed in other embryonal carcinoma lines and embryonic stem cells, and in mouse tissues it is restricted to the testis. Repression depends on RAR activation. This is basic cell-biology research using cell lines as a model, with no clinical component.

pmid-7498571.summary_ja: 小児2例で、排液を伴う涙嚢粘液嚢腫様の症状を示した正中鼻内類皮嚢腫を報告。正中部の鼻皮膚陥凹が診断の手がかりとなり、脳瘤や神経膠腫などを伴うことがある。胚細胞腫瘍そのものではなく、稀な発生異常の報告である。
pmid-7498571.summary_en: This report describes two children with midline intranasal dermoid cysts that presented as discharging lacrimal sac mucoceles. The diagnosis of this rare condition was suggested by midline nasal cutaneous dimples. The authors note that such dimples may be associated with isolated anomalies such as nasal dermoid cyst, encephalocele, or glioma. The paper addresses a rare developmental anomaly rather than a germ cell tumor as such, so its relevance to the site is borderline.

pmid-7500436.summary_ja: 脂肪成分を含む高エコーの子宮脂肪性腫瘤が、経膣超音波で卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）と類似しうることを報告。3例で経腹超音波の併用が誤診回避に必要であった。主題は子宮病変であり、奇形腫は鑑別対象として扱われている。
pmid-7500436.summary_en: This report describes lipomatous uterine masses, which are hyperechoic pelvic tumors containing adipose tissue. On endovaginal ultrasound they can mimic ovarian dermoids, which are benign cystic teratomas. Distinguishing them depends on identifying the parent organ, which can be difficult endovaginally. Three patients are presented in whom transabdominal views were needed to avoid misdiagnosis. The primary subject is the uterine lesion, with ovarian teratoma serving as the mimic in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-7540549.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3と正常胎盤栄養膜細胞の核に、機能的なEGF受容体が存在することを示した基礎研究。核内EGF受容体はEGFに結合して自己リン酸化を起こし、核内蛋白のチロシンリン酸化を制御する。また、EGFは単離核においてhCG/LH受容体遺伝子の転写を抑制した。疾患そのものよりも栄養膜細胞の基礎生物学が主題である。
pmid-7540549.summary_en: The authors show that the JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell line and normal human placental trophoblasts express functional EGF receptors in their nuclei. Nuclear EGF receptors are 170-kDa proteins that bind EGF, autophosphorylate upon EGF stimulation, and regulate tyrosine phosphorylation of other nuclear proteins. EGF also suppresses hCG/LH receptor gene transcription in isolated nuclei. The findings suggest nuclear EGF receptors may mediate intracrine and paracrine actions regulating trophoblast function. The study is mainly basic cell biology rather than a study of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7543852.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9の2つのサブ株(F9-1、F9-2)のレチノイン酸(RA)への応答を比較した。F9-1ではより多くの受容体遺伝子がRAにより制御され、F9-2はRARγ1が高く、RXRγを欠いていた。両株のRA感受性の違いは受容体制御の差に由来すると考えられる。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞を用いた基礎的なレチノイド受容体研究である。
pmid-7543852.summary_en: This study compared two F9 embryonal carcinoma cell substrains, F9-1 and F9-2, in their response to retinoic acid. RA regulated more receptor and other genes in F9-1 than in F9-2. F9-2 expressed higher RAR gamma isoforms and lacked RXR gamma, and showed constitutive RARgamma binding to an RA-responsive element. These differences may explain the substrains' distinct RA sensitivity. The work is basic retinoid receptor biology using embryonal carcinoma cells as a model.

pmid-7558497.summary_ja: 腰部の長期間存在する類皮嚢腫に扁平上皮癌が悪性転化した症例を報告した。病変は6年間にわたりゆっくりと進行した。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化はきわめてまれであり、本部位での報告は過去にないとされる。
pmid-7558497.summary_en: This case report describes malignant transformation of a long-standing lumbar dermoid cyst into squamous cell carcinoma. The lesion progressed slowly over six years. The authors note that malignant transformation of a dermoid cyst is extremely uncommon and has not previously been recorded at this site.

pmid-7585674.summary_ja: 前頭骨の大泉門から離れた正中部に生じた類皮嚢腫の1例を報告した研究である。詳細な記載の少ない症例であり、頭蓋内への進展の可能性を考察し、関連文献を概説している。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫系の病変として扱われることがあるが、胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは限定的である。
pmid-7585674.summary_en: A case of a midline dermoid cyst of the frontal bone located away from the anterior fontanel is reported. The authors note that few such cases have been described in detail. They discuss possible intracranial extension of these lesions and review the relevant literature. The lesion arises in bone and scalp rather than primarily in the brain, and the dermoid cyst is the central subject of the report.

pmid-7594759.summary_ja: 口腔底の巨大な類皮嚢腫に対し、オトガイ下部の皮膚切開を避けて口腔内から到達する手術法を示した技術ノート。十分な術野を確保しつつ外表の瘢痕を回避できるとされる。胚細胞腫瘍の治療研究ではなく、良性の発生性嚢胞に関する外科的記載である。対象は類皮嚢腫の手術手技に限られる。
pmid-7594759.summary_en: This technical note describes an intraoral surgical approach for very large dermoid cysts involving both the floor of the mouth and the submental space. The method allows adequate exposure without an external skin incision in the submental fold, avoiding visible scarring. The paper is a short surgical description rather than a study of germ cell tumor biology or treatment. Its relevance to the site depends on whether oral dermoid cysts, which are mature teratoma-type lesions, fall within the germ cell tumor scope.

pmid-7611019.summary_ja: 耳管に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫の2例を報告する。反復性中耳炎と慢性耳漏を呈し、CTでは脂肪濃度の病変が耳管を充満・拡張していた。MRIでは脂肪信号を示し、内頸動脈との関係がCTより明瞭に描出された。組織学的には外胚葉および中胚葉成分の混在が認められた。
pmid-7611019.summary_en: Two patients with congenital dermoid cysts of the eustachian tube presented with recurrent otitis media and chronic otorrhea unresponsive to antibiotics. CT showed fat-density lesions filling and expanding the tube, and MR signal was consistent with fat and better delineated the relationship to the internal carotid artery. Histology revealed mixed ectodermal and mesodermal elements. The report illustrates imaging features of this rare head and neck lesion.

pmid-7611819.summary_ja: 不妊症の女性で、両側の卵管および正所性卵巣が欠如していた。精査により、大網内に類皮嚢腫を含む異所性卵巣が見つかった。本稀少な異常の成因と臨床的意義について考察している。異所性卵巣組織内の類皮嚢腫は、成熟奇形腫に相当する病変である。
pmid-7611819.summary_en: A woman with infertility was found to have absence of both fallopian tubes and ovaries in their normal positions. Careful search revealed an ectopic ovary containing a dermoid cyst located in the omentum. The authors discuss possible mechanisms and clinical significance of this rare anomaly. The dermoid component corresponds to a mature teratoma within ectopic ovarian tissue.

pmid-7637328.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌株NT2細胞を免疫不全マウスの脳や末梢組織に移植し、増殖・細胞死・分化を検討した。くも膜下腔や新皮質などでは急速に致死的な腫瘍を形成し、尾状核被殻では増殖を停止してニューロン様細胞へ分化した。移植部位が細胞の運命を決定することが示された。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、中枢神経系発生の研究モデルとしての報告である。
pmid-7637328.summary_en: This study transplanted the human embryonal carcinoma line NTera2 (NT2), which resembles neural progenitors, into the brains and peripheral tissues of immunodeficient mice. NT2 cells proliferated and formed lethal bulky tumors in the subarachnoid space, neocortex, lateral ventricles, liver, and muscle, whereas cells in the caudoputamen stopped proliferating and differentiated into neuron-like cells. The graft site thus determined proliferation, death, and differentiation. The model is proposed for studying CNS development rather than clinical germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-7698219.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を用い、レチノイン酸による壁側内胚葉分化の過程でインテグリンα6β1の発現と機能を調べた基礎研究です。α6タンパク質は分化に伴い減少する一方、mRNA量は一定であり、転写後調節が示唆されました。α6Aとα6Bのアイソフォームの切り替えは細胞運動能の獲得と関連しており、両者は異なる機能を持つと考えられます。
pmid-7698219.summary_en: This cell biology study used F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, which differentiate into parietal or visceral endoderm after retinoic acid treatment, to investigate integrin alpha6 beta1 during differentiation. Total alpha6 protein declined after differentiation while mRNA levels remained constant, suggesting post-transcriptional regulation. Alpha6B was the predominant isoform and decreased after parietal endoderm differentiation, whereas alpha6A increased and localised to focal contacts, correlating with acquired motility. The findings suggest distinct functions for the two isoforms.

pmid-7698228.summary_ja: タンパク質ホスファターゼ阻害剤オカダ酸が、胎児性癌細胞株F9の分化に与える影響を調べた基礎研究です。処理細胞は形態変化を示してM期で増殖が停止し、分化マーカー遺伝子のmRNAが増加しました。c-junとjunBのmRNAも速やかに増加し、AP-1の活性化を介して分化遺伝子の発現が誘導されると考えられています。
pmid-7698228.summary_en: This basic research study examined how okadaic acid, a protein phosphatase inhibitor and tumour promoter, affects differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Treated cells changed morphology, arrested in M phase, and showed increased expression of various differentiation marker mRNAs. Okadaic acid rapidly induced c-jun and junB mRNA, suggesting that phosphatase inhibition activates protein phosphorylation and promotes differentiation gene expression through AP-1 activation. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model for stem cell growth and differentiation.

pmid-7737975.summary_ja: P19マウス胎児性癌細胞にレチノイン酸を加え神経分化を誘導し、NHE1遺伝子の発現を解析した。分化初期に転写が約10倍に増加し、近位のAP-2部位が関与した。分化不全変異株RAC65では効果が低下した。形態変化に先行して遺伝子発現が上昇し、神経分化に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-7737975.summary_en: This study examined Na+/H+ exchanger NHE1 gene regulation during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation of P19 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells. NHE1 transcription increased about 10-fold early in differentiation, driven by a proximal AP-2 site whose binding increased. The effect was reduced in the differentiation-defective mutant RAC65. Treated cells also recovered faster from acid load, and gene and activity changes preceded morphological changes, suggesting NHE1 activation may contribute to neuronal differentiation.

pmid-7824272.summary_ja: 本研究は、アデノウイルスE1A遺伝子を胎児性癌細胞P19に導入し、その分化能の変化を検討したものです。E1Aを発現したクローンは増殖を失うか、胎児性癌細胞の性質を失い、レチノイン酸などによる分化誘導にも応答しなくなりました。p300への結合領域が必要であることから、E1Aとp300の結合が胎児性癌の性質の喪失を引き起こすと結論づけています。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではなく、細胞生物学的研究です。
pmid-7824272.summary_en: This 1995 Oncogene study expresses adenovirus 5 E1A in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells to test how E1A alters their differentiation. E1A-expressing clones either stopped proliferating or lost embryonal carcinoma characteristics, failed to differentiate in response to retinoic acid or DMSO, lost the SSEA-1 antigen, and expressed cytokeratin 55. Using 12S E1A deletion constructs, the authors showed that the N-terminal 25 amino acids and the CR1 region, both required to bind cellular p300, are needed for these effects. They conclude that E1A binding to p300 causes loss of embryonal carcinoma cell characteristics. The work is primarily viral oncogene and cell biology research.

pmid-7824282.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌細胞P19をin vitroで分化させた際の網膜芽細胞腫タンパク質(pRb)およびサイクリン依存性キナーゼ(cdk)の変化を検討したものです。分化に伴いpRbの合成は誘導され、主に低リン酸化型になりました。cdk2活性は低下し、サイクリンD1・D2の誘導によりcdk4活性は上昇しました。細胞周期研究であり、臨床的な腫瘍研究ではありません。
pmid-7824282.summary_en: This 1995 Oncogene study examines retinoblastoma protein (pRb) and cyclin-dependent kinases during in vitro differentiation of P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, used as a model of early developmental processes. pRb synthesis is strongly induced and becomes mainly underphosphorylated. Cdk2 activity is impaired, while cdk4 activity is stimulated through induction of cyclins D1 and D2. E2F DNA-binding activity declines and the G1 cell fraction increases. The authors conclude that differentiation alters cdk activities, pRb regulation, and E2F binding, producing cells with a changed cell cycle profile. It is a cell cycle biology study rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-7844528.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株3種をHTLV-I産生細胞と共培養し、3か月間の持続感染を検討した研究である。ウイルスDNAは持続したが、組み込まれたプロウイルスの多くは不完全であった。転写産物は少なく、ウイルスタンパク質は検出されなかった。栄養膜細胞は非産生的に持続感染しうるとの結論である。主題は腫瘍学よりもウイルス学である。
pmid-7844528.summary_en: The authors tested whether three choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR, BeWo, JEG-3) can be persistently infected with HTLV-I after co-culture with the productively infected MT-2 line. Over three months, viral DNA persisted, although integrated proviruses were mostly incomplete, while a full-length genome was found in clonally expanded cultures. Viral transcripts were substantially reduced compared with MT-2 cells, and no viral protein or reverse transcriptase activity was detected. The authors conclude that trophoblastic cells can be persistently but essentially non-productively infected. The focus is virology rather than tumor biology.

pmid-8832901.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞(P19およびレチノイン酸抵抗性RAC65細胞)を用い、分化時のOct-4遺伝子の発現抑制機構を検討した基礎研究である。RARα2またはRARβ2の導入により抵抗性細胞でもOct-4抑制が回復し、Oct-4プロモーター上のホルモン応答配列にはCOUP-TFが結合し、その結合が発現抑制と相関した。腫瘍患者ではなく培養細胞の転写調節が主題である。
pmid-8832901.summary_en: This basic study examines how retinoic acid silences the stem-cell factor Oct-4 during differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells, using P19 and RA-resistant RAC65 cell lines. The authors show that RAR alpha 2 or RAR beta 2 can restore Oct-4 promoter repression in resistant cells, and that COUP-TF family factors, rather than nuclear RA receptors, bind the Oct-4 promoter hormone response element and correlate with silencing. The work addresses transcriptional regulation in cultured cells rather than tumour patients.

pmid-10358266.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の内分泌活性を有する卵巣腫瘍を概説した総説です。女性化をきたす腫瘍として若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍や非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌などを、男性化をきたす腫瘍としてセルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍などを取り上げています。小児期・思春期の性器腫瘍として卵巣腫瘍が最も多いことを述べています。胚細胞腫瘍は絨毛癌として部分的に扱われ、治療や予後の記載はありません。
pmid-10358266.summary_en: This pediatric and adolescent endocrinology chapter reviews hormonally active ovarian tumors. Feminizing tumors include juvenile granulosa cell tumors, nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma, and others, while masculinizing tumors include Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors, gynandroblastoma, and steroid cell tumors. It notes that ovarian tumors are the most frequent genital neoplasms in childhood and adolescence. The abstract provides no treatment or outcome data, and its germ cell component is limited to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-11578382.summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍36例を20年間にわたり後方視的に検討した報告です。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、次いで未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマでした。手術による病期分類で31例中10例の病期が変更されました。多剤併用化学療法により予後は大きく改善し、大半の患者が無病生存しています。妊孕性温存手術も多くの症例で可能でした。
pmid-11578382.summary_en: This 20-year single-institution series of 36 patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors reports that endodermal sinus tumor was most common, followed by immature teratoma, dysgerminoma, and mixed germ cell tumor. Surgical staging changed the stage in 10 of 31 patients. Most patients were alive without disease at a median follow-up of 47 months. Combination chemotherapy substantially improved prognosis, and second-look laparotomy identified patients needing additional therapy. Fertility-preserving surgery was feasible in most patients.

pmid-12797133.summary_ja: 妊娠23週台で超音波検査により診断された心膜内奇形腫の症例報告です。直前の正常な産科超音波検査から4週間以内に急速に増大し、胸水貯留と大動脈流出路の血流速度上昇を伴っていました。1週間以内に胎児水腫と徐脈が出現し、母体が心膜穿刺を拒否したため胎児は死亡しました。心臓内ドプラ所見の異常は胎児の循環不全を予測しうると示され、胎児手術の役割についても考察されています。
pmid-12797133.summary_en: This case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed by ultrasound at 23.6 weeks' gestation, less than four weeks after a normal obstetric scan. The mass was associated with a large pleural effusion and elevated aortic outflow velocity. Within a week, fetal hydrops and bradycardia developed, and the fetus died after the mother declined pericardiocentesis. The authors highlight rapid growth of such teratomas and the value of abnormal intracardiac Doppler findings in anticipating fetal compromise, and discuss implications for fetal surgery.

pmid-12797191.summary_ja: 口蓋正中から発生する良性の成熟奇形腫であるエピグナサスの胎児症例2例を報告しています。超音波では不均一で多葉状の腫瘤と羊水過多を認め、他の形態異常は伴いませんでした。新生児の予後は上気道閉塞の程度に左右され、超音波は頭頸部の他の腫瘤との鑑別に有用とされています。予後不良の場合は妊娠中絶、そうでなければ出生時に多職種による介入を伴う妊娠継続という管理方針が考察されています。
pmid-12797191.summary_en: This report describes two fetal cases of epignathus, a benign mature teratoma arising from the midline of the palate. Ultrasound identified a heterogeneous, polylobed mass with polyhydramnios and no other morphological anomalies. Neonatal prognosis depends on upper airway obstruction, and ultrasound helps differentiate the mass from other cephalic masses. Management options discussed include termination of pregnancy when prognosis is poor, or continuation with multidisciplinary intervention at birth.

pmid-21566932.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマの患者が、週3回の血液透析を受けながらカルボプラチンとエトポシドによる4サイクルの化学療法を受けた症例です。各サイクルの2日目と3日目に透析を行い、血中白金濃度を測定しました。グレード4の血液毒性のため後続サイクルで用量を減量しましたが、AUCは各サイクルで変化しませんでした。透析患者の精巣がん治療では、カルボプラチンの薬物動態を考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-21566932.summary_en: This report describes a patient with advanced seminoma who received four cycles of carboplatin and etoposide while undergoing thrice-weekly hemodialysis. Hemodialysis was performed on days 2 and 3 of each cycle, and plasma platinum levels were measured. Dose reductions were needed after grade 4 hematologic toxicity, yet the area under the curve remained unchanged across cycles. Platinum was detectable before subsequent infusions, and the authors conclude that carboplatin pharmacokinetics should be considered when treating testicular cancer patients on hemodialysis.

pmid-21607368.summary_ja: 15年間にわたる反復性肺炎として発症し、悪性腫瘍が疑われた縦隔の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。22歳まで胸部X線写真では腫瘤が確認されませんでした。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で病変の範囲は示されましたが、嚢胞性であることや診断は確定できませんでした。前側方開胸により安全に摘出されましたが、周囲構造との強固な癒着のため切除は困難でした。反復性肺感染症の鑑別として縦隔奇形腫を考慮する重要性が示されています。
pmid-21607368.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma of the mediastinum that presented as recurrent pneumonia over 15 years and mimicked malignancy. The mass was not seen on chest radiographs until age 22. CT showed its extent but could not confirm the cystic nature or establish a diagnosis. The lesion was safely removed through an anterolateral thoracotomy, although dense adhesions to surrounding structures made resection difficult. The report highlights the importance of considering mediastinal teratoma in recurrent pulmonary infection.

pmid-37281067.summary_ja: 胎児性癌由来のF9細胞株を用いて、分化誘導の機序を検討した基礎研究です。レチノイン酸は不可逆的な分化を、酪酸ナトリウムは急速かつ可逆的な変化を誘導します。両剤を併用すると、一方で誘導された細胞には他方が影響せず、F9細胞は相互に排他的な二つの経路に分化することが示されました。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の管理には直接言及していません。
pmid-37281067.summary_en: This basic study examines differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a teratocarcinoma-derived line. Retinoic acid induces irreversible differentiation, while sodium butyrate induces rapid, reversible changes. Combining the two agents showed that each had no effect on cells induced by the other, indicating that F9 cells differentiate along two distinct, mutually exclusive pathways. The work provides insight into embryonal carcinoma biology, but it does not address clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-7505805.summary_ja: 進行期セミノーマ142例を対象に、白金製剤ベースの化学療法の成績と予後因子を検討した。評価可能例の93%が良好な反応を示し、中央値43か月の観察で88%が生存、86%が無増悪であった。hCGおよびLDHの上昇は予後不良と関連したが、性腺外原発は予後不良因子ではなかった。シスプラチンとエトポシドの4サイクル療法が有効であり、標準治療であると結論づけている。
pmid-7505805.summary_en: This series of 142 patients with advanced seminoma, treated mostly with cisplatin plus etoposide, achieved favorable responses in 93% of assessable patients. At a median follow-up of 43 months, 88% were alive and 86% were progression-free. Elevated hCG and LDH were associated with worse survival and relapse, whereas an extragonadal primary site was not adverse. All patients with mediastinal primaries achieved complete response. The authors conclude that four cycles of cisplatin and etoposide is highly effective and is their standard therapy.

pmid-7506478.summary_ja: 2歳と17歳の男児に発生した腸間膜原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍2例を報告した。両例とも腹部腫瘤を呈し、腫瘍径は9cmと11cmであった。組織学的に典型的な卵黄嚢腫瘍像を示し、αフェトプロテインが免疫染色で陽性であった。術後に化学療法を受け、現在生存しているがフォローアップ期間は短い。性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の文献的レビューと、腸間膜発生の組織発生学的意義について考察している。
pmid-7506478.summary_en: Two yolk sac tumors arising in the mesentery, in a 2-year-old and a 17-year-old male, are described. Both presented with abdominal masses measuring 9 and 11 cm, and one grew into the bowel lumen. Histology showed typical yolk sac tumor patterns, and immunostaining was positive for alpha-fetoprotein. Both patients received postoperative chemotherapy and remain alive, although follow-up is short. The authors review extragonadal yolk sac tumors and discuss the histogenetic implications of their occasional origin in the mesentery.

pmid-7506856.summary_ja: 白金製剤化学療法後もAFPやhCGが持続的に高値の進行期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍16例に対し、残存病変の外科的切除を行った。多くは後腹膜転移のみであった。術後死亡はなく、6例（37%）が平均74か月無病生存した。腫瘍マーカーが正常化しない例では、残存病変の切除を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-7506856.summary_en: Sixteen patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, whose AFP and/or hCG remained persistently elevated after platinum-based chemotherapy, underwent resection of all residual radiographic disease. Ten had retroperitoneal metastasis only. There were no postoperative deaths, and 37% were disease-free at a mean of 74 months. Ten patients died of disease at a mean of eight months after surgery. The authors recommend that such patients be considered for resection of all residual disease, which may offer the only realistic chance of cure in selected cases.

pmid-7507793.summary_ja: バレット食道に発生した腺癌において、卵黄嚢および絨毛癌への分化を伴う症例を報告した。血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇から胚細胞分化を疑い、細胞障害性化学療法で寛解を得た。小さな生検では胚細胞成分を見逃す可能性があり、50歳未満の腺癌患者には胚細胞腫瘍マーカーの免疫染色が推奨されると結論づけている。
pmid-7507793.summary_en: A patient with a primary adenocarcinoma of Barrett's esophagus showed yolk sac and trophoblastic (choriocarcinoma) differentiation, a finding not previously described at this site. Elevated serum tumor markers prompted the diagnosis of germ cell differentiation, and the patient achieved remission with cytotoxic chemotherapy. The authors note that germ cell components may be missed in small biopsies and recommend immunostaining for germ cell tumor markers in adenocarcinoma patients younger than 50 years, since germ cell differentiation changes therapy and prognosis.

pmid-7508884.summary_ja: 本研究は精母細胞性セミノーマ7例を14種類の抗体パネルで免疫組織化学的に検討した。古典的セミノーマと異なりPLAP、hCG、AFP、神経特異エノラーゼは陰性で、3例で低分子量サイトケラチン(CAM 5.2)の局所染色が見られた。古典的セミノーマや卵黄嚢腫瘍との鑑別に有用で、簡略化した抗体パネルが推奨された。
pmid-7508884.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined seven spermatocytic seminoma cases using a panel of 14 antibodies. Spermatocytic seminoma was negative for PLAP, hCG, AFP, and neuron-specific enolase, unlike classic seminoma, while focal low molecular weight cytokeratin (CAM 5.2) staining was seen in three cases. The findings help distinguish spermatocytic seminoma from classic seminoma and yolk sac tumor, and the authors recommend a simplified antibody panel for this differential diagnosis.

pmid-7509255.summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者78例を、無治療群、初期の補助化学療法群、VBP4コース群に分けて後方視的に比較した。VBP4コース群では再発なく、生存率は97.3%だった。著者らは4コースのVBPで治癒率100%が得られたと結論し、2コースの妥当性は長期フォローアップが必要とした。
pmid-7509255.summary_en: This retrospective review of 78 patients with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors compared no adjuvant therapy, earlier non-cisplatin adjuvant regimens, and four courses of VBP (vinblastine, bleomycin, cisplatin). Patients given four courses of VBP had no recurrences and a 97.3% survival rate, while the untreated group had a 66.7% survival rate. The authors conclude four courses of adjuvant VBP achieved a 100% cure rate, with longer follow-up needed to judge whether two courses suffice.

pmid-7509890.summary_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者4例が、化学療法後に残存肺病変に対して開胸手術を受けた。残存病変は生存癌細胞、未熟奇形腫、成熟奇形腫、壊死を示した。3例が完全寛解し、生存癌細胞が残った1例は腎不全で死亡した。化学療法への良好な反応と残存腫瘍の完全切除が重要であると結論された。
pmid-7509890.summary_en: This report describes four patients with stage III nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who underwent thoracotomy for persistent lung masses after multi-drug chemotherapy. Residual masses showed viable cancer, immature teratoma, mature teratoma, or necrosis. Three patients achieved complete remission, while the patient with viable residual cancer died of renal failure. The authors conclude that favorable chemotherapy response and complete resection of residual tumors are key to successful treatment of advanced testicular cancer.

pmid-7510450.summary_ja: 43歳男性の右精巣セミノーマ症例で、術前に修正PVB療法3コースを行い、その後に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。閉鎖リンパ節に生存細胞が見られたためVIP療法2コースを追加した。治療後15か月間再発はなく、初回化学療法後の精巣摘除術が実施可能であることが示された。
pmid-7510450.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with a right testicular seminoma and enlarged regional lymph nodes. He received three courses of modified PVB chemotherapy before right orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, after which tumor markers normalized and CT showed necrosis. Because viable cells were found in an obturator lymph node, two courses of VIP chemotherapy were added. He remained recurrence-free for 15 months, suggesting that orchiectomy after initial chemotherapy is feasible when the tumor is not removed en bloc.

pmid-7510451.summary_ja: PVB療法後に再発した病期IIIB非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の45歳男性の症例報告。カルボプラチン、エトポシド、シクロホスファミドによる超大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞自家移植を施行した。重篤な副作用はなく、2か月以上の部分寛解を得た。5か月後に肺転移による呼吸不全で死亡した。
pmid-7510451.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old man with relapsed stage IIIB nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after PVB chemotherapy. He received ultra high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide followed by peripheral blood stem cell autotransplantation. No serious side effects occurred, and he achieved partial remission lasting over two months. He later died of respiratory failure from metastatic lung cancer five months after treatment, and the authors suggest this approach may be a new option for refractory testicular cancer.

pmid-7510465.summary_ja: 縦隔・頸部・後腹膜転移を伴う27歳男性の精巣胎児性癌の症例。BEP療法3コースで転移リンパ節は縮小し、腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。サルベージ手術で摘出したリンパ節に生存細胞は認められなかった。1993年9月時点で無病生存しており、化学療法後の手術により完全奏効が得られた。
pmid-7510465.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with metastatic testicular embryonal carcinoma with syncytiotrophoblastic cells. After three courses of BEP chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin), lymph node metastases shrank and tumor markers normalized. Surgical dissection of cervical, mediastinal, and retroperitoneal nodes showed no viable cells. The patient was alive without evidence of disease at follow-up in September 1993, showing that salvage surgery can achieve complete response after chemotherapy.

pmid-7512072.summary_ja: 浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍100例の精巣摘除標本を検討し、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の精巣網へのパジェット様進展を評価した。該当する60例のうち24例(40%)で認められ、非セミノーマ群で多かった。2例は浸潤性セミノーマと誤診されかけた。免疫組織化学が鑑別に有用であった。
pmid-7512072.summary_en: This study reviewed 100 orchiectomy specimens with invasive testicular germ cell tumors for pagetoid spread of intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) into the rete testis. The spread was found in 40% of evaluable cases, more often in nonseminomatous than pure seminomatous tumors. Two cases were nearly misdiagnosed as invasive seminoma. Placental alkaline phosphatase and AE1 staining helped distinguish the pagetoid spread from invasive seminoma, supporting the value of immunohistochemistry.

pmid-7512129.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を完全切除された93例に対し、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン(BEP)3コースの補助化学療法の有効性を検討したGOGの試験である。93例中91例が4〜90か月のフォローアップ中、再発なく経過した。急性骨髄単球性白血病や悪性リンパ腫の発症も報告され、長期フォローアップの必要性が示された。
pmid-7512129.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group trial assessed postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy with three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (BEP) in 93 assessable patients with completely resected ovarian germ cell tumors. Ninety-one of 93 patients remained free of germ cell cancer during follow-up of 4 to 90 months. Toxicities were moderate, with one case of acute myelomonocytic leukemia and one malignant lymphoma noted. The authors conclude that three BEP courses nearly always prevent recurrence in well-staged patients and should be given to all such patients.

pmid-7512416.summary_ja: 1988〜1993年に予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍46例へシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った後方視的検討である。電解質、尿酸、LDHなどの推移から、急性腫瘍崩壊症候群を示す代謝異常は認められなかった。胸部に巨大病変を有する2例は呼吸窮迫と多臓器不全で早期に死亡した。特別な予防療法は不要と考えられる。
pmid-7512416.summary_en: This retrospective review of 46 patients with poor-risk germ cell tumors treated with aggressive cisplatin-based chemotherapy from 1988 to 1993 evaluated whether acute tumor lysis syndrome occurs. Serial electrolyte, uric acid, creatinine, and LDH values showed no metabolic abnormalities suggestive of ATLS. Two patients with bulky chest disease died early from respiratory distress and multiorgan failure. The authors conclude that ATLS is unlikely in poor-risk germ cell tumors, so special prophylaxis may be unnecessary.

pmid-7512520.summary_ja: ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株SMT-cc1によるウシ血管内皮細胞の破壊を、共培養モデルで検討した基礎研究である。アプロチニンや抗プラスミン抗体で破壊は用量依存的に抑制された。腫瘍細胞のuPA-プラスミン系の蛋白分解活性が、血行性転移の重要な段階であることが示唆される。
pmid-7512520.summary_en: This in vitro coculture study examined how the human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line SMT-cc1 destroys bovine vascular endothelial cells (CPAE). SMT-cc1 cells rapidly caused CPAE detachment, and this was dose-dependently suppressed by the serine protease inhibitor aprotinin or an anti-plasmin antibody. The findings suggest that uPA-plasmin proteolytic activity on tumor cells contributes to endothelial destruction and may be a critical step in blood-borne metastasis.

pmid-7513256.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの精巣胚細胞腫瘍65例の原発巣を盲検的に評価し、血管新生(微小血管数)が隠れた所属リンパ節転移を予測するかを検討した。微小血管数が30を超えた11例は全例が病理学的病期Bであった。多変量解析では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の欠如のみが有意な予測因子であった。前向きの検証が必要である。
pmid-7513256.summary_en: This blinded review of 65 clinical stage A testicular germ cell tumors assessed whether tumor angiogenesis, measured by factor VIII-immunostained microvessel counts, predicts occult nodal metastases. Of 65 patients, 43 had pathological stage B disease. All 11 patients with counts above 30 per high-power field had occult metastases. Multivariate analysis showed that absence of a yolk sac tumor component was the only significant independent predictor. Angiogenesis quantitation may help identify such patients, pending prospective validation.

pmid-7513603.summary_ja: シスプラチンとイホスファミドによる救援化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍54例を後方視的に解析し、初期2コースの血清腫瘍マーカー半減期と治療成績の関係を検討した。適切な低下を示した患者は無イベント生存期間と全生存期間が有意に長かった。hCGの低下はAFPより強い予測因子であった。
pmid-7513603.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 54 germ cell tumor patients treated with cisplatin and ifosfamide salvage chemotherapy examined whether the serum AFP and hCG half-life during the first two cycles predicts outcome. Satisfactory marker decline was associated with markedly longer event-free and overall survival (median event-free survival 20.7 vs 5.8 months). hCG decline was a stronger predictor than AFP decline, and marker decline remained independent in multivariate analysis. Early marker kinetics may guide escalation to more intensive therapy.

pmid-7514077.summary_ja: ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋標本1884例の固形腫瘍と833検体の正常組織を用いて、c-kit蛋白の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。セミノーマ/ディスジャーミノーマの92%でc-kit陽性であり、診断マーカーとしての有用性が示された。正常の精巣精母細胞や卵巣卵母細胞も陽性であった。
pmid-7514077.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined c-kit expression across 1884 solid tumors and 833 normal tissue samples. Seminoma/dysgerminoma showed preferential c-kit positivity in 92% of cases, versus 36% of small cell lung carcinomas, while other carcinomas were largely negative. Normal testicular spermatocytes and ovarian oocytes were c-kit positive. The authors propose c-kit as a useful diagnostic marker for seminoma/dysgerminoma and for distinguishing pulmonary small cell carcinoma from non-pulmonary small cell carcinoma.

pmid-7514435.summary_ja: 1978〜1992年に当施設で治療した女性の卵巣および性腺外悪性胚細胞腫瘍43例の後方視的検討です。卵巣腫瘍ではシスプラチン併用化学療法により良好な成績が得られ、片側卵巣摘出で妊孕性を温存しても治癒を損なわないことが示されました。予後不良因子として卵黄嚢腫瘍、高AFP、高年齢が挙げられています。
pmid-7514435.summary_en: A single-institution retrospective review of 43 females with ovarian and extragonadal malignant germ cell tumors treated from 1978 to 1992. Histologies included dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma, and mixed tumors. Most ovarian tumors were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy (PVB or BEP), and unilateral oophorectomy preserved fertility without compromising cure. Ten-year overall survival was 89%, with poorer outcomes in yolk sac tumor, AFP above 1000 ng/ml, and older age. Extragonadal tumors, including pineal cases, had lower event-free survival.

pmid-7514514.summary_ja: 26歳男性が疼痛を伴う女性化乳房で受診し、前縦隔の腫瘤が見つかった症例報告です。エストラジオールとβ-hCGの上昇がみられ、外科的切除によりホルモン値と女性化乳房は改善しました。病理組織で原発性縦隔セミノーマと確定し、化学療法後も再発はありません。
pmid-7514514.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with painful gynaecomastia and was found to have a mass in the anterior mediastinum. Endocrine testing showed elevated oestradiol and hCG-beta. No primary testicular tumour or metastases were found. Surgical resection normalized hormone levels and resolved the gynaecomastia. Histology confirmed a primary mediastinal seminoma that stained positively for hCG-beta. He received chemotherapy with etoposide and cisplatin and remained free of recurrence, with normal tumour markers.

pmid-7514671.summary_ja: ねじれを伴った嚢胞性奇形腫が、hCG産生と腹腔内出血により破裂性子宮外妊娠に類似した症例報告です。奇形腫がゴナドトロピンを産生し急性腹症として発症しうることを示しています。鑑別診断として念頭に置くべきだと述べられています。
pmid-7514671.summary_en: Benign cystic teratomas are often asymptomatic, though some have been reported to secrete thyroid-stimulating hormone, estrogen, testosterone, or prolactin. This report describes a patient whose twisted cystic teratoma mimicked a ruptured ectopic pregnancy. The tumour produced beta-human chorionic gonadotropin and caused hemorrhage into the peritoneal cavity. The case highlights that gonadotropin-producing teratomas can present as an acute abdominal emergency and should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-7514697.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性または予後不良の精巣がん患者4例を対象に、大量エトポシドで末梢血幹細胞を採取し、自家移植を行った研究です。採取された造血前駆細胞は安全な移植に十分な量でした。BEP療法や超大量化学療法により完全寛解が得られ、高リスク患者に有望な方法と結論付けられています。
pmid-7514697.summary_en: Peripheral blood stem cell autotransplantation (PBSCT) after ultra-high-dose chemotherapy was evaluated in four patients with chemotherapy-resistant or poor-prognosis testicular cancer. High-dose etoposide was used to mobilize stem cells, followed by G-CSF, and cells were collected by apheresis and cryopreserved. The mean CFU-GM yield was 22.3 x 10^5/kg. Three patients achieved complete remission with BEP. One patient who did not respond received ultrahigh-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide followed by PBSCT and achieved remission. The authors concluded the approach is promising for high-risk patients.

pmid-7514699.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん15例に低用量COMPE化学療法(シスプラチン、ビンクリスチン、メトトレキサート、ペプロマイシン、エトポシド)を施行した研究です。12例が13〜86か月の追跡で無病生存しました。残存腫瘍の切除や放射線療法で完全寛解に至った症例もあり、進行例の一部は再発・死亡しています。
pmid-7514699.summary_en: Fifteen patients with advanced testicular cancer, including five with seminoma and ten with non-seminoma, were treated with low-dose COMPE chemotherapy (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, and etoposide), with a mean of 3.2 courses. Twelve patients were alive without evidence of disease at 13 to 86 months of follow-up. Six achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone, and others achieved complete remission after resection or irradiation of residual masses. Two patients with advanced disease relapsed and died, and one with progressive disease died after five months.

pmid-7514845.summary_ja: 慢性肝炎を合併した32歳男性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例です。シスプラチン併用化学療法後もAFPが高値のままでしたが、LCAによるAFPサブフラクション解析で卵黄嚢成分の減少が確認されました。肝由来と腫瘍由来のAFPを鑑別する有用性が示されています。
pmid-7514845.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with chronic hepatitis and a scrotal mass was diagnosed with embryonal carcinoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. AFP and beta-hCG were elevated, and lung and retroperitoneal metastases were seen. After three courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, beta-hCG normalized and metastases shrank, but AFP remained elevated. Lens culinaris hemagglutinin (LCA) subfraction analysis showed that the liver-derived peak 2 disappeared after the third course, indicating reduction of the yolk sac component. The case shows how AFP subfractions can distinguish tumour-derived from liver-derived AFP.

pmid-7514956.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者36例を対象に、白血球中の白金-DNA付加体を原子吸光分析法とELISAで測定した研究です。付加体量は投与レジメンにより異なりましたが、治療反応とは相関しませんでした。過去の報告との不一致は、白金製剤、用量、投与スケジュール、採血時期の違いによると考察されています。
pmid-7514956.summary_en: Platinum-DNA adducts were measured in leukocytes of 36 patients with germ cell tumors receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy, using atomic absorption spectrometry and an ELISA. Three regimens were compared: cisplatin with etoposide, carboplatin with etoposide, and VAB-6 with or without high-dose therapy. Adducts rose after each cycle and persisted for 4 to 8 weeks after therapy. Contrary to earlier studies, adduct levels did not correlate with favorable clinical response. The authors attribute differences between studies to variations in platinum analogue, dose, schedule, and sampling timing.

pmid-7515000.summary_ja: 逆転写PCR法を用い、絨毛癌細胞株、完全胞状奇胎、正常胎盤におけるhGH-VおよびhCSのRNA発現を比較した。腫瘍性栄養膜細胞ではhCSが優位であったが、JAR細胞ではhGH-Vが主体であった。絨毛癌細胞株ではhCS-L転写産物は検出されなかった。遺伝子発現の脱制御または栄養膜細胞の分化の違いが示唆された。
pmid-7515000.summary_en: This study used reverse transcriptase-PCR to examine expression of placental growth hormone variant (hGH-V) and chorionic somatomammotropin (hCS) RNA in choriocarcinoma cell lines, complete hydatidiform moles, and term placenta. hCS was the predominant transcript in neoplastic trophoblast samples, whereas JAR choriocarcinoma cells mainly expressed hGH-V. hCS-L transcripts were absent in the cell lines. The findings suggest deregulated hGH/hCS gene expression in neoplastic trophoblasts or differences related to trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-7515445.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に腫瘍マーカーのみが持続的に上昇し、臨床的病変を認めない非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の15例を後方視的に検討した。初回に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた11例は全例で後の化学療法が必要となった。初回化学療法を受けた4例では、後の手術が必要だったのは1例のみだった。マーカー上昇は全身性腫瘍を示すことが多く、初回化学療法が望ましいと結論づけられた。
pmid-7515445.summary_en: This retrospective review covered 15 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who had persistently elevated AFP and/or hCG after orchiectomy but no clinical evidence of disease. Eleven underwent initial retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and all required later chemotherapy. Four received primary chemotherapy, and only one needed later surgery.
