The authors conclude that persistent marker elevation usually indicates systemic disease best treated initially with chemotherapy.

pmid-7515451.summary_ja: 播種性卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して化学療法を受けた小児で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化したものの後腹膜に腫瘤が残存した。切除標本では線維組織、壊死、石灰化のみが認められ、生存腫瘍細胞は見られなかった。思春期前の卵黄嚢腫瘍で後腹膜に残存腫瘤を伴う症例としては初めての報告とされる。症例報告である。
pmid-7515451.summary_en: A child with disseminated yolk sac tumor received chemotherapy and achieved normalization of serum alpha-fetoprotein, but a residual retroperitoneal mass persisted. Surgical excision showed only fibrous tissue, necrosis, and calcification, with no viable tumor. The authors report this as the first case of a prepubertal yolk sac tumor with a residual retroperitoneal mass. This is a case report.

pmid-7515656.summary_ja: 成人の精巣セミノーマ15例と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍18例で、染色体11p13および11p15.5領域の解析を行った。ヘテロ接合性の消失や欠失は非セミノーマで多くみられた。WT1遺伝子には構造異常や配列変異は認められなかった。11p領域の喪失は一般的だが、成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症には必ずしも重要ではないと結論づけられた。
pmid-7515656.summary_en: This study examined chromosomal bands 11p13 and 11p15.5 in 15 adult testicular seminomas and 18 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Loss of heterozygosity and deletions were more frequent in nonseminomas, especially combined loss of both regions. No gross or sequence-level abnormalities were found in the WT1 gene. The authors conclude that 11p loss is common but likely not crucial in the pathogenesis of adult testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7517072.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌に対して肺全摘術を受けた患者で、反対側の肺に出血性転移が生じ、「絨毛癌症候群」を呈した。極めてまれな腫瘍であるため診断が困難であった点が強調されている。本報告は臨床経過の提示を中心とした症例報告である。
pmid-7517072.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma who, after pneumonectomy, developed haemorrhagic pulmonary metastases on the contralateral side, a presentation termed choriocarcinoma syndrome. The report highlights the diagnostic difficulty of this extremely rare tumour and its haemorrhagic metastases. It focuses on the clinical presentation of the case.

pmid-7517380.summary_ja: 悪性非セミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者14例に、大量シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによるPVeBV療法を施行した第II相試験である。中央値6年の追跡で14例中10例が無増悪生存であった。BEP療法と同等の有効性で毒性は少なく、1990年代の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の標準治療はBEPであると著者らは述べている。
pmid-7517380.summary_en: This phase II study treated 14 patients with malignant nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors using high-dose cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin, and etoposide (PVeBV). Ten of 14 patients were progression-free at a median follow-up of six years. The authors conclude that PVeBV showed efficacy equal to BEP with less toxicity, and that BEP remains the standard for ovarian germ cell tumors in the 1990s.

pmid-7517758.summary_ja: 非奇胎性絨毛性疾患5例(胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例、過形成性胎盤部2例、絨毛癌2例)を正常胎盤と比較検討した。PSTTは胎盤部中間型栄養膜細胞の腫瘍性変化であることが示唆された。過形成性胎盤部の浸潤性中間型栄養膜細胞はPSTT細胞に類似していた。
pmid-7517758.summary_en: This study compared five non-molar trophoblastic disease cases, including one placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), two exaggerated placental sites, and two choriocarcinomas, with normal placenta. Light microscopy, immunohistochemistry, and electron microscopy suggested that PSTT represents neoplastic transformation of placental site intermediate trophoblast. Infiltrating intermediate trophoblasts in exaggerated placental sites resembled PSTT cells.

pmid-7517917.summary_ja: 本研究は免疫組織化学法を用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の36検体(CIS、セミノーマ、非セミノーマを含む)と対照19検体におけるc-kitタンパク発現を検討した。c-kitはほぼすべてのCISで強く発現し、セミノーマでは強度にばらつきを伴いながら保持されていた一方、非セミノーマおよび正常胚細胞では発現が認められなかった。著者らは、CISは原始生殖細胞に由来すると考えられ、c-kitはCISの新たなマーカーとなる可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-7517917.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to examine c-kit protein expression in 36 testicular germ cell neoplasia specimens, including carcinoma-in-situ (CIS), seminomas, and non-seminomas, plus 19 controls. c-kit was strongly expressed in almost all CIS lesions, variably retained in seminomas, and absent in non-seminomas and normal germ cells. The authors suggest CIS arises from primordial germ cells and propose c-kit as a novel CIS marker.

pmid-7518019.summary_ja: 1984〜1990年に胚細胞腫瘍と診断された小児107例の多剤化学療法の成績を検討した。PVB-M療法からBEP療法への移行後、完全寛解率は40%から85%に向上した。BEP療法はシスプラチンとエトポシドの併用により、有効性・毒性・遵守性で優れ、進行例で好ましいと結論づけている。
pmid-7518019.summary_en: This study assessed multiagent chemotherapy outcomes in 107 children diagnosed with germ cell tumors between 1984 and 1990. Patients first received PVB-M (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin, methotrexate), then BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) from 1988. Complete remission was 40% with PVB-M versus 85% with BEP, and survival was better with BEP. The authors conclude etoposide plus cisplatin is superior to vinblastine plus cisplatin for advanced pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-7518517.summary_ja: 非転移性および低リスク転移性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する単剤化学療法を概説している。5日間筋注メトトレキサート、週1回のGOG法、アクチノマイシンDの単回またはパルス投与で高い完全奏効が得られるが、毒性は異なる。奏効は胞状奇胎後のβ-hCG持続上昇の有無や絨毛癌の否定に左右され、転移例では初回不応率が高い。
pmid-7518517.summary_en: This review examines single-agent chemotherapy for nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease. Five-day intramuscular methotrexate, weekly GOG methotrexate, and single-dose or pulsed actinomycin-D achieve high complete response rates, with differing toxicity profiles. Success depends on a prior molar pregnancy, persistent beta-hCG elevation, and the absence of choriocarcinoma. First-line failure rates are higher in metastatic disease, where another agent such as actinomycin-D should be considered.

pmid-7518576.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、LOH解析によるアレロタイプ解析を行った。RB1、DCC、NME、TP53などの既知の腫瘍抑制遺伝子と新規領域で欠失を同定した。分化度の高い奇形腫は胎児性癌より対立遺伝子欠失が多く、奇形腫ではNME遺伝子の欠失が70%超であった。
pmid-7518576.summary_en: This allelotype study used loss of heterozygosity assays on human male germ cell tumors to identify recurrent deletions in tumor suppressor genes (RB1, DCC, NME, TP53) and several novel chromosomal regions. Well-differentiated teratomas showed more allelic loss than embryonal carcinomas. NME genes showed over 70% loss in teratomas. The authors suggest nonrandom gene loss contributes to tumor development and that other gene losses relate to somatic differentiation.

pmid-7518667.summary_ja: 女性患者に発生した原発性後縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告している。外科的切除後に3コースの併用化学療法を施行した。治療後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化した。縦隔の卵黄嚢腫瘍は多くが若年男性の前縦隔に発生するため、女性かつ後縦隔発生である点が特徴的である。
pmid-7518667.summary_en: The authors describe a rare primary posterior mediastinal endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor in a female patient. Surgical excision was performed, followed by three courses of combination chemotherapy. Serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized after treatment. Mediastinal yolk sac tumors are uncommon, typically occur in young males, and mostly arise in the anterior mediastinum, making this case notable for its female patient and posterior location.

pmid-7519539.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の肺転移に対する穿刺吸引細胞診標本を検討した。Diff-Quik染色で異染性ヒアリン物質内に短い線維を認め、パパニコロウ染色では認められなかった。この線維は壁側分化を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断の手がかりとなりうるとし、本所見の初の報告としている。
pmid-7519539.summary_en: Fine-needle aspiration smears from a lung metastasis of a mediastinal yolk sac tumor with parietal differentiation were examined. Diff-Quik staining revealed short, curvilinear, nonbranching fibrils within metachromatic hyaline material, which were not seen on Papanicolaou-stained slides. The authors propose these fibrils, possibly proteoglycan core protein, as a diagnostic clue for yolk sac tumor with parietal differentiation, and report this as the first demonstration of the finding.

pmid-7519650.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法中における、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の血清腫瘍マーカーの半減期を検討した。低下が遅いと、良好群・不良群の双方で予後不良と関連した。治療前リスクと治療後のマーカー消失は独立した予後因子であり、救援化学療法でもhCGの低下速度が全生存期間(全生存率)の独立予測因子であった。
pmid-7519650.summary_en: This study examined serum tumor marker half-life during chemotherapy in germ cell tumor patients. Slow decline of AFP or HCG was linked to inferior survival in both good- and poor-risk patients. Pretreatment risk and post-treatment marker clearance were independent prognostic factors. In previously treated patients receiving cisplatin plus ifosfamide-based salvage chemotherapy, the rate of HCG decline independently predicted overall and event-free survival.

pmid-7519651.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の管理におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の臨床的有用性を概説している。治療前の基礎値は独立した予後因子として治療選択に影響し、化学療法前の上昇も予後的意義を持つ。マーカーの減衰曲線は手術の根治性を示し、化学療法中の推移は以後の治療戦略を左右する。
pmid-7519651.summary_en: This article reviews the clinical use of alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin in testicular tumor management. Their high specificity and sensitivity make them valuable. Pretreatment baseline marker levels are independent prognostic variables that influence therapy selection. A rising marker before chemotherapy may carry prognostic significance, the decay curve reflects surgical radicality, and marker behavior during chemotherapy guides further treatment decisions.

pmid-7519959.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は稀な疾患で、かつては全例が致死的であった。疑いを高く持ち早期に診断し、現代の多職種による集学的治療を組み合わせることで、長期生存や治癒が得られるようになった。シスプラチンを基盤とした併用化学療法を早期に用いたことが、治療成績向上の主因である。
pmid-7519959.summary_en: This review discusses mediastinal germ cell tumors, which are rare and were once uniformly fatal. A high index of suspicion leading to early diagnosis, combined with modern interdisciplinary management, now allows prolonged comfortable survival and many cures. The authors identify the early use of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy as the major factor behind improved treatment results over time.

pmid-7520498.summary_ja: 非典型的な症状で発症し、診断が遅れた転移性栄養膜腫瘍の症例を報告している。絨毛癌は稀で多彩な病像をとるため見逃されやすく、早期治療や治癒の機会を失うおそれがある。栄養膜疾患とその合併症を念頭に置き、高い疑い指数を保つことの重要性を強調している。
pmid-7520498.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic trophoblastic neoplasm, most likely choriocarcinoma, whose diagnosis was delayed because of an unusual clinical presentation. The authors emphasize that choriocarcinoma is rare and its varied presentations can lead to missed diagnosis, delaying effective treatment and reducing the chance of cure. They stress the need to maintain a high index of suspicion for trophoblastic disease and its complications, particularly when patients present with atypical symptoms.

pmid-7521445.summary_ja: 多能性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2に対し、OP-1(BMP-7)が増殖を抑制し、不可逆的な分化を誘導することを示した。HOXA1の誘導も認められた。非多能性の胎児性癌細胞株では反応が限定的であった。OP-1は一部の胚細胞腫瘍の治療に役立つ可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-7521445.summary_en: This in vitro study examined osteogenic protein-1 (OP-1, BMP-7) in pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma cells. OP-1 inhibited proliferation of the pluripotent NTERA2 line and induced irreversible differentiation with loss of EC markers, acting partly through HOXA1 induction. Nullipotent EC lines responded only partially. The authors suggest OP-1 may modulate retinoic acid-induced differentiation and may hold therapeutic value for some germ cell tumors.

pmid-7521931.summary_ja: 1982〜1992年にドイツの小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍106例を対象とした全国研究の報告である。組織型と病期に応じた化学療法と精巣摘除術を施行し、卵黄嚢腫瘍の多くは病期Iで経過観察とされた。救援化学療法を要した症例もあるが、各組織型で再発のない生存は良好であった。
pmid-7521931.summary_en: This German cooperative study reviewed 106 children with testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1982 to 1992 with stage- and histology-stratified chemotherapy plus orchiectomy. Most had yolk sac tumors, many of which were managed by wait-and-see after stage I. Teratomas and malignant teratomas showed high relapse-free survival. Patients with incomplete response to standard therapy received salvage regimens including etoposide, ifosfamide, and cisplatin. One death from sepsis occurred during salvage therapy.

pmid-7522081.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍における癌原遺伝子や増殖因子の分子遺伝学的変化を概説している。c-kit、そのリガンドであるSCF、hst1、c-mycなどが注目され、頻繁に変化する12番染色体上の遺伝子も検討されている。遺伝子変化が段階的に起こり組織亜型が生じるとし、従来の病理分類を補完しうると述べている。
pmid-7522081.summary_en: This review summarizes molecular genetic studies of testicular tumors. It focuses on altered proto-oncogenes and growth factors, including c-kit and its ligand SCF, hst1, and c-myc, along with genes on chromosome 12, which is frequently altered. The authors propose that stepwise genetic changes drive development of the histologic subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors. They argue these insights may refine traditional histopathologic classification.

pmid-7522313.summary_ja: 純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫の32例を10年間前向きに治療した研究である。病期と悪性度に応じた方針をとり、30例で妊孕性温存手術を実施した。低悪性度・低病期では手術のみで十分とされた。全例が無病生存中で、妊娠を希望した女性では正常妊娠が得られた。
pmid-7522313.summary_en: This prospective 10-year study treated 32 patients with pure ovarian immature teratoma using stage- and grade-based policies. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 30 patients, and surgery alone sufficed for low-grade, low-stage disease. All patients were alive and disease-free at median follow-up of 47 months. Five of six women wishing to conceive had seven normal pregnancies. The authors conclude that low-grade, low-stage tumors need no chemotherapy and that fertility-sparing surgery is warranted.

pmid-7522874.summary_ja: 化学療法後に再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の38例を、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる集中的治療で再治療した研究である。47%が第2の完全寛解に至り、そのうち88%が無病で経過している。全生存期間(全生存率)は46%であった。切除不能な腫瘤が残存した症例は、腫瘍マーカーが正常化しても予後不良であった。
pmid-7522874.summary_en: This study followed 38 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors who relapsed after chemotherapy and were retreated with intensive cisplatin- and etoposide-based regimens, with surgery in 22. Forty-seven percent achieved a second complete remission, and 88% of those remain disease free. Overall survival was 46% with median follow-up over 4.3 years. Patients with unresectable masses after relapse therapy had poor outcomes despite normal tumor markers.

pmid-7522951.summary_ja: カラードプラ超音波検査で28例の妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍の子宮血管パターンを、びまん型・腔隙型・緻密型に分類した。びまん型は診断時のβ-hCG値が低く、緻密型は高値であった。短期間の化学療法で治癒したのは多くがびまん型で、緻密型は奏効しにくかった。血管パターンはhCG値、血行動態、治療反応とよく相関した。
pmid-7522951.summary_en: This study used color Doppler ultrasound to classify uterine vascular patterns in 28 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors into diffuse, lacunar, and compact types. Diffuse lesions had the lowest beta-hCG at diagnosis, while compact lesions had the highest. Lacunar lesions showed the lowest uterine artery resistance index. Brief chemotherapy cured most diffuse-type lesions, whereas compact-type lesions responded poorly. Patterns correlated with hCG levels, hemodynamics, and treatment response.

pmid-7524297.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍であるセミノーマの稀な管状亜型4例を報告している。古典的セミノーマの領域を併存し、免疫組織化学およびDNA解析の所見も一致したことから、本亜型はセミノーマの組織学的変異型と結論づけている。卵黄嚢腫瘍や胎児性癌に類似した形態を示すため、精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断と治療において重要であると述べている。
pmid-7524297.summary_en: Four cases of tubular seminoma, a rare histologic variant of seminoma, are described. Patients were aged 15 to 44 years; three presented with painless testicular enlargement and one with a retroperitoneal mass and an occult primary. The tumors showed tubular or tubulopapillary architecture resembling yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma, yet were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and negative for cytokeratin and AFP. DNA flow cytometry showed hypotetraploid stemlines. The authors conclude that tubular seminoma is a seminoma variant, relevant to the differential diagnosis and management of testicular masses.

pmid-7524298.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の特殊型であるびまん性胎児性腫瘍の2例を報告している。両例とも病期I（精巣限局）で、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍が密に混在していた。免疫組織化学では卵黄嚢成分がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性、胎児性癌成分がCD30陽性を示し、少数の栄養膜成分はhCG陽性であった。両例とも術後11年以上無病生存中である。
pmid-7524298.summary_en: Two cases of diffuse embryoma of the testis, a distinct variant of mixed germ cell tumor, are reported. Both patients, aged 37 and 38, had tumors confined to the testis (stage I). The tumors consisted of intimately intermingled embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor with scattered trophoblastic cells. Immunohistochemistry showed AFP and strong cytokeratin in the yolk sac component, CD30 in the embryonal carcinoma component, and hCG in trophoblastic elements. Both patients remained alive without evidence of disease more than 11 years after surgery. The authors recommend distinguishing this entity from polyembryoma.

pmid-7524606.summary_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍38例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対する逐次切除の結果を検討している。腫瘍マーカーは正常でも、39%の症例で手術ごとに組織像が異なっていた。残存腫瘤の組織は部位ごとに一様でないため、すべての残存腫瘤を切除することが推奨されると結論づけている。
pmid-7524606.summary_en: This series of 38 patients with advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumours describes sequential surgical resection of persistent radiographic masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, despite normal serum tumour markers. Histology differed between sequential operations in 39% of patients, often with less favourable features at the first or a later operation. Patients with malignant teratoma intermediate in the primary tumour showed mature teratoma at least at one site. The authors conclude that all residual masses should be excised, and RPLND should not be omitted when lung resection shows necrosis or fibrosis.

pmid-7524830.summary_ja: 15歳未満の小児59例で、AFP陽性疾患の血清αフェトプロテイン亜分画を解析している。91.5%の症例は良性肝疾患、肝悪性腫瘍、卵黄嚢腫瘍の3型のいずれかに分類された。AFP亜分画の解析は、肝芽腫、肝細胞がん、肝硬変、肝炎、胚細胞腫瘍などの小児AFP陽性疾患の鑑別に有用であると結論している。
pmid-7524830.summary_en: This study examined serum AFP subfraction profiles in 59 children under 15 years of age with AFP-positive disease, using lectin affinity crossed-line immunoelectrophoresis. Most profiles (91.5%) fell into three types: benign liver disorder, hepatic malignancy, and yolk sac tumor. Five infants showed an atypical profile resembling hepatic malignancy. The authors conclude that AFP subfraction analysis helps differentiate hepatoblastoma, hepatoma, cirrhosis, hepatitis, and germ cell tumors among pediatric AFP-positive diseases.

pmid-7524920.summary_ja: 精巣の低病期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者690例について、治療法の変遷を解析している。再発は17.4%、がん死は3.6%であった。初回の神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の適応は段階的に制限されてきた。臨床病期Iの治療は依然として議論が残るとしている。病理学的病期IICでは補助化学療法が必須で、病理学的病期IIAおよびIIBでは2コースで十分と述べている。
pmid-7524920.summary_en: This report analyzes treatment changes in 690 consecutive patients with low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Relapse occurred in 17.4%, and 3.6% died of cancer after 2 to 20 years of follow-up. Indications for primary nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were progressively restricted to clinical stages I and IIA with normal postorchiectomy markers. Management of clinical stage I remains controversial. Adjuvant chemotherapy is mandatory for pathological stage IIC, while two courses suffice for pathological stages IIA and IIB.

pmid-7524921.summary_ja: 1965年から1989年までに臨床病期Bの非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた174例を検討している。病理学的病期Aは23%、病理学的病期Bは77%であった。補助化学療法を受けなかった病理学的病期B患者の65%は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清のみで治癒した。全生存期間(全生存率)は全期間で96%、シスプラチン併用化学療法の時代には98%であった。
pmid-7524921.summary_en: This Indiana University series reviewed 174 patients with clinical stage B nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection from 1965 to 1989. After surgery, 23% were pathological stage A and 77% pathological stage B. Among pathological stage B patients not receiving adjuvant chemotherapy, 65% were cured by RPLND alone. Overall survival was 96% over the entire period and 98% in the cisplatin-based chemotherapy era. The authors conclude that RPLND is effective for clinical stage B disease and avoids unnecessary chemotherapy in pathological stage A patients.

pmid-7525163.summary_ja: 肺に原発した芽腫と胚細胞悪性腫瘍の混合型の1例を報告している。受診時に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値で、胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法により正常化した。切除標本では、壊死性の強い胚細胞腫瘍と、成熟神経組織、骨・骨格筋分化を伴う二相性芽腫が認められた。胚細胞成分が体細胞系列の異常な分化を示すのか、芽腫成分が奇形腫様の異常な分化を示すのかは明らかでないと述べている。
pmid-7525163.summary_en: A single patient with a mixed blastoma-germ cell malignancy arising primarily in the lung is described. Serum AFP was elevated at presentation and normalized after chemotherapy for germ cell tumor. The resected specimen showed massively necrotic germ cell tumor with viable mature neural tissue, along with viable biphasic blastoma containing stromal bone and skeletal muscle differentiation. The authors could not determine whether the germ cell component reflected unusual somatic differentiation or whether the blastoma reflected unusual teratomatous differentiation.

pmid-7525293.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマ患者106例で、高感度法によりβ-hCGを測定した。精巣摘除術前に30.2%で高値を認め、術後76%、放射線または化学療法後34%で正常化した。β-hCG陽性患者は全例が観察期間中に完全寛解を維持した。一方、AFPやβ-hCGが極端に高い症例では、組織学的には純粋セミノーマでも非セミノーマ成分の存在が示唆された。
pmid-7525293.summary_en: This study measured beta-hCG in 106 patients with pure seminoma using a highly sensitive assay. Elevated levels were found before orchiectomy in 30.2%, normalizing in 76% afterward and in 34% after irradiation or chemotherapy. All beta-hCG-positive patients remained in complete remission over 2 to 84 months. Two patients with markedly high beta-hCG, or beta-hCG elevated together with AFP, had tumor marker patterns suggesting nonseminomatous elements despite a histologic diagnosis of pure seminoma. Levels up to 200 IU/l were consistent with pure seminoma.

pmid-7525792.summary_ja: 26歳男性の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例を報告している。血清AFPが26,765 ng/mlと著明に高値で、前縦隔および右胸腔に大きな腫瘤を認めた。シスプラチン併用化学療法（CDDP+VP-16）3コースで腫瘤は縮小したがAFPは正常化せず、薬剤抵抗性を疑って手術を施行した。術後18か月再発なく経過しており、化学療法後の手術時期の判断に血清AFPが有用であったと述べている。
pmid-7525792.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with an anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor, diagnosed from markedly elevated serum AFP (26,765 ng/ml) and a large mass in the anterior mediastinum and right thoracic cavity. After three courses of cisplatin and VP-16 chemotherapy, the mass shrank considerably, but AFP did not normalize, suggesting drug resistance. Surgical resection was performed, and histology confirmed yolk sac tumor with small viable foci. AFP normalized postoperatively, and the patient remained free of recurrence for 18 months. The authors note that serum AFP helps guide the timing of surgery after chemotherapy.

pmid-7525885.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用療法後に再発・難治となった胚細胞腫瘍31例にパクリタキセルを投与した第II相試験。奏効率は26%(完全奏効3例)で、シスプラチン、イホスファミド、エトポシドに不応の症例でも奏効が得られた。今後は併用化学療法での検討が推奨されている。
pmid-7525885.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated paclitaxel (250 mg/m2 by 24-hour infusion every 21 days, with G-CSF support) in 31 patients with previously treated germ cell tumors whose prior therapy was limited to one cisplatin-based regimen or up to six cycles. Eight patients (26%) responded, including three complete responses, and responses occurred even in patients refractory to cisplatin, ifosfamide and etoposide. The authors conclude that paclitaxel has antitumor activity in GCT and merits study in combination chemotherapy, and that limited-prior-therapy eligibility is a feasible design for testing new agents.

pmid-7527309.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の血清309例と尿88例を用い、切断型ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCGn)の免疫学的認識と臨床的意義を検討した。hCGnは一部のhCGアッセイで反応が不安定であったが、血清hCGを腫瘍マーカーとして日常的に用いる際の有用性には影響しないと結論された。尿中では血清より多く存在した。
pmid-7527309.summary_en: This study characterized nicked human chorionic gonadotropin (hCGn). Its beta subunit splits into two peptides, it is less hydrophobic, and it lacks two holo-hCG epitopes while preserving five beta epitopes. In 309 sera and 88 urine samples from patients with seminomatous or nonseminomatous testicular cancer, hCG-only and hCG-plus-hCGn assays gave parallel results. hCGn was more abundant in urine. The authors conclude that failure to recognize hCGn does not compromise routine serum hCG use as a tumor marker in testicular cancer.

pmid-7528029.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍21例に対し、VAB様の2レジメン(ビンブラスチン、アクチノマイシンD、ブレオマイシン、シクロホスファミド、シスプラチン)を用いた化学療法の長期成績を報告。全体の無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は62%(追跡期間中央値7年)。毒性と有効性の点から、エトポシドおよびシスプラチンを基本とする化学療法レジメンが標準治療として推奨されている。
pmid-7528029.summary_en: This report presents long-term outcomes of two VAB-like regimens (vinblastine, actinomycin-D, bleomycin, cyclophosphamide and cisplatin) in 21 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, given as primary postoperative therapy in 15 and for recurrence in 6. Three of four pure dysgerminoma patients and 10 of 17 non-dysgerminomatous patients were alive without disease. Overall progression-free survival was 62% at a median follow-up of 7 years, and two toxic deaths occurred. The authors favor etoposide- and cisplatin-based regimens as standard therapy because of lower toxicity and better efficacy.

pmid-7528180.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がん52例に対する修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清(MRLND)の治療成績を報告。28.8%で後腹膜リンパ節転移が認められ、PVB化学療法を施行した。原発巣の血管浸潤のみが転移の有意な予測因子であった。MRLNDはフォローアップ方針や初回化学療法と並ぶ選択肢として依然有用と結論された。
pmid-7528180.summary_en: This report describes 52 patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated with modified retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (MRLND). Retroperitoneal nodal metastases were found in 28.8% of patients, who received PVB chemotherapy. Ejaculatory disturbance persisted in 7.7%, and 7.7% of patients without nodal metastasis relapsed and achieved complete remission with adjuvant PVB. Vascular invasion by the primary tumor was the only significant predictor of metastasis. The authors conclude that MRLND remains a feasible option alongside follow-up policy or primary chemotherapy.

pmid-7528606.summary_ja: 46歳女性の胃腫瘍に絨毛癌、肝様腺癌、通常型腺癌の成分が含まれていた症例報告である。免疫組織化学により各成分が同一腫瘍内に別々に存在することが示された。脈管侵襲は肝様腺癌細胞のみに認められた。再発後に血清AFPは著明に上昇したが、hCG-βは正常範囲内であった。肝様腺癌成分の方が絨毛癌成分より増殖性が強かったと結論づけている。
pmid-7528606.summary_en: A 46-year-old woman had a gastric tumor containing choriocarcinoma, hepatoid adenocarcinoma, and common adenocarcinoma components. Immunohistochemistry, including placental alkaline phosphatase staining, showed each histologic type separately within the same tumor. Only the hepatoid adenocarcinoma cells invaded lymphatic and blood vessels. After recurrence, serum AFP rose markedly while hCG-beta remained normal. The authors conclude that the hepatoid adenocarcinoma component grew more aggressively than the choriocarcinoma component.

pmid-7529045.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍13例に対し間期in situハイブリダイゼーションを行い、成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍で認められる染色体異常を検出した。12番染色体の過剰コピーが最も多く、i(12p)は成人に比べ稀であった。1p36.3欠失は病期IVの胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍で全例に認められ、分化型奇形腫や病期Iの卵黄嚢腫瘍では認められず、予後マーカーとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-7529045.summary_en: This study applied interphase in situ hybridization to 13 pediatric germ cell tumors to detect chromosome 1, 8, 10, 12, X, and Y abnormalities common in adult testicular GCT. Additional chromosome 12 copies were most frequent, but i(12p) was rare compared with adults. Deletions of 1p36.3 were present in all stage IV embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, and absent in differentiated teratomas and one stage I yolk sac tumor. The authors propose that 1p36 deletion may serve as a prognostic marker in pediatric GCT.

pmid-7529549.summary_ja: 奇形腫成分を含まない純粋な三相性の精巣ウィルムス腫瘍を報告し、隣接する上皮内癌(CIS)を認めた。CISは成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である。i(12p)を含む染色体異常はCISと腫瘍で類似した数的分布を示した。WT1遺伝子は検討領域で不活化されておらず、H19およびIGF2の両親由来アレルが発現していた。胚細胞起源であることが確認された。
pmid-7529549.summary_en: The authors describe a pure triphasic testicular Wilms' tumor without teratomatous elements, with adjacent carcinoma in situ (CIS), the precursor of adult testicular germ cell tumors. Flow cytometry revealed a single hypotriploid stem line, and karyotyping and in situ hybridization showed an i(12p) with a similar numerical distribution in CIS and tumor. Molecular analysis showed maternal origin of chromosome 12 short arms and no WT1 inactivation in the regions studied. Both parental alleles of H19 and IGF2 were expressed. The germ cell origin of this extrarenal Wilms' tumor was demonstrated.

pmid-7530470.summary_ja: 1989年から1992年に王立マースデン病院で治療した予後不良の転移性胚細胞腫瘍21例に対し、サイクル間隔を極めて短くした加速化学療法を検討したパイロット研究である。中央値36か月の追跡で、2年全生存期間(全生存率)は90%であった。1例は病死、1例は寛解中の治療合併症で死亡、1例は再発後に放射線療法と手術で寛解を維持した。多施設での評価が推奨されている。
pmid-7530470.summary_en: This pilot study evaluated an accelerated, dose-intensive chemotherapy schedule with a very short intercycle interval for 21 poor-prognosis patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital from 1989 to 1992. The regimen combined cisplatin, carboplatin, infusional bleomycin, and vincristine, followed by BEP-type cycles. At a median follow-up of 36 months, one patient died of disease, one died of treatment toxicity in remission, and one relapsed but remained in remission after radiotherapy and surgery. The 2-year overall survival was 90%, and multicentre assessment was recommended.

pmid-7530660.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者47例を対象に、化学療法前および第1サイクルの1、2、5日目にホルター心電図で評価した研究である。PVB療法とPEB療法の間に有意差はなく、いずれも上室性期外収縮を増加させた。有意な伝導障害は認められなかった。心疾患の既往がない若年者では、第1サイクルにおいて重大な心室性催不整脈作用や虚血作用はないと結論づけている。
pmid-7530660.summary_en: Forty-seven young men with testicular cancer were monitored with Holter ECG before chemotherapy and on days 1, 2, and 5 of the first cycle, comparing PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin; n=23) with PEB (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin; n=24). Both regimens increased or induced supraventricular ectopic beats. No significant difference was found between groups, and no significant conduction disturbances were recorded. The authors conclude that during the first cycle, PVB and PEB had no significant ventricular arrhythmogenic or ischemic potency in patients without a cardiac history.

pmid-7530680.summary_ja: 早期の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(OGCT)と性索間質性腫瘍(OSCST)の管理を総説している。若年者には片側卵管卵巣摘出術が一般的に適切とされ、後方視的研究で治癒率は同等であった。OGCTでは病期IA、グレード1の未熟奇形腫や純粋ディスジャーミノーマを除き、術後化学療法が推奨される。早期のOSCSTでは手術単独が許容され、転移例や低分化型のセルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫には白金製剤併用化学療法が選択される。
pmid-7530680.summary_en: This review addresses management of early malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (OGCT) and sex cord-stromal tumors (OSCST). Unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with uterine and contralateral ovary preservation is generally appropriate for young patients, supported by retrospective data showing equivalent cure rates. Surgical staging guides prognosis and treatment. Postoperative chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin is indicated for most OGCT, except well-documented stage IA grade 1 immature teratoma or pure dysgerminoma. Surgery alone is generally acceptable for early OSCST, while metastatic disease or poorly differentiated Sertoli-Leydig tumors receive platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-7532546.summary_ja: 肝細胞癌、肝芽腫、性腺および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍などのAFP分泌性腫瘍について、AFPの糖鎖変異体をCIAEで解析した。胚細胞腫瘍ではConA反応性AFPが減少し非反応性AFPが増加していた。肝転移の由来の鑑別にも有用で、鑑別診断や治療・予後判定への応用が示唆された。
pmid-7532546.summary_en: This study quantified AFP molecular variants (Concanavalin A reactive and nonreactive fractions) by crossed immunoaffino electrophoresis in hepatocellular carcinoma, hepatoblastoma, gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumors, and suspected liver metastases. Each AFP-secreting malignancy showed a characteristic pattern. Germ cell tumors had reduced ConA-reactive AFP and elevated nonreactive AFP. Microheterogeneity analysis identified the origin of one liver metastasis and may aid differential diagnosis, management and prognosis.

pmid-7533078.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の25例にカラーフロードプラ法を施行した。子宮内の腫瘍血管は72%で検出された。持続病変でドプラ信号が検出されない場合は侵入奇胎よりも絨毛癌が示唆されたが、全例が化学療法に反応した。子宮内の血流の程度は化学療法への反応とおおまかに相関し、治療反応の評価に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-7533078.summary_en: This study evaluated colour flow Doppler in 25 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, performed transabdominally at first and transvaginally later. Uterine tumour vessels were detected in 72% of patients. Absent Doppler signal in persistent disease suggested choriocarcinoma rather than invasive mole, although all such patients responded to chemotherapy. The extent of uterine vascularity roughly correlated with chemotherapy response, suggesting Doppler may help assess treatment response.

pmid-7533129.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ病期II 48例(IIA 28例、IIB 20例)の後方視的解析。3年生存率はIIAで82%、IIBで75%であった。再発はそれぞれ28%、35%であった。救援化学療法はリンパ節再発の70%で奏効した。IIAには腹部放射線療法単独、IIBには導入化学療法が推奨され、予防的縦隔照射は日常的には勧められないとされた。
pmid-7533129.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 48 patients with stage II testicular seminoma (28 IIA, 20 IIB) evaluated post-orchiectomy management. Three-year survival was 82% for IIA and 75% for IIB. Relapse occurred in 28% and 35%, respectively. Radiotherapy was the mainstay, and salvage chemotherapy succeeded in 70% of nodal relapses. The authors recommend abdominal radiotherapy alone for IIA, induction chemotherapy for IIB, and do not advocate routine mediastinal irradiation.

pmid-7534146.summary_ja: 精巣がんの化学療法に伴う血管毒性について概説した総説。シスプラチン併用化学療法は転移性胚細胞腫瘍の予後を改善したが、レイノー現象が頻発する。心筋梗塞、脳卒中、肺塞栓などの重大な血管イベントは稀だが、晩期の血管毒性も考慮が必要とされる。治療判断は発生率の低さだけで行うべきではないと結論づけている。
pmid-7534146.summary_en: This review summarizes vascular toxicity associated with chemotherapy for testicular cancer. Cisplatin-based regimens improved outcomes in metastatic germ cell tumors, but Raynaud's phenomenon is common. Major vascular events such as myocardial infarction, stroke and pulmonary embolism are infrequent, though late vascular toxicity should be considered. Causality is probable for some events, while others may be coincidental or disease-related. The low incidence should not drive therapeutic decisions.

pmid-7534631.summary_ja: 精巣がんの国際的な罹患率と死亡率の推移を解析した総説。1970〜1985年に13の集団で15〜54歳男性の罹患率が上昇し、奇形腫とセミノーマの両方が増加していた。一方、9か国では化学療法の普及により死亡率が低下した。環境要因は特定されておらず、早期診断と治療の改善が重要とされる。
pmid-7534631.summary_en: This review analyzes international testicular cancer incidence and mortality trends. Incidence rose in men aged 15 to 54 across 13 populations between 1970 and 1985, affecting both teratomas and seminomas, while mortality declined in nine national populations. Delayed declines in some countries reflect slow uptake of chemotherapy. Environmental risk factors are suspected but unidentified, so early diagnosis and improved treatment remain central to control.

pmid-7543012.summary_ja: 1971〜1993年に京都大学で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の小児12例を報告した。内訳は卵黄嚢腫瘍7例と成熟奇形腫5例。卵黄嚢腫瘍のうち病期I 6例中2例に肺転移が生じ、1例は死亡した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の7例中6例と成熟奇形腫の全例が生存しており、フォローアップ期間は4か月から22年。
pmid-7543012.summary_en: This report describes 12 children with testicular germ cell tumors treated at Kyoto University between 1971 and 1993: seven yolk sac tumors and five mature teratomas. Of the yolk sac tumor patients, six had stage I disease, and two of these developed lung metastases, one of whom died. Six of seven yolk sac tumor patients and all five mature teratoma patients are alive, with follow-up from 4 months to 22 years.

pmid-7544042.summary_ja: 精巣の病理学的病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例で、精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清後40か月で再発した。唯一の所見は血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇であり、併用化学療法により完全寛解が得られた。腫瘍マーカーの上昇のみで発見された病期I精巣NSGCTの遅発再発は初報告であり、長期の腫瘍マーカー経過観察の重要性を示す。
pmid-7544042.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with pathologic stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who relapsed 40 months after inguinal orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The only sign of recurrence was an elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein level. Combination chemotherapy led to complete remission. The authors reviewed the literature and note this as the first reported late relapse in pathologic stage I testicular NSGCT presenting solely with a tumor marker elevation, highlighting the need for long-term marker surveillance.

pmid-7627844.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌が後腹膜、肺、骨、脳に転移した症例を報告する。手術、化学療法、放射線療法を組み合わせた積極的な集学的治療により、良好に治療されたとされる。多臓器転移を伴う稀で悪性度の高い病態に対する治療経験を示した短報である。
pmid-7627844.summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma involving the retroperitoneum, lung, bone, and brain was successfully treated with surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. The report documents aggressive multimodal management of this rare, highly malignant variant with multi-organ metastases. It is a brief clinical report in the International Journal of Urology and is of interest to clinicians managing advanced testicular germ cell tumors with central nervous system involvement.

pmid-7627853.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍50例と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍10例を対象に、予後因子を検討した。3年生存率は精巣が71.9%、性腺外が60.0%であった。絨毛癌成分、LDHの高値、肝・脳・縦隔転移、10cmを超える後腹膜腫瘍が予後不良因子であり、これに基づく予後分類で良好群と不良群の生存率を明確に区別できた。
pmid-7627853.summary_en: This study of 50 patients with testicular and 10 with extragonadal germ cell tumors (all retroperitoneal) with metastatic nonseminomatous disease assessed prognostic factors. Three-year survival was 71.9% for testicular and 60.0% for extragonadal tumors. Choriocarcinoma histology, LDH above twice the upper limit, liver, brain, or mediastinal metastases, and retroperitoneal tumors over 10 cm predicted worse survival. The authors proposed a poor-risk classification that separated patients with 3-year survival of 88.7% and 49.7%.

pmid-7627858.summary_ja: 右停留精巣の2歳男児の症例である。鼠径部探索術で腹腔内精巣に腫瘍が見つかり、正中線を越えて反対側の上腹部壁に及んでいた。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。精巣奇形腫がこのような部位に位置した例はこれまで報告がないとしている。
pmid-7627858.summary_en: A 2-year-old boy with right cryptorchidism underwent inguinal exploration, and a tumor was found in the intra-abdominal testis extending across the midline into the opposite upper abdominal wall. Histology showed a mature teratoma. The authors report that this unusual location of a testicular teratoma has not been previously described and note the rarity of such a presentation.

pmid-7635038.summary_ja: 卵巣がんと精巣がんの治療におけるシスプラチンとカルボプラチンを比較した解説記事である。カルボプラチンは1986年に、シスプラチンより毒性の低い代替薬として導入された。シスプラチンを置き換えられるかについては議論が続いている。両薬剤を比較し、臨床医の選択を支援する内容である。
pmid-7635038.summary_en: This Drug Therapeutics Bulletin article compares cisplatin and carboplatin in treating ovarian and testicular cancer. Carboplatin was introduced in 1986 as a less toxic alternative to cisplatin, and the debate about whether it can replace cisplatin has continued. The article reviews the two agents for these cancers to help clinicians decide between them.

pmid-7674101.summary_ja: 妊娠初期における経膣カラードプラ超音波検査の有用性を検討した。ドプラ所見により妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病型を鑑別でき、全胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎や絨毛癌を区別できると報告している。筋層浸潤の程度評価にも有用とされる。非侵襲的で簡便な手法であるが、さらなる検討と安全性の評価が必要と述べている。
pmid-7674101.summary_en: This paper describes the use of transvaginal color and pulsed Doppler ultrasonography in early pregnancy. The authors propose that Doppler findings may distinguish forms of gestational trophoblastic disease, allowing complete mole to be differentiated from invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, and that myometrial invasion may be assessed. They suggest the technique is noninvasive, simple, and clinically valuable, while noting that further studies and safety considerations are needed.

pmid-7702793.summary_ja: 72歳女性の右卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫で、破裂し周囲組織と癒着していた。組織学的に、エクリン・毛包分化を示す微小嚢胞性付属器癌と扁平上皮癌が良性奇形腫内に同時に認められた。PASおよびCEA陽性がエクリン分化を示唆した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化の稀な一例として報告している。
pmid-7702793.summary_en: A 72-year-old Korean woman had a right ovarian cystic teratoma that ruptured and adhered to adjacent structures. Microscopy revealed a combined tumor of microcystic adnexal carcinoma, showing eccrine and hair follicular differentiation, and squamous cell carcinoma arising within the benign teratoma. PAS and CEA positivity supported eccrine differentiation. The authors describe this rare combination as an example of malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-7711696.summary_ja: 精巣型に類似する稀な原発性縦隔セミノーマの3症例を報告する。治療は放射線療法と化学療法の併用、または手術と放射線療法であった。1例は化学療法中の血栓性合併症により死亡した。生存した2例は26か月および5年の時点で無症状であった。診断、腫瘍マーカー、治療プロトコルについても考察する。
pmid-7711696.summary_en: This report describes three cases of primary mediastinal seminoma, a rare neoplasm histologically similar to testicular seminoma and mainly affecting men aged 30 to 60. Treatments included combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy, surgical resection with radiotherapy, and thoracotomy with radiotherapy. One patient died after chemotherapy was interrupted by thrombotic complications. The two surviving patients remained asymptomatic at follow-up of 26 months and 5 years. The discussion covers embryogenesis, clinical and radiological features, tumor markers, diagnostic procedures, and treatment protocols.

pmid-7713136.summary_ja: 47,XXY核型のクラインフェルター症候群に、縦隔原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を合併した症例を報告する。内分泌変化によりβ-hCG値が上昇していた。肺転移を伴っていたが、化学療法と胸部外科手術により完全寛解が得られた。両疾患の稀な合併とhCGマーカーの有用性を示す。
pmid-7713136.summary_en: This report describes a patient with Klinefelter syndrome (karyotype 47,XXY) who had a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor of the mediastinum. Elevated beta-hCG levels were present, reflecting altered endocrinology in Klinefelter syndrome. The patient had lung metastases. Chemotherapy combined with thoracic surgery achieved complete remission. The case highlights the rare association between Klinefelter syndrome and extragonadal germ cell tumors and the value of hCG as a marker in such patients.

pmid-7721664.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者8例を前向きに追跡した。照射後3か月で多くの患者の精子数が大きく低下した。運動率は維持された。3例のパートナーが妊娠し、正常児を出産した。放射線療法による一過性の不妊は多くが可逆的と考えられる。
pmid-7721664.summary_en: This prospective study followed eight patients with stage I testicular seminoma who underwent radical orchiectomy and then megavoltage radiotherapy to the retroperitoneum. Radiation reduced sperm counts to below 10 million/ml in most patients by three months. Motility remained unchanged. One patient's count recovered to normal by 12 months but stayed below 20% of baseline. Three partners conceived between 9 and 14 months and delivered healthy infants. The authors conclude that radiotherapy causes transient infertility that is often reversible.

pmid-7721669.summary_ja: 1955年から1992年の不妊男性2,739例の精巣生検を後方視的に検討した。16例に片側性の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）を認め、常に精巣萎縮を伴っていた。未治療例の50%が6年以内に胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。ITGCNの発生率と管理、フォローアップの重要性を論じる。
pmid-7721669.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed testicular biopsies from 2,739 infertile men collected between 1955 and 1992. Unilateral intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) was found in 16 men and was always associated with testicular atrophy. Half of the untreated patients with ITGCN developed germ cell tumors within six years. Among 1,639 men biopsied before 1982, three without ITGCN later developed germ cell tumors. The study discusses the incidence and management of ITGCN in infertile men, emphasizing the importance of follow-up.

pmid-7741838.summary_ja: 3歳男児の精巣に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）と成熟奇形腫が併存した稀な症例を報告する。非定型胚細胞の約5%でp53とPCNAの核発現を認めた。PAS染色で細胞質内グリコーゲンが確認された。PCNA、p53、PAS染色は悪性の精細管内胚細胞の検出に有用と考えられる。
pmid-7741838.summary_en: This report describes a 3-year-old boy with both intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) and mature teratoma of the testis, a rare combination in children. Immunohistochemistry showed p53 and PCNA nuclear expression in about 5% of atypical germ cells, while PLAP and 43-9F were negative. Periodic acid-Schiff staining revealed intracytoplasmic glycogen in these cells. The authors suggest that PCNA, p53, and PAS staining may be useful markers for detecting malignant intratubular germ cells. A literature review is included.

pmid-7742500.summary_ja: DNA含量の測定により、部分胞状奇胎は大多数が三倍体、完全胞状奇胎は二倍体または四倍体であることが示された。DNA含量の把握で診断の一致率が向上し、双胎妊娠合併例では診断遅れと持続・転移性疾患の増加が認められた。残存中間型トロホブラスト結節は化学療法に抵抗性であった。免疫組織化学は胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と絨毛癌の鑑別に有用だが、重なる例もある。
pmid-7742500.summary_en: This review covers recent DNA content studies of gestational trophoblastic tumors. Flow cytometry and image analysis showed that partial hydatidiform moles are mostly triploid and complete moles mostly diploid or diploid/tetraploid. Measuring DNA content improved diagnostic agreement for hydropic abortuses and moles. Interphase cytogenetic probes and microsatellite analysis allowed ploidy and parental-origin assignment. Twin pregnancy with a mole was linked to delayed diagnosis and more persistent or metastatic disease. Residual intermediate trophoblast nodules resisted chemotherapy. Immunohistochemistry helps separate placental site trophoblastic tumor from choriocarcinoma, though profiles sometimes overlap.

pmid-7746743.summary_ja: 49歳女性の子宮平滑筋腫手術中に左卵巣腫瘤と大網播種が見つかった。組織学的に良性の卵巣ストルーマ(甲状腺腫)の大網進展と診断された。3コースの化学療法後、32か月間無病であった。病変の本態は不明確で、卵巣ストルーマ由来の高分化濾胞癌の成熟化の可能性も否定できないとされる。
pmid-7746743.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of peritoneal strumosis. A 49-year-old woman undergoing surgery for a uterine leiomyoma was found to have a left ovarian mass and omental implants. Histology showed benign ovarian struma with omental spread and no thyroid neoplasm. After three courses of chemotherapy, she remained disease-free at 32 months. The authors note the lesion's nature is unclear and that maturation of a well-differentiated follicular carcinoma arising in the ovarian struma cannot be excluded.

pmid-7746746.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫に隣接する精巣組織の上皮内癌(CIS)を検討した。成人患者8例中4例でPLAP免疫染色によりCISを同定し、そのうち3例でCIS細胞がp53陽性であった。p53の変異による不活化が示唆された。成熟奇形腫の潜在的悪性度とCISの関連、および精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期発生へのp53関与が考察されている。
pmid-7746746.summary_en: This study examined carcinoma in situ (CIS) in testes adjacent to mature teratomas. CIS was identified by placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) immunostaining in four of eight adult patients with mature teratomas. In three of these four, CIS cells were positive for p53 protein, suggesting p53 tumor suppressor inactivation. The authors propose that CIS in histologically normal testicular tissue near mature teratomas may relate to their malignant potential. They also suggest p53 inactivation may act early in testicular germ cell tumor development.

pmid-7772738.summary_ja: 悪性扁平上皮成分を伴う卵巣癌5例を報告する。2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した扁平上皮癌で、うち1例は上皮内癌であった。他3例は腺扁平上皮癌で、奇形腫を合併した例もあった。組織発生と形態は多様であり、文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-7772738.summary_en: This report describes five ovarian cancers containing malignant squamous cell elements. Three were adenosquamous carcinomas, associated with mature cystic teratoma or mixed mesodermal tumor in some cases. Two were squamous cell carcinomas arising in mature cystic teratoma, one with in situ carcinoma. One adenosquamous case showed transitional forms between squamous and endometrioid components. The authors conclude that malignant squamous elements in ovarian cancer show diverse histogenesis and morphology, with a review of the literature.

pmid-7798304.summary_ja: 再発かつシスプラチン抵抗性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍10例にパクリタキセルを投与した。3例が奏効し、1例は5か月以上部分奏効を維持した。135〜225 mg/m²で毒性は許容可能であった。その後のシスプラチン併用化学療法で4例が奏効した。ドイツのグループによる第II相試験が進行中である。
pmid-7798304.summary_en: This phase I/II trial tested paclitaxel in ten patients with relapsed, cisplatin-refractory testicular germ cell tumors. Three patients responded, though two relapsed after two and four cycles, and one remained in partial response beyond five months. Doses of 135 to 225 mg/m2 were tolerable, with reversible granulocytopenia in all patients. Six patients were retreated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy after paclitaxel, and four achieved responses. A phase II study by the German Testicular Cancer Study Group is ongoing.

pmid-7800439.summary_ja: 8か月齢女児の仙尾部腫瘍は生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、化学療法を受けた。残存腫瘍は画像と病理で成熟奇形腫と確認された。卵黄嚢腫瘍が成熟奇形腫へ逆転したように見える偽性逆転として報告されている。CTおよびMRI所見が病理所見と対比して示されている。
pmid-7800439.summary_en: This report describes an 8-month-old girl with a sacrococcygeal tumor diagnosed by biopsy as yolk sac tumor. After chemotherapy, the residual tumor was confirmed as mature teratoma by imaging and pathology. The authors describe this as pseudoretroconversion, in which the yolk sac tumor appeared to convert to mature teratoma. CT and MRI findings are presented alongside pathological correlation.

pmid-7801148.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによる報告で、進行した悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対しPEI化学療法後にGM-CSFを投与し、用量強度を1.4倍に高めた。評価可能な75例の全生存期間(全生存率)は、中央値27か月のフォローアップで79%であった。用量制限毒性は重度の粘膜炎・腸炎と遷延する血小板減少であった。今後は末梢血幹細胞を用いた支持療法と併せ、標準用量との無作為化比較試験が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-7801148.summary_en: This study from the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) in patients with far-advanced malignant germ cell tumors. Following PEI chemotherapy, GM-CSF allowed a 1.4-fold increase in dose intensity. Among 75 evaluable patients, overall survival was 79% at a median follow-up of 27 months. Dose-limiting toxicities were severe mucositis/enteritis and prolonged thrombocytopenia. The authors propose using peripheral blood stem cells and growth factors to support multiple cycles of dose-intensified chemotherapy, which future trials must compare against standard dosing.

pmid-7801304.summary_ja: 胎盤の胎児面から有茎性腫瘤として突出した稀な胎盤奇形腫の症例を報告する。組織学的に皮膚・付属器、神経組織、腸管構造、軟骨・骨、平滑筋および横紋筋など三胚葉すべての由来組織を含んでいた。分節的な構成は認められなかった。奇形腫の成分が胎盤内にも生じうることを示す症例であり、性腺や典型的な性腺外部位以外での奇形腫の範囲を示している。
pmid-7801304.summary_en: This report describes a rare placental teratoma presenting as a pedunculated mass on the fetal surface of the placenta. Histology showed tissues derived from all three germ layers, including skin with appendages, neural structures, gut, cartilage, bone, and smooth and striated muscle. The lesion lacked segmental organization. The case highlights that teratomatous elements can arise within placental tissue, extending the spectrum of teratoma beyond gonadal and typical extragonadal sites.

pmid-7803244.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療が奏効した直後に急性骨髄性白血病（M2）を発症した症例を報告する。白血病に先行して骨髄異形成期が記録されていた。骨髄および末梢血には胚細胞性悪性腫瘍に典型的なi(12p)を含む複雑な染色体異常が認められた。FISHでは骨髄芽球、赤芽球、好中球にi(12p)が検出されたがリンパ球には検出されなかった。両疾患は共通のクローン起源を持つ可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7803244.summary_en: A patient developed acute myeloid leukemia (M2) shortly after successful treatment of a mediastinal germ cell tumor, preceded by a documented myelodysplastic phase. Bone marrow and peripheral blood cells showed complex cytogenetic abnormalities, including i(12p), typical of germ cell malignancy. Fluorescence in situ hybridization detected i(12p) in myeloblasts, erythroblasts and neutrophils but not in lymphocytes. The authors suggest a common clonal origin for the hematologic malignancy and the mediastinal tumor.

pmid-7805708.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の播種例で化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫3例の、パラフィン包埋標本7検体を用いてフローサイトメトリーによる核DNA倍数性解析を行った。組織学的に良性の所見であるにもかかわらず、全検体でDNA異数体が認められた。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は悪性の挙動を再開しうるため、完全な外科的切除が推奨される。
pmid-7805708.summary_en: Flow cytometric nuclear DNA ploidy analysis was performed on paraffin-embedded blocks from three patients with residual mature teratoma after chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular tumors. All seven specimens were DNA aneuploid despite benign histologic appearance. The authors conclude that postchemotherapy mature teratomas can resume malignant behavior and recommend complete surgical removal. The findings support cautious management of apparently benign residual lesions in patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-7805967.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟奇形腫内に虫垂様構造があり、そこから原発性卵巣カルチノイドが発生した稀な症例を報告する。対側卵巣には形態が類似する顆粒膜細胞腫が認められた。術後に追加治療は行わず、診断から13年後も無症状で良好に経過している。成熟奇形腫内にカルチノイドが生じる例は極めて稀であると述べている。
pmid-7805967.summary_en: This case report describes a primary ovarian carcinoid arising in an imitation of the appendix within a mature teratoma, with 13 years of follow-up. The contralateral ovary contained a granulosa cell tumor with similar morphology. The patient received no additional therapy after surgery and remained well at 13 years. The authors describe this combination as unique and emphasize the rarity of carcinoid components within ovarian mature teratomas.

pmid-7807966.summary_ja: 腫瘍性の胎盤細胞がパラソルモン関連蛋白（PTHrP）を産生することを検討した。免疫組織化学と免疫測定法により、絨毛血管腫、絨毛癌、胞状奇胎でPTHrPが検出された。正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜細胞や細胞性栄養膜細胞なども産生し、栄養膜および羊膜上皮由来の細胞株は培養液中へ分泌した。PTHrPは胎盤腫瘍性病変のマーカーとなりうると考察している。
pmid-7807966.summary_en: This study shows that neoplastic placental cells produce parathyroid hormone-related protein (PTHrP). Immunohistology and immunoassay detected PTHrP in chorioangioma, choriocarcinoma, and hydatidiform mole. PCR confirmed transcripts in placental cells and in trophoblast and amniotic epithelial cell lines, which secreted PTHrP into culture medium. PTHrP was also produced by normal syncytiotrophoblast, intermediate and cytotrophoblasts, and amniotic epithelium. The authors propose PTHrP as a potential marker of placental neoplasia.

pmid-7807969.summary_ja: 成人の混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍9例を対象に、染色体15番の動原体領域のコピー数を指標としてクローン性を検討した。セミノーマ成分と非セミノーマ成分、それぞれに隣接する上皮内癌は、多くの症例で同一の起源を持つことが示唆された。一方、2例では成分間でコピー数パターンが異なった。大半の腫瘍は単クローン性起源であり、上皮内癌と浸潤癌の核型進化は類似していると結論づけられた。
pmid-7807969.summary_en: This study examined the clonal origin of combined testicular germ cell tumors in nine adult cases by counting chromosome 15 centromeric copy numbers in carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and nonseminomatous components. In most tumors, the seminoma and nonseminomatous components and their adjacent carcinoma in situ shared the same copy-number pattern, although two cases showed discordant patterns. The findings suggest that these components generally arise from a monoclonal origin, with karyotype evolution in carcinoma in situ closely resembling that of the invasive tumor.

pmid-7808025.summary_ja: 本総説は、膀胱・精巣・前立腺がんにおけるレチノイドを検討したものである。疫学では血清レチノイド低値が膀胱がんと前立腺がんのリスク上昇と関連し、前臨床研究では増殖抑制と分化誘導が示された。胚細胞腫瘍に対する13-シス レチノイン酸の第II相試験は陰性であった。臨床試験も期待外れであった。著者らは、臨床的利益はまだ示されておらず、有効な患者群を特定するさらなる研究が必要だと結論している。
pmid-7808025.summary_en: This review examines retinoids in bladder, testicular, and prostate cancers. Epidemiologic data link low retinoid levels to higher bladder and prostate cancer risk, and preclinical studies show growth suppression and differentiation induction. In germ cell tumors, a phase 2 trial of 13-cis retinoic acid was negative. Clinical trials in superficial bladder cancer and advanced prostate cancer have also been disappointing. The authors conclude that retinoids have not yet shown clinical benefit and that further work is needed to identify responsive patient subsets.

pmid-7811187.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた病期Iaの腺扁平上皮癌を持つ57歳女性を紹介している。手術後に化学療法を受け、3年間無病生存を維持した。文献上の7例を併せて検討し、早期例は予後良好であったが進行例は予後不良であった。
pmid-7811187.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman with stage Ia adenosquamous carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary is reported. She underwent total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and omentectomy, followed by chemotherapy, and remained disease-free for three years. The authors reviewed seven reported cases of this rare malignant transformation. Early-stage tumors had favorable outcomes, whereas advanced-stage cases had poor survival, suggesting a worse prognosis than conventional squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-7811188.summary_ja: 外科手術が困難な絨毛癌の症例に対し、子宮からの致死的な出血を抑える目的で放射線療法を行い、救命に成功したことを報告している。全身状態が重篤で手術が困難な症例において、放射線療法が有効な選択肢となりうることを示した症例報告である。
pmid-7811188.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma whose surgery was not feasible because a large nodule extended into the anterior vaginal wall and she was in critical condition. Radiation therapy was given to control life-threatening uterine hemorrhage. The treatment was successful and life-saving, and it is presented as a palliative option when surgery is not possible.

pmid-7811190.summary_ja: 縦隔と頭皮に生じた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性2例を報告している。両例とも腫瘍マーカーが上昇し、組織学的に胎児性癌と診断された。シスプラチン併用化学療法により完全奏効が得られ、卵巣機能は回復して出産にも至った。フォローアップ期間中、両例とも無病生存が維持されている。
pmid-7811190.summary_en: Two young women with extragonadal germ cell tumors are described. Both presented with midline lesions, one in the mediastinum and one on the scalp, with elevated tumor markers and normal ovaries on CT. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma in both. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieved complete response, and both later regained normal ovarian function and delivered healthy babies. Both remained disease-free at 30 and 55 months of follow-up.

pmid-7814189.summary_ja: 本研究では卵巣未熟奇形腫244例を解析し、組織学的悪性度が転帰を予測するか、また分類が再現性を持つかを検討した。病期Iの143例では、高悪性度腫瘍の死亡率が悪性度1の腫瘍より著しく高かった。他の胚細胞成分の小さな病巣は予後を悪化させなかった。病理医間の一致度は、三段階分類では中等度にとどまったが、二段階分類では改善した。著者らは、トレーニングと簡略化された基準の必要性を示唆している。
pmid-7814189.summary_en: This study analyzed 244 immature ovarian teratomas, including 143 stage I cases with long follow-up, to test whether histologic grade predicts outcome and whether grading is reproducible. High-grade tumors had a markedly higher death rate than grade 1 tumors. Small foci of other germ cell elements did not worsen prognosis. Interobserver agreement for the traditional three-tiered grading was only moderate and improved with a two-tiered system, suggesting that training and simplified criteria are needed.

pmid-7820136.summary_ja: 本研究は1965～1989年に臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍464例に初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った結果を検討した。病理病期Aの再発率は11%、死亡率は0.7%であった。病理病期Bで補助化学療法を受けなかった群の再発率は32%で、補助化学療法を受けた46例では再発はなかった。神経温存術式により射精不能を回避できると結論している。
pmid-7820136.summary_en: This review analyzes 464 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell cancer who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection (RPLND) between 1965 and 1989. Relapse rates were 15% in the early era and 11% in pathological stage A patients in the later era, with 0.7% mortality. Pathological stage B patients who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed in 32% of cases, whereas none of 46 patients who received adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed. The authors conclude that RPLND remains a sound approach and that nerve-sparing techniques can avoid anejaculation.

pmid-7820137.summary_ja: 本総説は悪性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的要因に関する現時点の知見をまとめたものである。停留精巣が主要な既知のリスク因子であり、人種や地域による発生率の差も大きい。家族例や両側例、泌尿生殖器奇形の合併から遺伝的関与が示唆される。多くの胚細胞腫瘍でみられるアイソクロモソーム i(12p) は診断や予後に有用とされ、発症に関わる遺伝子の研究も紹介されている。
pmid-7820137.summary_en: This review summarizes current knowledge of genetic factors in malignant germ-cell tumors. Undescended testis is the major known risk factor, and environmental exposures early in life are thought to contribute, with marked variation in incidence across populations and races. Familial cases, bilateral tumors, and urogenital malformations suggest a genetic component. The isochromosome i(12p), found in most germ-cell tumors, can aid diagnosis and may have prognostic significance. Ongoing research on genes involved in germ-cell tumor development is also discussed.

pmid-7820138.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の巨大転移に対し化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った際、下大静脈切除または腔内腫瘍栓摘出を受けた42例を報告している。適応は腫瘍の遺残除去、静脈の瘢痕閉塞、腫瘍栓であった。腫瘍栓の病理所見は多くの症例でリンパ節所見と一致した。合併症は一過性が多く、生存率は71%であった。
pmid-7820138.summary_en: This report describes 42 patients who underwent inferior vena cava resection or intraluminal tumor thrombectomy during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection for bulky nonseminomatous germ-cell cancer. Indications included tumor clearance, caval scar occlusion, and caval tumor thrombus, and thrombus pathology mirrored nodal findings in most cases. Complications were generally transient. The 71% survival rate was considered to justify this intensive surgery in patients who had exhausted chemotherapeutic options.

pmid-7820139.summary_ja: 1965～1992年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた710例を検討している。巨大病変の10例で大動脈置換が必要であった。大動脈破裂の主な危険因子は腫瘍固着による広範な外膜下剥離であり、十二指腸損傷や腸漿膜の広範な損傷は大動脈腸管瘻のリスクを高めた。高リスク例では予防的な大動脈移植を検討し、大網間置は瘻孔形成の予防に有効とされる。
pmid-7820139.summary_en: This report reviews 710 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection between 1965 and 1992. Ten patients with bulky disease required aortic replacement, either postoperatively or during surgery. The main risk factor for aortic rupture was extended subadventitial dissection needed because of tumor fixation. Duodenal injury or extensive bowel serosal violation increased the risk of aortoenteric fistula. The authors suggest prospective aortic grafting in high-risk cases and note that omental interposition helps prevent fistula formation.

pmid-7820140.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する初回または救援化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で見つかる残存癌を転帰とともに解析している。救援化学療法後の患者の約55%に残存癌があった。完全切除された53例では、術後の再度救援化学療法の有無で無病生存に差はなく、転帰は切除の完全性に左右されると結論している。
pmid-7820140.summary_en: This outcome analysis evaluates persistent cancer found in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection after primary or salvage chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. About 55% of patients after salvage chemotherapy had residual cancer, whereas after primary chemotherapy most specimens showed teratoma or necrosis. Among 91 patients who underwent surgery after salvage chemotherapy, 53 had complete resection. Repeat postoperative salvage chemotherapy did not improve disease-free outcomes, so the completeness of resection appeared to determine outcome.

pmid-7820141.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の導入化学療法後に残存した腫瘍について、153例（評価可能127例）の後方視的研究で検討している。原発腫瘍の組織型別に残存腫瘍の組織を評価した。悪性成分は各群の一部の残存腫瘍にみられ、非セミノーマでは最小の悪性残存腫瘍が4～5cmであった。残存腫瘤が5cm未満のセミノーマ、3cm未満の奇形腫を含まない非セミノーマでは二次手術を省略しうると提案している。
pmid-7820141.summary_en: This retrospective study of 153 patients with advanced germ-cell tumors examines residual masses after inductive chemotherapy to identify when secondary resection can be omitted. Residual histology was assessed by primary tumor type: pure seminoma, nonseminoma without teratoma, and nonseminoma with teratoma. Malignant elements were found in some residual masses across all groups, with the smallest malignant residues measuring 4 to 5 cm in nonseminomatous tumors. The authors suggest that secondary surgery may be omitted for residual seminoma under 5 cm or nonseminoma without teratoma under 3 cm.

pmid-7820142.summary_ja: 化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた557例のうち45例（8.1%）で、古典的な胚細胞腫瘍以外の腫瘍成分を認めた。内訳は肉腫14例、その他の非肉腫性・非胚細胞性癌18例、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌8例である。原発腫瘍の臨床的・組織学的特徴から予測できなかった。外科的切除で根治の可能性があり、無病生存率は肉腫68%、絨毛癌88%であった。
pmid-7820142.summary_en: This study of 557 patients undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND identified 45 cases (8.1%) with neoplastic elements beyond the classic germ-cell tumor types. These included sarcomas in 14 patients, other nonsarcomatous non-germ-cell cancers in 18, and cystic atypical choriocarcinoma in 8. No clinical or histologic feature of the primary tumor predicted these findings, although orchiectomy sampling error was considered. Surgical resection was potentially curative, with disease-free survival of 68% for sarcoma, 56% for other cancers, and 88% for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7820143.summary_ja: 予後不良の播種性胚細胞腫瘍で、治療反応が不十分な例や再発例に対する治療強化を検討する総説である。非交差耐性薬剤の交互投与や用量強化レジメンは従来法より優れていなかった。造血成長因子や造血幹細胞再輸注を用いた早期治療強化はさらなる検討に値する。第I/II相試験では、治癒困難とされた患者が大量化学療法と自家幹細胞再輸注で救済されており、第III相試験が計画・進行中である。
pmid-7820143.summary_en: This review examines treatment intensification for poor-risk disseminated germ-cell tumors with inadequate response or relapse. Alternating non-cross-resistant drugs and dose-intensified regimens have not proven superior to conventional chemotherapy. Early intensification with hematopoietic growth factors or stem cell reinfusion warrants further study. Phase I/II trials showed that patients considered incurable were salvaged with high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell reinfusion, and several phase III trials are planned or ongoing.

pmid-7821700.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JAR、JEG-3、BeWoにおける17β-HSD1型の特性を検討した研究である。全細胞株が正常ヒト細胞と同一の遺伝子を保持していたが、発現量はJAR細胞で最も低く、BeWo細胞で最も高かった。還元活性は酸化活性の4～7倍で、エストラジオール生成に有利であることが示された。
pmid-7821700.summary_en: This study characterizes 17 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (17-HSD1) in three choriocarcinoma cell lines: JAR, JEG-3, and BeWo. All lines carried and expressed the same gene as normal human cells, but expression levels differed markedly, being lowest in JAR and highest in BeWo cells. Promoter sequence differences did not explain these variations. Reductive activity, converting estrone to estradiol, was 4 to 7 times higher than oxidative activity, indicating that these lines favor estradiol formation.

pmid-7826498.summary_ja: EASF（胚関連免疫抑制因子）に対するモノクローナル抗体H5D12を作製し、絨毛癌細胞が分泌する因子を解析した。免疫組織化学でBeWo絨毛癌細胞に強い染色を認め、分子量24kDの免疫抑制活性を持つ因子を同定した。対照細胞株には同様の活性は認められず、生殖機能の制御因子となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-7826498.summary_en: The authors generated monoclonal antibody H5D12 against an embryo-associated immunosuppressor factor (EASF) and used it to characterize a factor secreted by choriocarcinoma cells. Immunohistochemistry showed intense staining of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, and biosynthetic labeling identified a 24-kD molecule with immunosuppressive activity in a lymphocyte proliferation assay, absent in control cell lines. The findings suggest a unique secreted factor that may regulate reproductive functions.

pmid-7826930.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移により縦隔病変を有した患者が、化学療法への良好な反応に伴い乳糜胸を発症した症例を報告している。悪性腫瘍に伴う乳糜胸は稀な合併症であり、転移性精巣セミノーマでの報告は既報の1例のみで、本報告が2例目となる。
pmid-7826930.summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular seminoma involving the mediastinum developed chylothorax after chemotherapy. Chylothorax is a rare complication of malignancy, and only one prior report describes it in metastatic testicular seminoma. The authors report this second case, which developed as a result of a favourable response to chemotherapy.

pmid-7826931.summary_ja: 縦隔に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）が、初診から19年後に悪性転化した症例を報告している。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常卵巣に生じるが、縦隔にも発生しうる。悪性転化は1〜2%に認められる稀な合併症であり、長期のフォローアップの重要性が示唆される。
pmid-7826931.summary_en: The authors describe malignant transformation within a mediastinal dermoid cyst, a mature cystic teratoma, occurring 19 years after initial presentation. Mature cystic teratomas usually arise in the ovary but can occur in the mediastinum, and malignant change is a rare complication reported in 1-2% of cases. The report highlights the importance of long-term follow-up for patients with mediastinal teratomas.

pmid-7828145.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移巣を細胞遺伝学的に解析し、複数の数的・構造的異常を確認した。染色体12番短腕の異常な分染領域は12p11.2-p12.1領域の増幅に由来し、FISHおよび比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで同定された。この領域は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進行に関わる遺伝子を含む可能性があると推測されている。
pmid-7828145.summary_en: This study analyzed a metastasis of an i(12p)-negative testicular seminoma using cytogenetics, FISH and comparative genomic hybridization. Multiple numerical and structural anomalies were found, including an abnormally banding region on chromosome 12 that resulted from amplification of 12p11.2-p12.1 sequences. The authors speculate that this region may harbor genes relevant to testicular germ cell tumor progression.

pmid-7830338.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（混合奇形腫、肝様αフェトプロテイン陽性、腺管状の卵黄嚢腫瘍成分）を有する22歳男性が、肺・肝臓・骨髄などに広がる悪性組織球症を併発した。化学療法には初期に感受性を示したが、初診から4か月以内に播種性血管内凝固症候群により死亡した。
pmid-7830338.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a mediastinal germ cell tumor containing mixed teratoma, hepatoid alpha-fetoprotein-positive, and glandular yolk sac components also had widespread malignant histiocytosis involving multiple organs. The disease was initially sensitive to chemotherapy, but the patient died of disseminated intravascular coagulation within four months of presentation.

pmid-7832075.summary_ja: 病期Iの典型的セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を施行された63歳男性が、38か月後に縦隔リンパ節のみの再発を来した。CTで縦隔腫瘍を指摘され、細針吸引細胞診でセミノーマ細胞が確認された。COMPE療法3コースにより完全寛解が得られ、治療後8か月時点で無病生存が続いている。
pmid-7832075.summary_en: A 63-year-old man developed isolated mediastinal lymph node relapse 38 months after orchiectomy for stage I typical seminoma, detected by CT and confirmed by fine-needle aspiration cytology. Complete remission was achieved after three courses of COMPE chemotherapy (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, etoposide), and he remained disease-free for 8 months. The authors note that most relapses occur within 3 years and mostly involve retroperitoneal nodes, making this late mediastinal-only relapse rare.

pmid-7832076.summary_ja: 70例の精巣腫瘍のうち脳転移を来した2例を報告している。1例は胎児性癌・奇形腫・STGCの病理像を示し、化学療法中に脳ヘルニアで死亡した。もう1例は胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫で、脳転移に対し切除と大量化学療法が行われ13か月間の完全寛解が得られた。国内文献21例の検討から予後は極めて不良とされる。
pmid-7832076.summary_en: The authors report two patients with testicular germ cell tumors who developed brain metastases among 70 treated cases over eight years. One patient had embryonal carcinoma, teratoma and STGC with lung and retroperitoneal metastases and died of brain herniation three months after orchiectomy. The other had embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor and teratoma, achieved remission with chemotherapy, and had a later brain relapse treated with resection and high-dose chemotherapy. A review of 21 Japanese cases highlights the very poor prognosis.

pmid-7832668.summary_ja: 妊娠26週に喀血と肺腫瘤を認めた女性が、38週で正期産となった症例である。胎盤の3か所で絨毛癌が確認され、分娩後に尿中hCGは急速に低下した。化学療法2コース後の部分肺葉切除では生存腫瘍は認められず、母児ともに良好な経過をたどった。胞状奇胎後の妊娠では胎盤の詳細な検索が必要とされる。
pmid-7832668.summary_en: The authors report choriocarcinoma within the placenta of a woman who delivered at term after a pregnancy complicated by hemoptysis and a lung mass at 26 weeks. Choriocarcinoma was found at three placental sites, and urine hCG fell rapidly after delivery. After two courses of chemotherapy, a partial lobectomy showed no viable tumor, and mother and infant remained well. The authors recommend detailed placental examination in post-molar pregnancies.

pmid-7833667.summary_ja: 34歳女性で、甲状腺の単発結節として発症し、肺および脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の甲状腺内転移例を報告している。針生検では未分化な悪性細胞がみられ、甲状腺摘除後の病理検査で甲状腺内の絨毛癌と確定した。化学療法と放射線療法の併用により良好な反応が得られた。甲状腺への転移性絨毛癌の報告はこれで3例目とされ、きわめてまれな病態である。
pmid-7833667.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with intrathyroid metastasis of choriocarcinoma, accompanied by pulmonary and brain metastases. She presented with a solitary thyroid nodule, and needle biopsy showed anaplastic malignant cells. Pathology after thyroidectomy confirmed choriocarcinoma in the thyroid gland. She responded satisfactorily to combined chemotherapy and radiotherapy. The authors note that this is only the third reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the thyroid, underscoring this rare presentation.

pmid-7835789.summary_ja: 純粋な45,X型Turner症候群の患者で、異形成性の性腺から生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例を報告している。血液と腫瘍の分子生物学的解析でY染色体由来の材料は認められなかった。従来、Turner症候群での性腺腫瘍のリスクはY染色体材料の存在が前提とされてきたが、本例はこれに当てはまらない。過去の純粋45,X症例5例の文献レビューも併せて行われている。
pmid-7835789.summary_en: This case report describes a dysgerminoma arising from a dysgenetic gonad in a patient with pure 45,X Turner syndrome. Cytogenetic and molecular analyses of blood and tumor found no Y chromosome material, which is classically required for gonadal tumor risk in Turner syndrome. The authors review five previously reported gonadal tumors with a pure 45,X karyotype, all supported only by cytogenetic analysis. They present this as the first ovarian tumor in 45,X Turner syndrome in which Y material was excluded by extensive molecular testing.

pmid-7836831.summary_ja: 50歳女性の縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例で、咳嗽と胸痛で受診し、右肺への浸潤と右胸水を伴っていた。血清CA19-9が204.4 U/mlと著明に上昇したが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CEA、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常であった。肺の一部を含めて腫瘍を全摘し、術後にCA19-9は正常化した。組織学的に皮膚、膵組織、軟骨、気管支上皮を含んでいた。
pmid-7836831.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a mediastinal mature teratoma that invaded the right lung and presented with cough, chest pain and right pleural effusion. Serum CA19-9 was markedly elevated at 204.4 U/ml, while AFP, CEA and hCG were normal. Complete resection with the adherent lung was performed, and CA19-9 normalized after surgery. Histology showed skin, pancreatic tissue, cartilage and bronchial epithelium. CA19-9 immunostaining was positive in bronchial epithelium but negative in the pancreatic tissue.

pmid-7839467.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者80例を、精巣摘除術単独後5年以上追跡した。サーベイランスとして腫瘍マーカー、胸部X線、後腹膜CTを行い、36.3%で再発した。再発リスクは血管侵襲、胎児性癌の主体成分、奇形腫の副成分、精巣摘除前の低精子数であった。血管侵襲と組織成分に応じて、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法、サーベイランスを使い分けるよう推奨している。
pmid-7839467.summary_en: This study followed 80 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors for at least five years after orchiectomy alone, using surveillance with tumor markers, chest X-ray and retroperitoneal CT. Relapse occurred in 36.3% of patients. Risk factors included vascular invasion, a major embryonal carcinoma component, a minor teratoma component and low sperm count before orchiectomy. The authors recommend risk-adapted management: retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, adjuvant chemotherapy, or surveillance, depending on vascular invasion and histologic components. Overall survival was 95%.

pmid-7839947.summary_ja: 1960～1985年にナイジェリアのイバダン大学病院（UCH）病理部で診断された奇形腫をレビューした。外科的生検1,000件あたり3.4例で、卵巣が83.2%と最多、次いで仙尾部が6.3%であった。女性対男性比は18対1、平均年齢は25.8歳であった。組織学的に再検討された症例の88%が成熟奇形腫、8%が未熟奇形腫、4%が悪性であった。
pmid-7839947.summary_en: This review of teratomas diagnosed at the Pathology Department of UCH Ibadan between 1960 and 1985 found 3.4 cases per 1,000 surgical biopsies. The ovary was the most common site (83.2%), followed by the sacrococcygeal region (6.3%). Other sites included the neck, testes and mediastinum, while extracranial, intracranial, uterine cervix and intraocular sites were rare. The female-to-male ratio was 18:1, with a mean age of 25.8 years. Of histologically reviewed cases, 88% were mature, 8% immature and 4% malignant.

pmid-7839950.summary_ja: 胸部1例、腹部8例の計9例の類皮腫瘍について、単純X線、超音波検査、CTの所見を報告した研究です。脂肪-液体レベルや「氷山」「ターゲット」徴候がCTで特異性高く描出されることを示し、これらの所見があれば類皮嚢腫に特徴的と結論しています。
pmid-7839950.summary_en: This 1994 case series from Africa describes nine dermoid tumours, one in the chest and eight in the abdomen, with radiological features on plain films, ultrasound, and computed tomography. The authors emphasize fat-fluid levels and the 'iceberg' or 'target' signs seen on CT and ultrasound. They note that ultrasound appearances of fat are variable, making CT more specific for demonstrating fat-fluid levels. The paper concludes that fat-fluid levels with a positive iceberg or target sign are diagnostic of dermoid cysts. The study provides imaging criteria for these mature teratomas.

pmid-7843087.summary_ja: ヒト肝臓や各種腫瘍におけるメタロチオネインの局在を免疫組織化学で調べた研究です。精巣胚細胞癌を含む腫瘍で検討し、分化度の高いセミノーマでは発現が乏しく、分化度の低い胎児性癌では高い発現が見られました。発現は腫瘍の種類や分化度に依存すると考察しています。
pmid-7843087.summary_en: This 1994 immunohistochemical study examined metallothionein localization in human liver and several tumour types, including testicular germ cell carcinoma, thyroid, bladder, and salivary gland tumours. Metallothionein was often high in both nucleus and cytoplasm of malignant tumours, with the strongest staining at the proliferating edge. Within germ cell tumours, well-differentiated seminomas showed little metallothionein regardless of stage, whereas less differentiated embryonal carcinomas expressed more. The authors suggest expression depends on tumour type, cellular origin, heterogeneity, and growth stage. The abstract is truncated in the source.

pmid-7845899.summary_ja: 妊娠27週で胎児水腫と子宮内死亡をきたした、前縦隔の急速に増大する奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査所見と病理所見を示しています。出生前診断は稀ですが、本例は妊娠中期に急速進行し致死的経過をとりうることを示しました。出生前の超音波検査の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-7845899.summary_en: This case report describes a rapidly growing anterior mediastinal teratoma detected prenatally during the second trimester. The tumour caused hydrops fetalis and in utero fetal demise at 27 weeks' gestation. The authors present the sonographic and pathological findings. Mediastinal teratomas are rarely diagnosed before birth, and when found in the neonatal period they usually cause respiratory distress or hydrops. The report highlights the importance of prenatal ultrasound in recognising such rapidly progressive germ cell tumours and their potentially lethal course in utero.

pmid-7847115.summary_ja: 両側精巣がんの症例を報告し、精巣がんの発生率上昇を論じた家庭医学の論文です。家族歴、停留精巣の既往、不妊症、対側精巣容積12mL未満などの高リスク群を挙げています。毎月の自己検査や、対側の上皮内癌を除外するための精巣生検の検討を勧めています。
pmid-7847115.summary_en: This family medicine case report describes bilateral testicular cancer and reviews its rising incidence. The authors highlight high-risk groups, including men with a family history, prior cryptorchidism, infertility, or contralateral testicular volume below 12 mL. They recommend monthly testicular self-examination and suggest considering testicular biopsy to exclude carcinoma in situ in the contralateral testis. Treatment and follow-up options are discussed to reduce long-term morbidity. The article is aimed at primary care physicians, emphasizing early recognition and risk-based evaluation of germ cell tumour patients.

pmid-7848877.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマ（SS）について、組織切片上の核面積を画像解析で定量した形態計測研究である。浸潤型SS12例を、他型のセミノーマや正常精子形成と比較した。SSの核面積は32.5〜56.5μm²と他型より小さく、一部のSSは既知の確率分布に当てはまらなかった。
pmid-7848877.summary_en: This morphometric study analyzes nuclear profile areas in spermatocytic seminoma (SS), a testicular germ cell neoplasm, using image analysis on histological slides. Twelve infiltrating SS cases were compared with intracanalicular SS, typical and anaplastic seminomas, and normal spermatogenesis. SS nuclear populations showed mean areas of 32.5 to 56.5 square microns, much smaller than other seminomas. Statistical tests distinguished most populations, and some SS distributions fit no standard model. The authors argue this finding argues against haploid nuclei in SS cells.

pmid-7855010.summary_ja: 6歳女児の心臓内奇形腫の症例報告である。当初は房室結節腫瘍と誤診された。3年後に再発した腫瘍には三胚葉由来の成熟成分がみられ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。免疫染色では奇形腫内に膵島組織の過形成が確認された。心臓内奇形腫は極めて稀で、診断が困難になり得る。
pmid-7855010.summary_en: This report describes a 6-year-old girl with an intracardiac teratoma initially mistaken for an atrioventricular nodal tumor. The first biopsy showed clusters of epithelial cells in fibrotic stroma. Three years later the tumor recurred with mature elements from all three germ layers, establishing a diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma. Immunostaining showed overgrown pancreatic islet components within the teratoma. The case highlights the rarity of intracardiac teratoma and the diagnostic pitfalls it presents.

pmid-7858284.summary_ja: 本研究は、カルボプラチンの投与前の腎機能と血小板数に基づき、卵巣がんおよび精巣がんの成人患者向けの投与量設定法を検討した。23例の薬物動態・毒性データと4施設の既報値を統合し、モンテカルロ・シミュレーションにより5段階の投与スキームを導いた。
pmid-7858284.summary_en: This study derives a carboplatin dosing scheme for adults with ovarian or testicular cancer based on pre-infusion renal function and platelet count. Pharmacokinetic and toxicity data from 23 patients were combined with published values from four centers. Relationships were established between platinum clearance and glomerular filtration rate, and between platelet reduction and platinum exposure. A Monte Carlo simulation aimed for 5% grade IV thrombocytopenia and produced a five-level scheme. Most patients with ovarian or testicular cancer would receive an initial dose of 900 mg.

pmid-7860203.summary_ja: 20歳男性の、精巣腫瘍が焼け跡型（burned-out）として後腹膜転移で発症した症例報告である。精巣摘除術では精巣網近傍に線維性瘢痕のみが認められた。切除不能な後腹膜腫瘍の生検で絨毛癌と診断され、化学療法を速やかに開始したが、発症7か月後に死亡した。
pmid-7860203.summary_en: This report describes a 20-year-old man whose testicular tumor presented as widespread retroperitoneal metastases, a burned-out tumor pattern. Orchiectomy revealed a subalbuginal fibrous scar near the rete testis, with no obvious primary mass. Biopsy of the unresectable retroperitoneal disease showed choriocarcinoma. Chemotherapy was started promptly, but the patient died seven months after initial symptoms. The case illustrates how a regressed testicular primary can present with aggressive retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7869011.summary_ja: 成人の後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。画像所見から術前に嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、外科的切除により患者は利益を得た。しかし、腫瘍の大きさや石灰化、嚢胞性・充実性成分の有無は良性挙動を予測しないとされ、確定診断には病理学的評価が必要であった。
pmid-7869011.summary_en: A case report describing an adult with a retroperitoneal cystic teratoma. The radiologic pattern allowed a preoperative diagnosis, leading to surgical removal that benefited the patient. The authors note that tumor size, calcification, and cystic or solid components do not reliably predict benign behavior. Definitive diagnosis required histopathology. Retroperitoneal teratoma is rare in adults, and the report highlights the limits of imaging-based diagnosis.

pmid-7870282.summary_ja: 正期産妊娠の9か月後に発症し、肺と脳に転移した絨毛癌の症例報告である。絨毛癌は婦人科以外の症状で発症しうるため、脳転移を呈する女性では妊娠検査により絨毛癌の可能性を確認または否定すべきと著者らは述べている。妊娠歴の聴取が診断上重要であることを示す。
pmid-7870282.summary_en: A case report of choriocarcinoma presenting with lung and brain metastases. The malignancy arose after a full-term pregnancy that ended nine months before admission. Although choriocarcinoma is a gynecologic malignancy, it can present with nongynecologic symptoms. The authors recommend a pregnancy test for women presenting with cerebral metastases, as it can confirm or exclude choriocarcinoma. The report emphasizes the diagnostic value of considering prior pregnancy in such presentations.

pmid-7871632.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例を対象に、フローサイトメトリーと画像解析による定量的DNA測定を比較した研究である。両法は76.5%で一致し、フローサイトメトリーのS期分画や画像解析の5c超過率が潜在性リンパ節転移の予測に有用であった。早期患者で後腹膜リンパ節郭清かフォローアップのみかを選択する一助となりうる。
pmid-7871632.summary_en: Flow cytometry and image analysis were compared in 62 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Both techniques agreed in 76.5% of samples. Aneuploid S-phase and G2M+S fractions by flow cytometry, and the 5c exceeding rate by image analysis, best predicted occult lymph node involvement. The authors suggest these measures may help select early-stage patients for lymph node dissection versus follow-up.

pmid-7872508.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍90例の新鮮腫瘍組織をフローサイトメトリーで解析した研究である。中央値DNA指数はセミノーマ1.82に対し非セミノーマ1.53と有意に低かった。進行例はS期分画の増加や5c超過指数陽性と関連し、リンパ節転移は異数性により92.8%で検出された。セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に寄与しうると結論づけられた。
pmid-7872508.summary_en: Flow cytometry was performed on fresh tumor tissue from 90 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. The median DNA index was lower in nonseminomas (1.53) than in seminomas (1.82), P<0.01. Four of 42 nonseminoma patients had progressive disease, and these patients more often showed increased S-phase fraction or a positive 5c-exceeding index. Lymph node metastases were detected by aneuploidy in 92.8% of available nodes. The authors conclude that flow cytometry supports rapid diagnosis of malignancy and may help distinguish seminomas from nonseminomas.

pmid-7873484.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に放射線療法を受けた病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ患者50例の妊孕性を検討した研究である。残存精巣への線量を2Gy未満に抑えると妊孕性が温存され、出生児に遺伝的異常は認められなかった。治療前の不妊例や治療後に子をもうけなかった例も多く報告されている。
pmid-7873484.summary_en: Studied 50 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy to paraaortic and ipsilateral pelvic nodes after orchidectomy.
