pmid-8207712.summary_en: Study of how cytokines affect hCG production in the Jar human choriocarcinoma cell line, used as a trophoblast model. IL-1 and TNF-alpha stimulated hCG release, while other cytokines had no significant effect. IFN-gamma strongly suppressed protein synthesis. TNF-alpha and IFN-gamma reduced cell viability to 40% and 50%. The authors conclude cytokines may regulate trophoblast function, with IL-1 stimulatory and TNF-alpha and IFN-gamma cytotoxic.

pmid-8217215.summary_ja: 奇形腫由来の細胞株に対する塩基性線維芽細胞増殖因子(bFGF)の作用を検討しています。非腫瘍原性・中等度腫瘍原性の細胞は増殖が促進されましたが、高腫瘍原性のPC細胞は低濃度から不可逆的に増殖が抑制されました。PKC経路によらない機序が示されており、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではありません。
pmid-8217215.summary_en: This study examines how basic fibroblast growth factor affects proliferation of teratoma-derived cell lines. bFGF stimulated the less tumorigenic 1246 and 1246-3A cells but irreversibly inhibited proliferation of the highly tumorigenic PC cells at very low concentrations. PC cells showed only low-affinity FGF binding sites, and inhibition did not depend on PKC signaling. Although c-myc and c-fos were transiently induced, growth still stopped. The work is a cell-biology study of a teratoma-derived model rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-8258730.summary_ja: 類皮嚢腫15例を含む良性卵巣嚢腫41例に対する腹腔鏡下切除術の注意点と改良点を報告した研究である。83%は腹腔鏡下に完遂され、7例で開腹に移行した。チョコレート嚢胞の1例は類内膜腺癌と判明した。嚢腫を大きさにより3群に分類し、巨大嚢腫や妊婦の嚢腫には小開腹術を適用した。
pmid-8258730.summary_en: This Japanese gynecologic study reports technical precautions and improvements for laparoscopic resection of benign ovarian cysts in 41 cases, including 15 dermoid cysts. Surgery was completed laparoscopically in 83% of cases, and laparotomy was needed in 7. One chocolate cyst proved to be endometrioid adenocarcinoma. The authors classified cysts into three size groups and applied mini-laparotomy to giant cysts and to cysts in pregnant women. The approach aims for minimal, safe, and reliable surgery comparable to standard laparotomy.

pmid-8332932.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌幹細胞株(P19、PCC7、F9)を用いて、分化前後の紫外線照射後のヌクレオチド除去修復を調べた。分化により初期切断能が低下し、分化細胞ではシクロブタン型ピリミジン二量体の除去が失われた。denV遺伝子の導入により両状態のP19細胞で修復が促進された。胎児性癌細胞は分化の研究モデルとして用いられ、分化に伴うDNA修復制御の理解に寄与する。
pmid-8332932.summary_en: This study examined nucleotide excision repair in mouse embryonal carcinoma stem cell lines (P19, PCC7, F9) before and after differentiation in culture. Differentiation sharply reduced early incision activity, and cyclobutane dimer repair was lost in differentiated cells, while (6-4) photoproduct removal slowed. Expression of bacteriophage T4 endonuclease (denV) restored and stimulated cyclobutane dimer repair in both undifferentiated and differentiated P19 cells, and also enhanced early (6-4) photoproduct repair. The work uses embryocarcinoma cells as a differentiation model and offers insight into how DNA repair is regulated during differentiation.

pmid-8356806.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来の細胞株が産生するレトロウイルス様粒子HTDVが、内在性レトロウイルスHERV-Kにコードされることを示した研究である。抗HERV-K gag抗血清を用いた免疫染色と免疫電顕により、HTDV粒子との特異的反応が確認された。主題はウイルス学であり、腫瘍患者の診療を扱ったものではない。
pmid-8356806.summary_en: This study identifies HERV-K as the endogenous retrovirus sequence encoding HTDV, a retrovirus-like particle produced at low frequency by human teratocarcinoma cell lines. Immunofluorescence and immunoelectron microscopy with an anti-HERV-K gag antiserum showed specific reaction with HTDV particles, and Western blotting detected a predominant 30 kDa core protein. The teratocarcinoma line serves as the source of the virus, and the work focuses on virology rather than on tumor biology or patients.

pmid-8365561.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞において、レチノイン酸による分化誘導時のEGF受容体(EGF-R)の役割を検討した。切断型変異体またはアンチセンスRNAを発現させ、EGF-R機能を低下させると分化能が低下した。EGF-Rは分化を促進し、チロシンキナーゼ活性を介する可能性が示唆された。臨床データを含まない基礎研究である。
pmid-8365561.summary_en: This study examined P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, which do not express detectable epidermal growth factor receptors (EGF-R) until retinoic acid induces differentiation. Cells were transfected with a truncated kinase-negative EGF-R or an antisense EGF-R construct. Both approaches reduced EGF-R function and impaired differentiation, as shown by tPA and neural intermediate filament markers, with most clones showing diminished differentiation capacity. The authors conclude that EGF-R promotes differentiation, possibly through its tyrosine kinase activity. The work is basic cell biology without clinical data.

pmid-8370079.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清がマウスの移植片対宿主反応（GVHR）を抑制するかを検討した1993年の基礎研究である。親細胞を注入したF1マウスで局所および全身性のGVHRを評価し、上清が急性・慢性の反応を強く抑制することを示した。絨毛癌細胞が免疫抑制因子を分泌することを示唆するが、臨床疾患の研究ではない。
pmid-8370079.summary_en: This 1993 study examined whether supernatants from human choriocarcinoma cell lines suppress graft-versus-host reactions in mice. Using F1 mice injected with parental cells, the authors tested both local and systemic responses. The conditioned media strongly suppressed acute and chronic graft-versus-host reactivity, supporting the idea that choriocarcinoma cells secrete potent immunosuppressive factors. The work is framed around placental immune tolerance and conceptus survival, with the tumor cell lines serving mainly as a source of bioactive secreted factors rather than as a study of clinical disease.

pmid-8375477.summary_ja: 酪酸ナトリウムはF9胎児性癌細胞を可逆的に分化させ、その機序はレチノイン酸とは異なる。酪酸ではjunBが速やかに強く誘導され、レチノイン酸ではc-junが誘導された。両者は異なるjun遺伝子を介して分化を誘導すると考えられる。胎児性癌細胞は分化機構を調べるモデル系として用いられている。
pmid-8375477.summary_en: Sodium butyrate induces reversible differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, and the authors compare this with retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Analysis of jun family genes showed rapid, predominant induction of junB by butyrate, regulated transcriptionally and post-transcriptionally. Retinoic acid mainly induced c-jun. The findings suggest the two agents drive differentiation through distinct jun-gene mechanisms. The embryonal carcinoma line serves as a model system.

pmid-8380175.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞とES細胞が内胚葉へ分化する過程でPTHrPとPTH/PTHrP受容体が誘導された。PTHrPは栄養外胚葉と原始内胚葉に出現する。胎児性癌細胞は初期発生を調べる試験管内モデルとして使われており、発生生物学が主題である。
pmid-8380175.summary_en: PTHrP and the PTH/PTHrP receptor are induced as F9 embryonal carcinoma and ES cells differentiate toward parietal and primitive endoderm. Exogenous PTH or PTHrP can replace dibutyryl cAMP in inducing parietal endoderm. In mouse embryos, PTHrP appears at the late morula stage in trophectoderm and later in primitive endoderm. The authors propose PTH/PTHrP receptor signaling as an early autocrine or paracrine mechanism in embryogenesis, using embryonal carcinoma cells as in vitro models.

pmid-8383002.summary_ja: マウスF9奇形癌幹細胞がレチノイン酸などで分化する過程で、ホスホリパーゼC-γの活性とタンパク質量を調べた基礎研究です。レチノイン酸、dbcAMP、テオフィリンを組み合わせたRACT処理で発現が低下し、mRNAも減少しました。単独処理では変化がなく、RACTが発現を負に制御すると結論づけています。
pmid-8383002.summary_en: This study investigates expression of phosphoinositide-specific phospholipase C-gamma during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of mouse F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells. Under combined RACT treatment (retinoic acid, dibutyryl cAMP and theophylline), both PLC-gamma activity and protein content decreased, and northern analysis showed a reduced 5.4-kb transcript. Treatment with retinoic acid or cAMP plus theophylline alone did not change levels. The authors conclude that RACT negatively regulates PLC-gamma expression during differentiation.

pmid-8384353.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NEC14をHMBAで分化誘導した際のN-myc発現調節を検討した。N-mycは12〜24時間で低下し48時間で回復した。この低下はE2F複合体形成の欠如と相関し、ホスファターゼ由来の阻害因子によるものであった。cAMP依存性キナーゼによるリン酸化で複合体が形成され、タンパク質リン酸化がN-mycの転写制御に関与することが示された。
pmid-8384353.summary_en: This study examined how the N-myc oncogene is regulated during HMBA-induced differentiation of the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NEC14. N-myc expression fell sharply at 12–24 hours and recovered by 48 hours. This decline tracked with the absence of E2F complexes at the N-myc promoter, which was caused by a phosphatase-generated inhibitor. Phosphorylation by cAMP-dependent kinase restored complex formation, and phosphatase treatment abolished it. The findings link protein phosphorylation to E2F-dependent control of N-myc during EC cell differentiation.

pmid-8389547.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株Tera-2を用い、レチノイン酸による分化前後のインヒビンサブユニット、フォリスタチン、アクチビン受容体の発現を解析した。生物活性が高く免疫活性が低い乖離はフォリスタチンによるものと示された。レチノイン酸はフォリスタチンとアクチビン受容体IIBの発現を抑制し、分化に伴うシグナル制御への関与が示唆された。
pmid-8389547.summary_en: The authors examined inhibin subunits, follistatin and activin receptors in the human teratocarcinoma line Tera-2 before and after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Tera-2 cells expressed inhibin alpha and beta B subunits and secreted high bioactivity but low immunoactivity, which was attributed to follistatin. Retinoic acid suppressed follistatin and activin receptor IIB expression during differentiation to endoderm-like cells, suggesting a role in differentiation-associated regulation of activin signaling in embryonal carcinoma-derived cells.

pmid-8389580.summary_ja: 腫瘍増殖が異所性の自己分泌増殖因子に起因するという通説に疑問を投げかける総説である。初期マウス胚と胎児性癌細胞の増殖因子系の類似性を比較し、分化の阻害が自己分泌刺激を維持して腫瘍増殖を招くと論じている。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床ではなく、胎児性癌細胞を中心的モデルとした議論である。
pmid-8389580.summary_en: This review proposes that abnormal tumor proliferation is not necessarily caused by ectopic autocrine growth factor production. The authors compare growth factors and receptors in early mouse embryos and mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinomas. They argue that differentiation shifts cells from growth-stimulatory to growth-inhibitory factor production, and that blocks in differentiation may sustain tumor growth through autocrine stimulation. Embryonal carcinoma serves as the central model rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-8390539.summary_ja: JarおよびJEG-3細胞株を用いて、細胞栄養膜細胞由来のTNF-αの分子的・生化学的特性を検討した。両株はTNF mRNAおよびタンパク質を産生し、TNFは自己分泌性の増殖因子として働いていた。アンチセンスオリゴヌクレオチドや抗p60 TNF-R抗体によりDNA合成は阻害された。Jar細胞はより多くのTNFを産生し、その増殖をより強く依存していた。TNFの恒常的発現は絨毛癌が宿主防御を回避する一因となりうる。
pmid-8390539.summary_en: The authors characterise TNF-alpha produced by cytotrophoblastic cells, using the Jar and JEG-3 cell lines, both choriocarcinoma-derived. Both lines express TNF and its receptors, and TNF acts as an autocrine growth factor, with DNA synthesis blocked by antisense oligonucleotides and anti-p60 TNF-R antibody. Jar cells produced more TNF and depended on it more strongly. The authors suggest that constitutive TNF expression may help trophoblastic tumours evade host defences.

pmid-8395003.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株6種のうち2種で全長のセンス鎖L1のRNAとタンパク質が同時発現することを示した。この2種は胚体外内胚葉への分化傾向が強かった。原始生殖細胞でのL1発現と整合し、マウス初期発生における原始生殖細胞の起源を示すマーカーとなる可能性が提案された。臨床腫瘍研究ではなく基礎研究である。
pmid-8395003.summary_en: This study shows that full-length sense-strand LINE-1 (L1) RNA and its encoded protein are coexpressed in mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Of six lines tested, only two expressed L1, and these were the ones with a strong predilection to differentiate into extraembryonic endoderm. The authors propose that L1 expression, consistent with that in primordial germ cells, could serve as a marker for identifying the origin of primordial germ cells during mouse embryogenesis. The work is basic retrotransposon and developmental biology rather than clinical tumor research.

pmid-8421897.summary_ja: R-U5 PCRと呼ばれる新しい手法で転写された内在性レトロウイルス配列を検出し、ウイルス粒子を産生する奇形癌細胞株でHERV-HおよびHERV-Kが発現していることを示した。HERV-K mRNAは複数のサイズで検出され、外来性レトロウイルスに似た複雑な発現パターンを示した。
pmid-8421897.summary_en: This 1993 Virology study introduces R-U5 PCR, a general method for identifying transcribed retroviral sequences in human mRNA. Using this approach, the authors show that the endogenous retroviral loci HERV-H and HERV-K are expressed in human teratocarcinoma cell lines that produce retroviral particles. Four HERV-K transcripts of different sizes were detected by Northern blotting, resembling the complex expression pattern of exogenous retroviruses. The work links viral particles previously observed in teratocarcinoma cells to specific genomic loci, providing evidence that human endogenous retroviruses can be expressed.

pmid-8429524.summary_ja: 脱落膜LAK細胞による正常栄養膜と絨毛癌細胞株の殺傷に対し、IFN-γの前処理が防御効果を示すことを報告している。IFN-αは効果がなく、JAR細胞はHLAクラスI分子を欠くため常に殺傷された。
pmid-8429524.summary_en: This 1993 Journal of Reproductive Immunology study tests whether interferon-gamma and interferon-alpha alter killing of trophoblast by decidual lymphokine-activated killer cells. Pretreatment with IFN-gamma protected normal trophoblast and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells from decidual effectors, whereas IFN-alpha had no such effect. JAR choriocarcinoma cells were killed regardless of interferon treatment. The protection correlated with IFN-gamma-induced upregulation of non-classical HLA class I molecules, which JAR cells lack. The work focuses on maternal-fetal immunology of trophoblast.

pmid-8453995.summary_ja: テラトカルチノーマF9細胞の分化に伴うHox1.6、c-jun、Oct-3遺伝子の発現変化を検討した基礎研究である。分化誘導にはレチノイン酸、酪酸ナトリウム、温度感受性変異株の3つの方法を用いた。RAR-βとMKはレチノイン酸でのみ誘導された。一方、Hox1.6、c-jun、Oct-3は3つの方法すべてで変化し、分化に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけられている。臨床疾患ではなく発生モデルとしての研究である。
pmid-8453995.summary_en: This basic research study examines expression of Hox1.6, c-jun and Oct-3 genes during differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells. Differentiation was induced by retinoic acid, sodium butyrate, or a temperature-sensitive genetic approach. RAR-beta and MK were induced only by retinoic acid, whereas Hox1.6, c-jun and Oct-3 changed in all three methods. The authors conclude these genes play key roles in teratocarcinoma differentiation. The work uses a germ cell-derived cell line as a developmental model rather than addressing clinical disease.

pmid-8455626.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞において、インターロイキン6(IL-6)とレチノイン酸がOct-1およびNF-IL6をどのように制御するかを検討した分子生物学研究である。両シグナルはOct-1のmRNAとタンパク質量、また異なるAUGから開始されるNF-IL6アイソフォームの比率を変化させた。両経路は重なり合い、Oct-1はNF-IL6の下流に位置すると著者らは示唆している。Oct-1合成の増強はアデノウイルスDNA複製を促進する。
pmid-8455626.summary_en: This molecular study investigates how interleukin-6 and retinoic acid regulate Oct-1 and NF-IL6 in human embryonal carcinoma cells. Both signals alter Oct-1 mRNA and protein levels and the ratios of NF-IL6 isoforms initiated from different AUGs. The authors suggest the pathways overlap, with Oct-1 downstream of NF-IL6. Enhanced Oct-1 synthesis stimulates adenovirus DNA replication, illustrating a functional consequence of this shared signaling. The work is basic cell biology rather than clinical study.

pmid-8456086.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARのスフェロイドが子宮内膜上皮細胞単層へ接着する過程に対するレチノイン酸の影響を検討したin vitro研究である。レチノイン酸は用量依存的に接着を低下させたが増殖には影響しなかった。最高用量では、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌が約5倍に増加し、栄養膜細胞の分化が促進された。本研究は患者の疾患ではなく栄養膜細胞の生物学を扱っている。
pmid-8456086.summary_en: This in vitro study examines how retinoic acid affects attachment of JAR choriocarcinoma multicellular spheroids to a human endometrial epithelial monolayer. Retinoic acid reduced spheroid attachment in a dose-dependent manner without affecting proliferation. At the highest dose it also increased hCG secretion about fivefold, indicating enhanced cytotrophoblast-to-syncytiotrophoblast-like differentiation. The authors conclude retinoic acid modulates adhesion and differentiation in choriocarcinoma spheroids. The model addresses trophoblast biology rather than patient disease.

pmid-8459123.summary_ja: 生後4か月の乳児から、舌下の先天性奇形腫様嚢腫を合併症なく摘出した症例報告である。口腔の奇形腫様嚢腫は稀で、通常は成人に診断されるため、乳児例は注目に値すると著者らは述べている。乳児の舌下病変の鑑別診断と治療方針についても概説している。胚細胞の生物学よりも臨床的認識に焦点を当てた短い報告である。
pmid-8459123.summary_en: A case report of a congenital sublingual teratoid cyst excised without complication from a 4-month-old infant. The authors note that teratoid cysts of the mouth are rare and usually diagnosed in adults, making this pediatric presentation notable. They also review the differential diagnosis and management approach to sublingual lesions in infants. The report is brief and focuses on clinical recognition rather than germ cell biology.

pmid-8472847.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoをメトトレキサートで処理し、胎盤性成長ホルモン変異体およびhCS遺伝子の発現変化を解析した研究である。MTXはhCS/hGH-V発現を低下させ、絨毛性ゴナドトロピンRNAを増加させた。その作用はT3受容体の数ではなく、T3応答性の阻害によると考えられる。胎盤発生における遺伝子の時間的発現パターンの違いも示唆される。
pmid-8472847.summary_en: Study of choriocarcinoma BeWo cells treated with methotrexate, examining expression of placental growth hormone variant and chorionic somatomammotropin genes. MTX reduced hCS/hGH-V transcripts while increasing chorionic gonadotropin RNA, producing an intermediate trophoblast state. The effect appears to interfere with T3 responsiveness of these genes rather than T3 receptor number or affinity. Findings suggest distinct temporal expression patterns during trophoblast development.

pmid-8474445.summary_ja: 多能性P19胎児性癌細胞の分化におけるインターフェロンの役割を検討した研究である。抗体によるIFN阻害は分化を低下させた。分化中にIFN-β mRNAやNF-κBの活性が上昇し、細胞内二本鎖RNAの蓄積とも時期が一致した。IFNの自己誘導による分化制御モデルを提唱している。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的な治療を扱う研究ではない。
pmid-8474445.summary_en: Investigates the role of interferons in differentiation of pluripotent P19 embryonal carcinoma cells. Blocking IFN activity with antibodies reduced differentiation, and IFN-beta mRNA, ISRE-binding activity and NF-kB increased during the process. IFN timing coincided with intracellular dsRNA accumulation and reduced dsRNA unwindase activity. The authors propose an autoinduction model in which dsRNA triggers IFN-beta production that controls differentiation.

pmid-8475056.summary_ja: 未分化のマウスF9胎児性癌細胞では、干渉素やTNF-αによる転写活性化が阻害されることを報告。分化によってこの阻害は解除され、分化細胞にアデノウイルスE1Aを導入すると再び阻害された。未分化細胞には、E1A様の細胞内活性が存在すると考えられる。
pmid-8475056.summary_en: This study asks why undifferentiated mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma (teratocarcinoma) cells fail to respond to interferon and TNF-alpha, which normally activate interferon-stimulated gene factors and NF-kappa B. These responses were blocked in undifferentiated cells but restored upon differentiation. Introducing adenoviral E1A into differentiated cells re-blocked them, suggesting that undifferentiated cells contain an E1A-like cellular activity that represses specific genes.

pmid-8488020.summary_ja: 若年成人の口腔底に生じた舌下類皮嚢腫の1例を報告。9年間にわたり緩徐に拡大し、比較的無痛性の腫脹を呈した。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫と近縁とされ、頭頸部では稀で、症状が乏しいまま大きくなることがある。本報告は臨床経過の記載が中心で、胚細胞腫瘍としての分子・組織学的解析は含まれない。
pmid-8488020.summary_en: A case of sublingual dermoid cyst of the floor of the mouth is presented in a young adult. The lesion showed slow expansive growth and relatively painless swelling over nine years. Such cysts are uncommon in the head and neck, are most often seen in young adults, and may remain asymptomatic until they become large. The report documents the clinical course rather than the germ cell biology of the lesion.

pmid-8502481.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸またはDMSOで分化誘導し、網膜芽細胞腫(RB)遺伝子の発現変化を解析した。レチノイン酸処理では神経外胚葉への分化とともにRBの発現が著明に増加し、神経細胞ではRBが低リン酸化型で存在した。臨床腫瘍ではなく細胞株を発生モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-8502481.summary_en: Expression of the retinoblastoma (RB) gene was studied in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells during differentiation induced by retinoic acid or DMSO. Undifferentiated cells had very low RB levels. Retinoic acid treatment caused a marked increase in RB mRNA and protein as cells became neuroectodermal, with reporter studies suggesting indirect transcriptional activation. Post-mitotic neurons showed hypophosphorylated RB, implicating RB in neuronal differentiation. The study uses an embryonal carcinoma cell line as a developmental model rather than examining patient tumours.

pmid-8507557.summary_ja: 初期発生における増殖因子の役割を概観した総説。上皮成長因子とその受容体、c-fosおよびその転写因子ファミリーに焦点を当て、胎児性癌細胞との関連にも触れている。主題は胚発生であり、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的な内容は含まれないため関連性は限定的である。
pmid-8507557.summary_en: This review examines the roles of growth factors in early development. It focuses on epidermal growth factor and its receptor, and on c-fos and its family of transcription factors. The authors argue that these molecules modulate growth and differentiation in early embryos and in embryonal carcinoma cells. The review is primarily about embryonic development, with embryonal carcinoma cells discussed as one related context. It contains no clinical data on germ cell tumors in patients, and its relevance to the site is therefore limited.

pmid-8507559.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4-FとF9が、基底膜タンパク質ラミニンとエンタクチンの同定に寄与した経緯をまとめた総説。主題は細胞外マトリックス研究であり、胎児性癌細胞は主に実験材料として扱われている。患者の胚細胞腫瘍に関する臨床的内容は含まれない。
pmid-8507559.summary_en: This review summarizes how mouse embryonal carcinoma lines PCC4-F and F9 helped identify the basement membrane proteins laminin and entactin. Differentiated derivatives of PCC4-F, including the M1536-B3 and 4CQ lines, produce extracellular matrix components. F9 cells differentiate into endodermal-like cells in response to retinoic acid. These cells also provided probes for cloning entactin and laminin chain genes. The paper is about extracellular matrix biology, with embryonal carcinoma cells serving mainly as experimental tools. It has no clinical content related to germ cell tumors in patients.

pmid-8507567.summary_ja: 胚由来幹細胞を遺伝子操作に用いた研究の歴史をたどる総説。奇形癌由来の胎児性癌幹細胞から胚性幹細胞へと展開した経緯を論じている。胎児性癌幹細胞の発生能の限界と、胚性幹細胞の全能性を対比している。患者の胚細胞腫瘍の臨床管理は扱わない。
pmid-8507567.summary_en: This historical review traces the use of embryo-derived stem cells for genetic manipulation. It begins with teratocarcinoma-derived embryonal carcinoma stem cells and moves to embryonic stem cells. The authors contrast the limited developmental potential of EC stem cells with the totipotency of ES cells from early embryos. They describe how gene targeting by homologous recombination in ES cells emerged from earlier EC cell mutant selection. The review links developmental, genetic, and cancer research. It does not address clinical management of germ cell tumors in patients.

pmid-8510077.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の培養上清由来の高分子量因子（HMWF）の免疫学的作用を検討した基礎研究。100 kDa超の画分は用量依存的にリンパ球増殖とトロホブラストへの接着を抑制したが、低分子画分には作用がなかった。母体の免疫寛容への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-8510077.summary_en: This study examines a high molecular weight factor (HMWF) secreted by choriocarcinoma cells into culture fluid. Size-fractionated data show HMWF above 100 kDa dose-dependently inhibits lymphocyte proliferation and blocks lymphocyte adhesion to trophoblasts, while lower-molecular-weight fractions have no effect. The effect is lost after freeze-thaw or heat treatment. The authors suggest trophoblast-derived HMWF may contribute to maternal immune tolerance, though the factor's identity remains unknown.

pmid-7685095.summary_ja: 妊娠初期および満期の絨毛栄養膜において、インテグリンα6β4の分布を免疫組織化学で検討した研究である。間質性の絨毛外栄養膜細胞では発現が消失しており、細胞の移動に関与すると考えられた。絨毛癌細胞株BeWoも比較対象として解析されている。
pmid-7685095.summary_en: This study mapped integrin alpha6beta4 distribution in first-trimester and term villous trophoblast, cytotrophoblast columns, and extravillous cells using immunohistochemistry. The subunits localized to basal and cell-contact surfaces but were absent from the apical syncytial surface and interstitial extravillous cytotrophoblast. Primary term trophoblast and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo were also examined. The results suggest integrin loss enables trophoblast migration into maternal tissue.

pmid-11576272.summary_ja: 初回治療に失敗した悪性非ディスジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者42例を、20年間に治療された160例の中から検討した。無増悪生存期間の中央値は6.8か月であった。救援化学療法では、シスプラチン併用療法とVAC療法により約40～55%の患者が無病状態となった。治療失敗は、手術単独や不適切なレジメンに起因すると考えられることが多く、29%の患者が無病で生存している。
pmid-11576272.summary_en: This study reviews 42 patients with malignant non-dysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors who failed primary therapy, out of 160 treated over two decades. Median progression-free survival was 6.8 months. Among salvage chemotherapy, cisplatin combinations and VAC achieved disease-free status in roughly 40 to 55 percent of patients. Failure was often attributed to surgery alone or suboptimal regimens, and 29% remain alive disease-free.

pmid-1279211.summary_ja: 病期I精巣悪性奇形腫41例を対象とした、補助シスプラチン併用化学療法2コースのパイロット研究です。高リスク・中間リスク群22例に補助化学療法、低リスク群19例にサーベイランスを行い、全体の再発率は9.7%でした。歴史的なサーベイランス群の35%より良好であり、今後の検討が必要と結論されています。
pmid-1279211.summary_en: This pilot study evaluated two courses of adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 22 high or intermediate risk patients with stage I testicular malignant teratoma, while 19 low risk patients underwent surveillance. The overall relapse rate was 9.7% at a median follow-up of 2 years, which compared favorably with a historical surveillance series (35%). The authors suggest that a single course of adjuvant treatment merits further study in a neoadjuvant setting.

pmid-1279935.summary_ja: 6歳女児の左卵巣に生じた混合型ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告です。血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に高値を示しました。ディスジャーミノーマは純粋型と混合型に分類され、混合型は他の胚細胞腫瘍成分を含みます。本例では、血清hCGとAFPが治療効果のモニタリングに有用であったと報告されています。
pmid-1279935.summary_en: This report describes a 6-year-old girl with a mixed-type dysgerminoma of the left ovary that had markedly elevated serum human chorionic gonadotropin and alpha-fetoprotein. Dysgerminoma is classified as pure or mixed, the latter containing other germ cell tumor elements. Serum hCG and AFP levels were useful markers for monitoring the response to treatment in this patient, according to the authors.

pmid-1281767.summary_ja: 精巣の未熟奇形腫と胎児性癌の既往がある36歳男性の症例報告です。腹痛と発熱で受診し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右腹部の大きな腫瘤、血清AFPの上昇がみられました。穿刺吸引細胞診で悪性腺細胞が確認され、化学療法後に切除されました。組織学的に類内膜癌様の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の類内膜癌様亜型の初報告とされています。
pmid-1281767.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a prior history of testicular immature teratoma and embryonal carcinoma who presented with abdominal pain and fever. CT showed a large right abdominal mass, serum AFP was elevated at 46.8 ng/ml, and fine-needle aspiration revealed malignant glandular cells. After chemotherapy, the mass was resected. Histology showed a yolk sac tumor with an endometrioid-like pattern, and AFP was prominent on immunostaining. The authors describe this as the first reported endometrioid-like variant of testicular yolk sac tumor and the first report of its fine-needle aspiration cytology.

pmid-1281804.summary_ja: 非ジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の24例に対し、術後にPVB療法を施行した長期成績です。内訳は卵黄嚢腫瘍14例と混合型胚細胞腫瘍10例でした。測定可能病変を有する19例のうち8例で治療が失敗し、本療法は有効であるが満足のいくものではないと結論しています。
pmid-1281804.summary_en: This retrospective series reports long-term outcomes in 24 consecutive patients with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors treated after surgery with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (PVB). Fourteen had endodermal sinus tumor and ten had mixed germ cell tumors. Among the 19 patients with measurable disease, complete remission was achieved in 16, but five later relapsed, so PVB failed in 8 of 19. Five patients without residual disease and with normal markers remained disease-free for a median of 59 months. Toxicity was significant but not fatal. The authors conclude that PVB is effective but unsatisfactory and that other regimens should be investigated.

pmid-1282160.summary_ja: 1983〜1988年に転移性精巣腫瘍47例にBEPV療法（2〜6コース）を施行した研究です。無病生存率は93.6%で、生存者のうち12例は追加治療を要しました。巨大病変を有する13例中10例が生存しており、BEPVは忍容性と有効性に優れた一次治療と結論されています。
pmid-1282160.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 47 patients with metastatic testicular tumours, including 44 non-seminomatous and three seminoma cases, treated with two to six courses of bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin and vincristine (BEPV) between 1983 and 1988. Forty-four patients (93.6%) were alive and disease-free 12 to 75 months after treatment. Twelve survivors needed further treatment, mainly surgical resection or additional therapy. Small-volume disease responded completely in nearly all cases, and ten of 13 patients with bulky disease were alive. The authors conclude that BEPV is a well-tolerated, effective first-line therapy for metastatic testicular tumours.

pmid-1282543.summary_ja: 1980〜1989年にスウェーデンの4施設で治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児32例を後方視的に検討した研究。悪性11例の多くは多剤化学療法で長期生存が得られ、遅発性再発は外科的切除で治療された。出生前診断例は8例で、AFPは経過観察に有用であった。
pmid-1282543.summary_en: This Swedish national retrospective study reviewed 32 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated at four pediatric surgery centers from 1980 to 1989. Prenatal diagnosis by ultrasonography was made in eight patients, with one postoperative death. Among 11 malignant teratomas, most received multiagent chemotherapy, typically cisplatin, bleomycin, and vinblastine. Most patients treated with chemotherapy survived tumor-free for years. Late relapses, all with distant metastases, were managed by surgical resection. Serum alpha-fetoprotein helped monitor disease.

pmid-1282774.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍11例にBEP療法を施行した日本の報告。再発予防例と転移例の双方で実施され、11例中10例が無病生存した。多臓器転移と高hCG値を有した1例は部分奏効のみで死亡した。副作用は可逆的で、PVB療法でみられる神経筋毒性は認めなかった。BEP療法は初回化学療法としてPVB療法より優れるとの見解を支持した。
pmid-1282774.summary_en: This Japanese study of 11 patients with testicular tumors treated with BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) chemotherapy included eight non-seminomatous and three seminoma patients. Some patients without evident metastasis received it to prevent recurrence, and others with metastatic disease received it as curative therapy. Ten of 11 patients were alive and disease-free. The one patient with brain, lung, eye, and bladder metastases and very high hCG had only a partial response and died. Most side effects were reversible, and the neuromuscular toxicity seen with PVB was absent.

pmid-1282775.summary_ja: 女性化乳房と陰嚢腫脹で受診した32歳男性の精巣絨毛癌の症例報告。脳、肺、後腹膜に転移があり、PEP療法3コースで脳転移は消失しβ-hCGも正常化した。残存した後腹膜病変には郭清を行い、5コース後に肺転移も消失した。現在まで無病経過である。
pmid-1282775.summary_en: A 32-year-old Japanese man presented with gynecomastia and a painless right scrotal mass. Orchiectomy revealed choriocarcinoma with mature teratoma, and imaging showed cerebral, pulmonary, and retroperitoneal metastases. After three courses of PEP chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, peplomycin), brain metastasis disappeared and beta-hCG normalized. Lung and retroperitoneal metastases regressed partially, prompting retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Lung disease resolved after the fifth course, and no evidence of disease has persisted.

pmid-1283444.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍230例を7年間追跡し、AFPとβ-hCG、および後腹膜・肺のCTの有用性を検討した。精巣摘除術前の79%で少なくとも1つのマーカーが上昇していた。化学療法後は、マーカーが正常でもCTで陽性所見を示す例が多く、その多くは成熟奇形腫によるものだった。病期Iでは病勢進行の早期検出に有用であった。
pmid-1283444.summary_en: This 7-year monitoring study of 230 patients with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors evaluated AFP and beta-hCG measurements alongside CT of the retroperitoneum and lungs. Before orchiectomy, 79% had at least one elevated marker. After orchiectomy, marker levels agreed with CT findings in 70.4%. After chemotherapy, over half showed normal markers yet positive CT findings, usually from mature teratoma. In stage I patients, combined marker and CT monitoring was confirmed useful for early detection of progression.

pmid-1283936.summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生したAFP産生性未熟縦隔奇形腫の43歳男性の症例報告。術前AFPは5,114ng/mlと高値だった。術後8か月で左胸腔に巨大な再発を来し、呼吸不全で死亡した。再発腫瘍は間葉系組織が主体であった。著者らは、成人の未熟縦隔奇形腫は高悪性度であると結論づけている。
pmid-1283936.summary_en: A 43-year-old Japanese man had an AFP-producing immature mediastinal teratoma arising in the anterior mediastinum, with preoperative serum AFP of 5,114 ng/ml. Histology showed glandular, neural, and hepatoid components. Eight months after surgery, a massive left thoracic recurrence (40 x 24 x 13 cm) caused fatal respiratory failure, although AFP had fallen during chemotherapy. The recurrence consisted mainly of mesenchymal tissue. The authors conclude that adult immature mediastinal teratoma is highly malignant.

pmid-1284342.summary_ja: 東アフリカからの報告で、HIV感染を伴う絨毛癌の3症例を提示したケースシリーズ。長期化学療法で寛解しなかった例、子宮摘除と化学療法で寛解した例、広範な転移を伴う例がみられた。著者らはHIV感染を妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の予後不良因子と見なすことを提案している。
pmid-1284342.summary_en: This East African report describes three patients with HIV infection and choriocarcinoma, a gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. One patient did not respond to prolonged chemotherapy. A second achieved remission only after hysterectomy combined with chemotherapy. The third had extensive metastatic disease alongside other low-risk features. The authors suggest HIV infection may predispose to extensive metastatic choriocarcinoma and should be considered a poor prognostic factor for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-1289250.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍60例と健常者26例で血清ロイシンアミノペプチダーゼ（LAP）を測定した研究である。セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、良性腫瘍で上昇し、治療後には低下したことから治療反応の指標になる可能性を示した。簡便で安価な定量法を、精巣悪性腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーとして活用できると結論している。
pmid-1289250.summary_en: Serum leucine aminopeptidase (LAP) was measured in 60 patients with testicular tumours and 26 healthy controls. LAP levels were significantly elevated in seminoma, nonseminoma, and benign testicular tumour patients. After treatment, LAP levels fell in seminoma, nonseminoma, and mixed cell carcinoma groups, suggesting response to therapy. The authors propose that this simple, quick, accurate, and inexpensive quantitative assay could serve as a tumor marker for testicular malignancies.

pmid-1289273.summary_ja: 46,XY核型を示す性分化異常の患者3例で、性腺芽腫と他の胚細胞腫瘍の合併を報告している。2例は性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマの合併で、1例では奇形腫も認められた。別の1例では性腺芽腫が奇形癌へ移行していた。思春期の2例で悪性変化が強かったため、早期の予防的性腺摘出を勧めている。
pmid-1289273.summary_en: This report describes three intersex patients with a 46,XY karyotype who had gonadoblastoma mixed with other germ cell tumours. Two patients had gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, one of whom also had a teratoma, and the third had gonadoblastoma transformed into teratocarcinoma. Malignant degeneration was more severe in the two pubertal patients. The authors recommend early prophylactic gonadectomy in patients with such disorders of sex development.

pmid-1289765.summary_ja: 1939〜1989年の周産期剖検17,417件から先天性腫瘍46例を抽出した研究である。最も多かったのは奇形腫24例で、子宮外生存が困難な大型例が多く、羊水過多や胎児水腫を伴った。死産例も20例に認められた。先天性腫瘍は小児期・成人期の腫瘍と異なり、奇形や胎児水腫との関連を念頭に置くべきだと述べている。
pmid-1289765.summary_en: This audit of 17,417 perinatal necropsies performed from 1939 to 1989 identified 46 congenital tumors, including 24 teratomas, which were the most common type. Most teratomas were large and incompatible with extrauterine life, frequently associated with polyhydramnios or hydrops fetalis, and some occurred in stillbirths. Other tumors included vascular tumors, neuroblastomas, and rhabdomyomas. The authors emphasize that congenital tumors differ from those in childhood or adult life and are often linked with malformations and hydrops.

pmid-1291571.summary_ja: 閉経前の患者14例に対し、卵巣成熟奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出術を行った報告である。術後合併症はなく、平均入院期間は2日だった。自然妊娠2例と体外受精による妊娠1例が得られた。悪性転化を否定できないため、腹腔鏡検査や採卵時に見つかった奇形腫は速やかに摘出し、胚は凍結保存するよう勧めている。
pmid-1291571.summary_en: This study reports 14 pre-menopausal patients who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign mature teratomas of the ovary. No operative complications occurred, and postoperative hospitalization averaged 2 days. Second-look laparoscopy showed mild adhesions in all patients who underwent it. Two spontaneous pregnancies and one in vitro fertilization pregnancy occurred afterward. The authors recommend prompt removal of teratomas discovered during laparoscopy or oocyte retrieval, since malignant transformation cannot be excluded, and freezing embryos for later transfer.

pmid-1299242.summary_ja: 63歳男性の膀胱原発絨毛癌の症例報告である。無痛性血尿で受診し、全膀胱摘除術が施行された。腫瘍は出血性で、細胞栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞からなり、移行上皮癌成分は認められなかった。免疫染色ではβ-hCGと低分子量サイトケラチンが陽性、CEAとEMAは陰性であった。術後の血清β-hCGは237mIU/mlで、その後低下した。文献をレビューし、診断基準を考察している。
pmid-1299242.summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder who presented with painless hematuria and underwent total cystectomy. Histology showed cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts with extensive hemorrhage and no transitional cell carcinoma component. Immunohistochemistry was positive for beta-hCG and low-molecular-weight cytokeratin and negative for CEA and EMA. Postoperative serum beta-hCG was 237 mIU/mL and then decreased. The authors review the literature and discuss diagnostic criteria.

pmid-1302225.summary_ja: 縦隔後部に生じた良性奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫の発生部位としては稀である。胸部X線とCTで診断された。心膜および食道と癒着しており、完全切除はできなかった。術後1年間無症状で、再発の所見はない。隣接臓器に浸潤する奇形腫の切除の難しさを示している。
pmid-1302225.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a benign posterior mediastinal teratoma, a rare location for teratomas. The diagnosis was established by chest radiography and thoracic CT. Complete surgical removal was not possible because the mass was adherent to the pericardium and esophagus. One year after surgery the patient remained asymptomatic, with no evidence of recurrence. The report highlights the difficulty of resecting teratomas that invade adjacent structures.

pmid-1309382.summary_ja: 病期I・IIの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍459例を対象に、中央病理診断による再評価を実施した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の同定や脈管侵襲の判定で施設間に差があった。中央診断での静脈・リンパ管侵襲は両病期で再発を予測し、血管侵襲は節病期と組み合わせて予後因子となった。AFPおよびhCGの免疫染色強度は血清値と相関した。
pmid-1309382.summary_en: This Testicular Cancer Intergroup Study re-reviewed pathology centrally in 459 patients with stage I or II non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Central and local pathologists differed notably in yolk sac tumor identification and vascular invasion. Venous or lymphatic invasion on central review predicted relapse in both stages, and vascular invasion combined with nodal stage was prognostic. Immunohistochemical AFP and hCG staining correlated with serum marker levels.

pmid-1309383.summary_ja: 13施設で転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン含有化学療法を受けた795例を解析したMRC研究である。肝・骨・脳転移、AFP・hCG高値、5cm超の縦隔腫瘤、肺転移20個以上、高齢が予後不良因子であった。原発巣に胎児性癌や線維組織がないことも不良因子であった。
pmid-1309383.summary_en: This second Medical Research Council study analyzed 795 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-containing chemotherapy at 13 centers. Liver, bone or brain metastases, raised markers, a mediastinal mass over 5 cm, 20 or more lung metastases, and older age were adverse factors. Absence of embryonal carcinoma or fibrous tissue in the primary tumor was also unfavorable. Four factors defined a classification whose good-risk group had 93% three-year survival.

pmid-1310123.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍の男性102例を対象とした後方視的研究で、後腹膜または胸部の残存腫瘍に対する二次手術を検討した。完全切除例は長期無病生存率が75%であったのに対し、不完全切除例では14%であった。切除標本の18例に悪性組織が認められ、全例が追加の化学療法を受けた。術前に腫瘍マーカーが異常であった14例のうち無病状態を達成したのは5例のみであった。著者らは、二次手術は胚細胞がんの治療の重要な一部であると結論づけている。
pmid-1310123.summary_en: This retrospective study of 102 men with germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy describes secondary surgery for residual retroperitoneal or thoracic masses. Complete resection was associated with 75% long-term disease-free survival, versus 14% after incomplete resection. Malignant tissue was found in 18 patients, all of whom received further chemotherapy. Resection despite preoperatively abnormal tumor markers yielded disease-free status in only 5 of 14 patients. The authors conclude that secondary surgery is an important part of treatment for germ cell cancer.

pmid-1310437.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ7例と古典的セミノーマ25例を免疫組織化学とDNAフローサイトメトリーで比較した研究。精母細胞性セミノーマは胎盤様アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）が陰性で、古典的セミノーマとの鑑別に有用であることを示した。また悪性リンパ腫との鑑別にはLCA染色が有用とされる。
pmid-1310437.summary_en: This immunohistochemical and DNA flow cytometry study compared seven spermatocytic seminomas with 25 classic seminomas. Spermatocytic seminomas were negative for placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), whereas classic seminomas were uniformly positive. Spermatocytic seminomas were also negative for AFP, beta-hCG, and LCA, and most had diploid or near-diploid DNA content. The authors conclude that PLAP staining helps distinguish classic seminoma from spermatocytic seminoma, and LCA staining helps separate spermatocytic seminoma from malignant lymphoma.

pmid-1310514.summary_ja: 成人精巣の上皮内癌と浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍のDNA倍数性をフローサイトメトリーで比較した研究。上皮内癌のDNA指数中央値はセミノーマと同程度で、浸潤性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍より高かった。上皮内癌とセミノーマは表現型だけでなく倍数性も共通しており、両者の生物学的関連を支持する。
pmid-1310514.summary_en: This DNA flow cytometry study compared ploidy of testicular carcinoma in situ with invasive adult germ cell tumors. The median DNA index of carcinoma in situ was similar to that of seminomas and higher than that of invasive nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. These findings indicate that seminoma and carcinoma in situ cells share both phenotypic features and ploidy. The study supports a close biological relationship between carcinoma in situ and seminoma within testicular germ cell tumor development.

pmid-1311621.summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児の肝腫瘍で、肝芽腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の両方の組織像を示した症例報告。この形態パターンは既報がないとされる。腫瘍の組織発生について考察している。卵黄嚢腫瘍は性腺外に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の成分であり、小児の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の形態と鑑別診断に関連する。
pmid-1311621.summary_en: This case report describes a liver tumor in a 6-month-old boy showing combined histology of hepatoblastoma and yolk sac tumor. The authors state this morphologic pattern had not been previously reported. The paper discusses theories of histogenesis for this combined tumor. Because yolk sac tumor is a germ cell tumor component arising at an extragonadal site, the report is relevant to pediatric extragonadal GCT morphology and differential diagnosis.

pmid-1312111.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者20例に対し、MRI、CT、デジタルサブトラクション血管造影を比較した研究。MRIでは胞状奇胎の所見が病理所見とよく一致した。侵入奇胎および絨毛癌の筋層内病変の検出率はMRIが83%、CTが50%だった。MRIは筋層内浸潤の診断に有用で、DSAとの併用が診断精度を高めると結論づけている。
pmid-1312111.summary_en: This Japanese study evaluated MRI, CT, and digital subtraction angiography in 20 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. MRI findings of hydatidiform mole corresponded closely with histopathology. MRI detected intramural lesions of invasive mole and choriocarcinoma in 83% of cases, compared with 50% for CT. Obliteration of the junctional zone and myometrial interruption on MRI indicated intramural invasion. The authors conclude that MRI is powerful for detecting intramural invasion and that combined MRI and DSA improves diagnosis.

pmid-1312306.summary_ja: 閉経後女性2例で、hCG産生肺腫瘍（大細胞癌と絨毛癌各1例）によるエストロゲン過剰が子宮出血の原因と考えられた。両腫瘍は胎盤性ペプチドを発現し、血清hCGは著明高値だった。肺絨毛癌例は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの意義に関連する。
pmid-1312306.summary_en: This report describes two postmenopausal women whose uterine bleeding was attributed to estrogen produced by hCG-secreting lung tumors, one large cell carcinoma and one choriocarcinoma. Both tumors expressed placental peptides, and both patients had markedly elevated serum hCG. Clinical and hormonal findings suggested that tumor steroid biotransformation caused estrogen excess and endometrial bleeding. The choriocarcinoma case is relevant to extragonadal germ cell tumor biology and to hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-1312586.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がんで化学療法後に残存する20mm未満の後腹膜腫瘤を有する78例を解析した。完全線維化/壊死が51例、成熟奇形腫が22例、生存する悪性胚細胞腫瘍が5例であった。原発腫瘍に未分化悪性奇形腫があり化学療法前の腫瘍マーカーが正常な症例では、線維化/壊死が全例で認められた。こうした症例では郭清を省略できる可能性を示した。
pmid-1312586.summary_en: Seventy-eight patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer and residual retroperitoneal masses under 20 mm underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Histology showed fibrosis or necrosis in 51, mature teratoma in 22, and viable malignant germ cell tumor in five. Alpha-fetoprotein rose before surgery in two of those five. Among patients with normal tumor markers, undifferentiated malignant teratoma in the primary tumor and normal prechemotherapy markers predicted fibrosis or necrosis. The authors suggest omitting surgery in selected patients with these features.

pmid-1312702.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍59例を免疫組織化学染色で解析し、6例でLINE-1（L1Hs）の発現を認めた。陽性細胞は上皮様で、胎児性癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞に似ていた。陽性腫瘍の肺・リンパ節転移巣でも発現が見られた。ヒト組織でのレトロトランスポゾン発現の初の報告であり、L1Hsがある種のがんで癌原遺伝子として働く可能性を示唆した。
pmid-1312702.summary_en: Using an antibody against the first open reading frame protein of the human LINE-1 (L1Hs) retrotransposon, the authors immunostained 59 formalin-fixed human testicular germ cell tumors. Six were L1Hs-positive. Positive cells were epithelial and mostly resembled embryonal carcinoma or yolk sac tumor cells. A lung and lymph node metastasis from one positive tumor also expressed L1Hs. The authors describe this as the first report of widespread retrotransposon expression in human tissue and suggest that L1Hs-encoded proteins may act as oncoproteins in some cancers.

pmid-1312877.summary_ja: 縦隔前部に多い縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を総説した。良性奇形腫は完全切除で治癒することが多い。セミノーマは放射線療法やシスプラチン併用化学療法がよく奏効する。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は予後が不良だが、近年の治療で約半数が生存する。未分化な縦隔癌は胚細胞腫瘍の可能性を検討すべきである。
pmid-1312877.summary_en: This review covers mediastinal germ cell tumors, which are among the most common anterior mediastinal neoplasms. Benign teratomas are usually cured by complete resection. Seminomas respond well to radiotherapy or cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Nonseminomatous tumors have a poorer prognosis, but about half of patients survive with modern cisplatin regimens. Poorly differentiated mediastinal carcinomas should be evaluated as possible germ cell tumors. Nonseminomas are associated with nongerm cell malignancies such as rhabdomyosarcoma and hematologic cancers, likely reflecting the multipotential nature of primitive germ cells.

pmid-1313282.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴うサルコイド型肺リンパ節腫脹の8例を報告した。全身性サルコイドーシスの強い根拠が5例で得られた。全身性サルコイドーシス3例では、追加治療を要する精巣がんを同時に有していた。従来の報告は全身性サルコイドーシスと腫瘍に対する局所的な肉芽腫反応を区別していなかったため、徹底的な検索を勧めている。
pmid-1313282.summary_en: The authors describe eight patients with sarcoid-type pulmonary lymphadenopathy associated with testicular germ cell tumors, adding to 14 previously reported cases. Five had strong evidence of systemic sarcoidosis. Three of those with systemic sarcoidosis also had coexisting testicular cancer requiring additional treatment. The authors caution that earlier reports did not distinguish systemic sarcoidosis from a local granulomatous reaction to tumor. They recommend thorough investigation of such cases before interpreting clinical and histological findings.

pmid-1313741.summary_ja: メモリアル・スローン・ケタリングがんセンターで連続登録された成人男性胚細胞腫瘍124例の細胞遺伝学的解析を報告した。i(12p)の頻度は非セミノーマで高かった。奇形腫では1p32-36と7q11.2、卵黄嚢腫瘍では1p22に染色体再編成が見られた。性腺外病変の24%で遺伝子増幅があり、主に転移病変であった。転移進展に関連する遺伝子を示唆している。
pmid-1313741.summary_en: The authors performed cytogenetic analysis on 124 consecutively ascertained adult male germ cell tumors at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center. Samples included testicular and extragonadal primary and metastatic lesions across histologic subtypes. Isochromosome 12p was more frequent in nonseminomas than seminomas. Teratomas showed rearrangements at 1p32-36 and 7q11.2, and yolk sac tumors at 1p22. Gene amplification appeared in 24% of extragonadal lesions, mostly metastatic, suggesting genes linked to metastatic progression.

pmid-1314021.summary_ja: 男性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。血栓塞栓症や両側気胸などの腫瘍関連合併症が出現するまで診断されなかった。胚細胞腫瘍は発生部位に起因する症状で発見されることが多く、診断の遅れにつながりうる。原因不明の血栓塞栓症や肺合併症では、胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含める必要性を示している。
pmid-1314021.summary_en: This case report describes a man with an extragonadal germ cell tumor that went undiagnosed until he developed several tumor-related complications, including thromboembolism and bilateral pneumothorax. It highlights that germ cell tumors often present through symptoms attributed to their location, which can delay diagnosis. The report underscores the importance of considering germ cell tumor in patients with unexplained thromboembolic and pulmonary complications.

pmid-1314276.summary_ja: 頭頸部に生じる悪性胚細胞腫瘍はきわめてまれで、積極的な手術と補助療法を行っても多くは致死的経過をたどる。本稿では頸部胎児性癌の1例を提示し、臨床像、経過、治療を文献的に概説している。予後不良な腫瘍であるため、臨床医による早期認識の重要性を示している。
pmid-1314276.summary_en: This report describes malignant germ cell tumours of the head and neck, which are extremely rare and usually fatal despite aggressive surgery and adjuvant therapy. The authors present a case of cervical embryonal carcinoma and review the presentation, clinical course, and treatment of such tumours. The review highlights the poor prognosis of these neoplasms and the need for clinician awareness to enable earlier recognition.

pmid-1314733.summary_ja: 卵巣のまれな腫瘍について、腹水および腹腔洗浄液の細胞診所見を検討した報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、Sertoli-Leydig細胞腫などが対象である。Sertoli-Leydig細胞腫の細胞学的特徴はこれまで十分に記載されていなかった。正確な分類のため、細胞ブロック、免疫細胞化学、組織所見との対比が重要と強調している。
pmid-1314733.summary_en: This cytology study describes the ascitic fluid and peritoneal washing findings of uncommon ovarian tumors, including endodermal sinus tumor, dysgerminoma, Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor, and malignant mixed Müllerian tumor. Cytologic features of Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors are highlighted as poorly described previously. The authors emphasize that correlating cytology with cell-block preparations, immunocytochemistry, and histology is essential for accurate classification in differential diagnosis.

pmid-1315103.summary_ja: 妊娠7週の卵管妊娠に発生した妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告である。患側卵管切除術と単剤のアクチノマイシンD化学療法で治癒した。4年後のフォローアップで再発はなく、その後2回正常分娩を経験している。異所妊娠に対する保存的治療が増える中、まれな絨毛癌を見逃さないためβ-hCGのモニタリングが必要と述べている。
pmid-1315103.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma arising in a 7-week tubal ectopic pregnancy. Treatment with unilateral salpingectomy and single-agent actinomycin-D chemotherapy achieved cure. At four-year follow-up there was no recurrence, and the patient had two normal births. The authors note that with increasing conservative management of ectopic pregnancy, beta-hCG monitoring is needed to avoid missing this rare choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1316595.summary_ja: 本総説は、1980年代に進展した早期の外陰腟横紋筋肉腫、DES関連腟明細胞腺癌、片側卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の保存的治療を概説する。横紋筋肉腫ではVAC化学療法後に局所切除または放射線療法を行い、妊孕性を温存しつつ高い治癒率が得られる。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では片側卵巣摘出後にシスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる補助療法で高い治癒率と妊孕性温存が得られ、標準治療になると考えられる。
pmid-1316595.summary_en: This review describes advances in the 1980s in managing early-stage vulvovaginal rhabdomyosarcoma, DES-related vaginal clear cell adenocarcinoma, and unilateral ovarian germ cell tumors. For rhabdomyosarcoma, VAC chemotherapy followed by local excision or radiation achieves high cure rates while preserving fertility. For DES-related vaginal adenocarcinoma, wide local excision with localized radiation gives similar outcomes. For unilateral ovarian germ cell tumors, salpingo-oophorectomy followed by cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin achieves high cure and fertility retention, and is likely to become standard therapy, including for dysgerminoma.

pmid-1316778.summary_ja: 1975年から1986年のニュージーランドのデータで、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率はマオリ人で10万人あたり6.84と、非マオリ人の5.26より高かった。差は特に15～49歳の年齢層で大きかった。白人で最も発生率が高いとの従来の報告があり、著者はその差異の要因や他の疫学的特徴について考察している。
pmid-1316778.summary_en: This epidemiological study of New Zealand data from 1975 to 1986 found that testicular germ cell cancer incidence was higher in Maori (6.84 per 100,000) than in non-Maori (5.26 per 100,000), especially among those aged 15 to 49. Previous studies have shown Whites to have the highest incidence. The authors discuss possible reasons for these differences and other epidemiological features of the disease.

pmid-1317386.summary_ja: 4種の絨毛癌細胞株について、サイトカイン産生と応答を検討した。JarとHCCM-5細胞は恒常的にIL-6を産生し、IL-6およびIL-1に応答してhCGを放出した。NUC-1とSCH細胞は応答しなかった。cAMP刺激によるhCG放出は抗IL-6受容体抗体やPKA阻害剤で抑制されず、IL-1・IL-6経路はcAMP依存性経路とは独立して働くことが示唆された。
pmid-1317386.summary_en: Four choriocarcinoma cell lines were examined for cytokine production and responses. Jar and HCCM-5 cells constitutively released IL-6 and responded to both IL-6 and IL-1 by releasing hCG, indicating a partly intact autocrine cytokine cascade. NUC-1 and SCH cells did not respond. cAMP stimulated hCG release through a pathway not blocked by an anti-IL-6 receptor antibody or a PKA inhibitor. The authors suggest that IL-1- and IL-6-mediated hCG release operates independently of the cAMP-dependent pathway.

pmid-1317652.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の中に発生した、無色素性の原発性卵巣悪性黒色腫の稀な症例を報告する。卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は約2%にみられるに過ぎない。臨床所見と病理組織学的所見を提示し、胚細胞腫瘍内で生じる稀な悪性転化の形態を示している。本症例は極めて稀である。
pmid-1317652.summary_en: This case report describes a rare primary ovarian malignant melanoma of the amelanotic type that arose within an ovarian dermoid cyst. Malignant transformation occurs in only about 2% of ovarian dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas. The authors present the clinical and histopathological findings of this unusual case, illustrating a rare form of malignant change within a germ cell tumor.

pmid-1318004.summary_ja: フローサイトメトリーを用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍148例と隣接する上皮内癌（CIS）のDNA倍数性を調べた。ほぼ全例が異数性を示した。CISとセミノーマのDNA指数は類似し、非セミノーマは低値であった。CISとセミノーマは腫瘍進展の段階的過程を示し、非セミノーマはさらなるDNA喪失で生じると考察され、精巣腫瘤の評価に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-1318004.summary_en: Flow cytometry measured DNA ploidy in 148 testicular germ cell tumours, including seminomas and nonseminomas, and adjacent carcinoma in situ. Nearly all tumours were aneuploid. CIS and seminoma had similar DNA indices, whereas nonseminomas had lower indices. The authors propose that CIS and seminoma represent sequential steps in tumour progression and that nonseminomas arise from either by further DNA loss. These findings support a nonstochastic model of germ cell evolution and may aid clinicopathologic evaluation of testicular masses.

pmid-1318262.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に先天的な染色体不安定性があるという仮説を検討した研究です。手術のみで治療された患者20名と健常対照20名のリンパ球を比較しましたが、患者群で構造異常の増加は認められませんでした。対照群で染色体の欠失が多いという予想外の結果も得られています。先行研究をレビューし、不安定性の大幅な増加を否定する信頼区間を算出しています。
pmid-1318262.summary_en: This study examined whether men with testicular germ cell tumors have constitutional chromosome instability. Lymphocytes from 20 patients treated with surgery alone were compared with those from 20 healthy controls using G-banding. Structural aberrations were not increased in patients. Unexpectedly, chromosome losses were more frequent in controls, and the loss pattern differed between groups, mainly affecting small chromosomes in controls. The authors reviewed prior literature claiming instability and calculated confidence intervals that excluded a substantial increase in instability.

pmid-1318827.summary_ja: 縦隔や後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍5例を、細胞診材料の電子顕微鏡で診断した報告です。臨床診断は全例で誤っており、光学顕微鏡では細胞型を特定できない場合が多くありました。電子顕微鏡は少量や壊死性の検体でも有用で、セミノーマと非セミノーマの密接な関係を示し、分類や予後に影響する可能性があります。
pmid-1318827.summary_en: Five cases of extragonadal germ cell tumor were diagnosed by electron microscopy on fine-needle aspiration cytology material. Clinical diagnoses were incorrect in all cases, and light microscopy identified malignant cells but often could not determine the cytotype. Ultrasonography, laparoscopy, and autopsy excluded a primary gonadal tumor. Histology confirmed the EM diagnoses in every case. The authors conclude that EM is useful even for scanty or necrotic cytology samples, particularly from mediastinal and retroperitoneal masses, and that it reveals close relationships between seminomatous and nonseminomatous components, which may affect classification and prognosis.

pmid-1318844.summary_ja: 34歳男性で、肺塞栓と下大静脈から右心房に及ぶ血栓を認めた症例です。精巣のセミノーマと胎児性癌の混合型で、大きな後腹膜病変と内臓転移がありました。大静脈切除は行わず、併用化学療法と抗凝固療法で治療し、その後残存腫瘤を切除しました。19か月後も無病の状態でした。大静脈血栓を伴う例で、静脈切除なしに化学療法で治療に成功した報告は見当たらなかったとしています。
pmid-1318844.summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with pulmonary emboli and inferior vena cava thrombosis extending into the right atrium. He had mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma of the testis with bulky retroperitoneal disease and visceral metastases. He was treated with combination chemotherapy and anticoagulation without caval resection, followed by resection of the residual mass. He remained free of disease at 19 months. The authors note that they found no previous report of successful chemotherapy without vena cava resection in such bulky retroperitoneal disease with caval thrombosis.

pmid-1319383.summary_ja: 1979年から1990年に治療された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍135例で、7種類の腫瘍マーカーを検討しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が全例陽性でした。CA125は悪性胚細胞腫瘍のスクリーニングに有用で、奇形腫性腫瘍ではCA19-9が高率に陽性となりました。ディスジャーミノーマや卵黄嚢腫瘍ではLDHが高値を示し、TPAとCEAは有用ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-1319383.summary_en: This Japanese multi-institutional study analyzed seven tumor markers in 135 patients with ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1979 and 1990. AFP was positive in 100% of yolk sac tumors but rarely in dysgerminomas or mature teratomas. CA125 was positive in most tumor types except mature cystic teratoma and was useful for screening malignant germ cell tumors. CA19-9 was frequently elevated in teratomatous tumors, and LDH was high in dysgerminomas and yolk sac tumors. TPA and CEA were not considered useful.

pmid-1319825.summary_ja: 白金ベース化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者36名の血液で、7種類の生物学的マーカーを解析しました。白金-タンパク質付加体、白金-DNA付加体、姉妹染色分体交換(SCE)は治療後に上昇し、3〜6か月後も高値のままでした。小核や遺伝子変異のマーカーは、用量に対する反応パターンがさまざまでした。治療群ごとに一貫した傾向は見られませんでした。
pmid-1319825.summary_en: Blood samples from 36 germ cell tumor patients receiving platinum-based chemotherapy were analyzed for seven biological markers, including platinum-protein and platinum-DNA adducts, sister chromatid exchange, micronuclei, and HPRT and glycophorin A mutations. Platinum adducts, SCE, and their correlates rose after treatment and remained elevated 3-6 months later. Micronuclei and mutation markers showed varying dose-response patterns. The abstract is truncated, and no consistent pattern was seen across treatment groups.

pmid-1320303.summary_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣がん63例の前向き研究です。シスプラチン併用化学療法後に外科的切除を要した残存腫瘤は37%でした。切除例の78%は成熟奇形腫で、壊死を伴う線維化や残存腫瘍も見られました。初回化学療法時に原発腫瘍の奇形腫成分と大きな転移性病変があることが、手術の必要性の強力な予測因子でした。
pmid-1320303.summary_en: In a prospective study of 63 patients with stage III nonseminomatous testicular cancer, 23 (37%) required surgical resection of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Of these, 78% had mature teratoma, 13% fibrosis with necrosis, and 9% residual tumor. Teratomatous elements in the primary tumor combined with bulky metastatic disease at initial chemotherapy predicted the need for surgery in 91% of patients with residual disease. Two patients had incomplete resection and needed further surgery for growing mature teratomas.

pmid-1320452.summary_ja: 臨床的に腫瘍を認めない男性3名の精巣生検で、微小浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍性病変が見つかった報告です。精巣摘除標本では、管内および管外に多発する腫瘍性胚細胞が認められました。微小浸潤は確定的な悪性腫瘍であり、セミノーマや非セミノーマ性腫瘍の出発点となります。原発治療として鼠径部精巣摘除術を推奨し、補助療法の必要性は今後の検討課題としています。
pmid-1320452.summary_en: The authors describe three men without clinical tumors whose testicular biopsies showed microinvasive germ cell neoplasia. Orchiectomy specimens revealed multifocal intratubular and extratubular neoplastic germ cells, sometimes forming seminoma-like infiltrates. Unlike intratubular in situ neoplasia, microinvasion represents definitive malignancy and the starting point for seminoma or nonseminomatous tumor. The authors recommend inguinal orchiectomy as primary therapy and note that the need for complementary treatment remains to be investigated.

pmid-1320854.summary_ja: 発生期のヒト胎盤におけるがん遺伝子の発現を放射性プローブで解析した。胞状奇胎および絨毛癌由来細胞では、検討した全てのがん遺伝子が有意に過剰発現していた。がん遺伝子の活性化が栄養膜細胞の腫瘍性変化と強く関連する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1320854.summary_en: This study measured expression of cellular oncogenes in developing human placenta using radioactive probes. c-mos and N-ras were highly expressed and amplified in term placenta, while c-myc and c-src peaked in the first trimester and then declined. Notably, hydatidiform mole tissue and choriocarcinoma-derived cells, including BeWo, showed significant overexpression of all examined oncogenes. The authors conclude that oncogene activation may be strongly associated with neoplastic change of trophoblast.

pmid-1320911.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体GCTM-2は、胎児性癌細胞株GCT 27において200 kDaのケラタン硫酸プロテオグリカンを認識する。免疫組織化学では、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21/22例とセミノーマの22/28例で染色された。正常胎児の腸上皮と筋肉も強く染色され、胎児性横紋筋肉腫や大腸癌などの一部の非胚細胞腫瘍も反応した。他の細胞株ではエピトープの可視化に透過処理が必要で、タンパク質は修飾が少なく小型であった。著者らは、このプロテオグリカンの発現は主に胎児性癌細胞の特徴であると結論づけている。
pmid-1320911.summary_en: The monoclonal antibody GCTM-2 recognizes a 200 kD pericellular keratan sulphate proteoglycan in the embryonal carcinoma cell line GCT 27. Immunohistochemistry stained 21 of 22 non-seminomatous germ cell tumours and 22 of 28 seminomas. Normal fetal gut epithelium and muscle stained strongly, and some non-germ cell tumours such as embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma and colorectal carcinoma also reacted. In other cell lines the epitope required permeabilization and appeared as smaller, less modified protein. The authors conclude that this proteoglycan expression is predominantly a characteristic of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-1322822.summary_ja: 1975〜1988年のストックホルム県における胞状奇胎、持続性栄養膜疾患、絨毛癌の発生率を解析した。胞状奇胎の約6%が侵入奇胎または絨毛癌のため化学療法を受けた。非胞状奇胎性絨毛癌は約33,717分娩に1例であった。
pmid-1322822.summary_en: This epidemiological study estimated the incidence of hydatidiform mole, persistent trophoblastic disease, and choriocarcinoma in Stockholm County from 1975 to 1988. Data came from the regional cancer registry and hospital registers, and rates were calculated per delivery and per total pregnancy. About 6% of molar pregnancies needed chemotherapy for invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. Non-molar choriocarcinoma occurred in about 1 in 33,717 deliveries. The authors also discuss the difficulties of measuring gestational trophoblastic disease incidence.

pmid-1323213.summary_ja: 難治性の悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対するイホスファミドの効果を検討した。単剤では難治性絨毛癌の2例中1例で反応が得られた。VIP療法では転移性疾患の3例でhCG価の反応があり、1例が治癒した。
pmid-1323213.summary_en: This study evaluated ifosfamide alone and in combination for refractory malignant gestational trophoblastic disease. It combined a phase II multi-institutional trial in refractory gynecologic malignancies with a review of institutional combination chemotherapy experience. Single-agent ifosfamide produced a response in one of two patients with refractory choriocarcinoma. Ifosfamide combined with etoposide and cisplatin (VIP) produced hCG responses in three patients with highly refractory metastatic disease, including one cure. The authors conclude that ifosfamide is active and may be curative with VIP.

pmid-1323524.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の内部に発生した、神経分泌顆粒を有する稀な小細胞癌の症例報告である。腫瘍は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の中に認められ、免疫染色は陰性であったが電子顕微鏡で膜結合性の神経分泌顆粒が確認された。温存手術の後、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシン、シクロホスファミドによる補助化学療法を行い、7年間の生存が得られた。関連文献をレビューし、この稀な悪性腫瘍の治療選択について考察している。
pmid-1323524.summary_en: This case report describes a rare small cell carcinoma with neurosecretory granules arising within an ovarian dermoid cyst, characterized by uniformly small cells within a mature cystic teratoma. Immunohistochemistry was non-reactive, but electron microscopy revealed membrane-bound neurosecretory granules. The patient underwent conservative surgery and adjuvant cisplatin, doxorubicin, and cyclophosphamide, and survived seven years. The authors review the literature and discuss treatment options for this unusual malignancy.

pmid-1323558.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総括したレビュー論文である。外科的病期分類と有効な化学療法レジメンの導入により予後は大きく改善し、完全切除例の大半が生存できる。ディスジャーミノーマ以外の組織型には補助化学療法が推奨され、病期IAのディスジャーミノーマは無治療で観察することが可能である。進行例には化学療法を行い、一部の高齢者などでは放射線療法も選択肢となる。非ディスジャーミノーマ群の治療成績には改善の余地が残ると結論づけている。
pmid-1323558.summary_en: This review summarizes the management of ovarian germ cell tumors. Modern surgical staging and effective chemotherapy regimens have greatly improved outcomes, and most patients with completely resected tumors survive. Non-dysgerminoma patients should receive adjuvant chemotherapy, while stage IA dysgerminoma can be observed without treatment. Higher-stage dysgerminoma and advanced disease warrant chemotherapy, with radiotherapy an option for selected older or ill patients. The authors note that outcomes in non-dysgerminoma tumors still have room for improvement.

pmid-1323989.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における放射線療法の位置づけを検討した文献レビューである。大きな腹部転移（10cm超）を伴う病期IIのセミノーマについて、化学療法が受けられない場合の一次治療、および化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対する補助療法としての放射線療法を推奨している。さらに、中枢神経系外の性腺外セミノーマにも同様の考え方が適用できるとしている。セミノーマの治療方針を選択する上での実践的な指針を示した論文である。
pmid-1323989.summary_en: This review examines the controversial role of radiotherapy in advanced seminomatous germ cell tumors. The authors recommend radiotherapy for stage II seminoma with bulky abdominal metastases over 10 cm in two settings: as primary therapy when chemotherapy cannot or will not be given, and as adjuvant therapy after chemotherapy for any residual mass. Similar recommendations are extended to extragonadal seminoma outside the central nervous system. The paper offers practical guidance for choosing radiotherapy in seminoma management.

pmid-1324379.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍54例を対象に、フローサイトメトリーでDNA含量を解析した研究である。96%が異数体であり、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のDNA指数の中央値はセミノーマより有意に低かった。進行病期のNSGCTではDI低下とDNA不均一性がみられ、予後との関連が示唆された。日本泌尿器科学会の臨床病期分類との有意な相関は認められなかった。DNA含量の解析が非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予後評価に寄与しうると考察している。
pmid-1324379.summary_en: This study applied flow cytometric DNA analysis to 54 adult testicular germ cell tumor patients, including 31 with seminoma and 23 with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Ninety-six percent were DNA aneuploid. The median DNA index was significantly lower in NSGCT than in pure seminoma, and advanced NSGCT showed lower DI and DNA heterogeneity, suggesting prognostic relevance. No significant correlation with the Japanese Urological Association clinical staging was found. The authors conclude that DNA content may aid prognostic assessment in NSGCT.

pmid-1326038.summary_ja: 1945〜1988年に治療された小児悪性卵巣腫瘍38例の43年間の検討。生存率は54%で、組織型の再分類や腫瘍マーカー・化学療法の進歩を報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌の混同、性腺芽腫の前がん性などを指摘し、妊孕性温存のための保存的手術を推奨している。
pmid-1326038.summary_en: This 43-year single-institution review (1945–1988) of 38 girls with malignant ovarian tumors, aged 3–16, found 54% survival with a median follow-up of 8 years. Tumors were histologically classified as germ cell, sex cord/stromal, or epithelial. The authors highlight that pure endodermal sinus tumor was previously confused with embryonal carcinoma, that gonadoblastoma is premalignant in 45,X/46,Y karyotypes, and that sex cord/stromal tumors cannot be predicted to metastasize from histology. They advocate conservative surgery to preserve fertility and note chemotherapy as the future.

pmid-1326221.summary_ja: 5年間に4回の胞状奇胎を繰り返した後に転移性絨毛癌を発症した38歳女性の症例報告。肺転移を有しながら妊娠し、正常満期出産に至った。肺病変の外科的切除と化学療法により20か月の無病生存を確認している。活動性絨毛癌と満期妊娠の併存が稀な点を示す。
pmid-1326221.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma that followed four recurrent consecutive hydatidiform moles over five years. She conceived while having pulmonary metastases, carried a coexistent normal pregnancy, and delivered a healthy infant at term. Surgical resection of the lung lesion combined with chemotherapy achieved sustained remission, with no evidence of disease at 20 months' follow-up. The report highlights the rare coexistence of active gestational choriocarcinoma and a term pregnancy.

pmid-1326777.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の放射線学的および病理学的所見を概説したレビューである。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の最も多い部位は前縦隔である。最も一般的な組織型は成熟奇形腫で、通常は無症状で、画像上は嚢胞成分、脂肪、石灰化を示す。悪性腫瘍は若年男性で症状を伴い大きな腫瘤として出現することが多く、CTでセミノーマは均一、非セミノーマ性腫瘍は不均一に描出される。治療は手術、放射線療法、化学療法から細胞型に応じて選択され、予後は成熟奇形腫と純粋セミノーマでは良好、非セミノーマ性および混合型腫瘍では不良である。
pmid-1326777.summary_en: A radiologic–pathologic review of mediastinal germ cell tumors, the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor site being the anterior mediastinum. Mature teratoma is the most common histologic type, usually asymptomatic and incidental, with cystic components, fat or calcification on imaging. Malignant tumors typically present as large masses in symptomatic young men; seminomas are homogeneous while nonseminomatous tumors are heterogeneous on CT. Treatment includes surgery, radiotherapy or chemotherapy depending on cell type, with excellent prognosis for mature teratoma and pure seminoma, and poor prognosis for nonseminomatous and mixed tumors.

pmid-1326848.summary_ja: 初回は子宮頸部妊娠と誤診された原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告。メトトレキサートによる保存的治療が無効で、子宮摘出術とアクチノマイシンDによる化学療法を施行した。20か月のフォローアップでβ-hCGは正常化し、良好な経過を示した。報告例は約60例と極めて稀である。
pmid-1326848.summary_en: A case report of primary cervical choriocarcinoma, initially misdiagnosed as cervical pregnancy. Conservative treatment with methotrexate failed, so the patient underwent hysterectomy followed by actinomycin-D chemotherapy. At 20 months of follow-up she was in good condition with normal serum beta-hCG levels. Primary cervical choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, with only about 60 cases reported.

pmid-1327005.summary_ja: 17歳男性の未熟精巣奇形腫で、主体となっていた黒色神経外胚葉腫瘍の症例報告。縦隔に成熟奇形腫も併存していた。免疫組織化学で神経上皮性と間葉系の形質を示した。精巣由来の黒色神経外胚葉腫瘍は初報告とされ、胚細胞由来の神経外胚葉分化と考えられる。
pmid-1327005.summary_en: A case report of a 17-year-old man with melanotic neuroectodermal tumour as the predominant component of an immature testicular teratoma, who also had a mature mediastinal teratoma. Immunohistochemistry showed neuroepithelial and mesenchymal features, with positivity for NSE, S-100, HMB45, cytokeratin and vimentin, and myogenic foci. The authors believe this is the first reported testicular origin of MNT, most likely reflecting neuroectodermal differentiation of germ cell origin within an immature teratoma.

pmid-1327076.summary_ja: 推定性腺外胚細胞腫瘍49例を、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる治療成績で検討した研究。完全寛解率は80%、中央値41か月で76%が無病生存。後腹膜腫瘍例の42%に精巣の上皮内癌が認められ、真の性腺外腫瘍ではない可能性や共通の悪性前駆細胞の存在が示唆された。
pmid-1327076.summary_en: A study of 49 patients with presumed extragonadal germ cell tumors (39 retroperitoneal, 8 mediastinal, 2 CNS) treated with high-dose or conventional cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin based on prognostic factors. Complete remission was 80%, and 76% were alive without disease at a median of 41 months. Bilateral testicular biopsies found carcinoma in situ in 42% of retroperitoneal tumor patients, suggesting these tumors may not be truly extragonadal or share a malignant progenitor.

pmid-1328977.summary_ja: 転移性高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌の女性12例に対し、エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンの多剤併用療法を行った研究である。10例が完全寛解、2例が部分寛解となった。1例で再発したが、シスプラチン併用化学療法で救援された。中央値26か月の追跡で全生存率は100%であった。重篤な毒性はなく、本レジメンは忍容性が高く有効と結論された。
pmid-1328977.summary_en: This study evaluated a multiagent regimen of etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine in 12 women with metastatic high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma. Ten achieved complete response and two partial response. One patient relapsed and was salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Overall survival was 100% with median follow-up of 26 months. Toxicities were manageable, with neutropenia causing treatment delays in a minority of cycles and no life-threatening events. The authors concluded that this regimen is well tolerated and highly effective for high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-1329050.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋標本31例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量解析を行い、部分奇胎と完全奇胎の鑑別を検討した研究である。組織学的に部分奇胎と診断された24例のうち8例が三倍体であった。核型解析が得られた9例中8例で結果が一致した。完全奇胎や持続性絨毛性疾患は二倍体であった。保存組織における部分奇胎の診断に有用な迅速法と結論された。
pmid-1329050.summary_en: This study applied flow cytometric DNA content analysis to paraffin-embedded specimens from 31 trophoblastic disease cases to distinguish partial from complete hydatidiform moles. Eight of 24 histologically diagnosed partial moles were triploid, matching karyotype in 8 of 9 cases with available cytogenetics. Complete moles, hydropic abortion, and persistent disease were diploid. One choriocarcinoma showed abnormal DNA content with a DNA index of 1.3. The authors conclude that flow cytometry is a reliable, fast method for diagnosing partial moles in archival tissue. The sample size is limited.

pmid-1329224.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチンの代替としてのカルボプラチンの有用性を、ロイヤルマーズデン病院の先行研究から検討したものである。転移性非セミノーマ76例にカルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンを併用し、完全寛解率は95%であった。転移性セミノーマ33例では単剤カルボプラチンを用い、無増悪生存率は79%であった。カルボプラチンはシスプラチンと同等の効果を示し、毒性は少ないと結論された。
pmid-1329224.summary_en: This review summarizes Royal Marsden pilot studies of carboplatin in testicular germ cell tumors. In 76 patients with metastatic nonseminoma treated with carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin from 1984 to 1988, complete remission was 95% and cause-specific survival 98.5% at median 24-month follow-up. In 33 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with single-agent carboplatin, actuarial progression-free survival was 79% over median 36 months. The authors conclude carboplatin has activity comparable to cisplatin and is less toxic, offering an alternative in testicular GCT.

pmid-1329449.summary_ja: 1985年から1991年に、進行胚細胞腫瘍12例を対象に、4種類のリスク基準の予後予測能を比較した臨床研究である。3サイクル以内に完全寛解した群と、それ以外の群に分けて検討した。インディアナ病期分類が最も有用と考えられた。症例数が少なく単施設研究である点が限界とされる。
pmid-1329449.summary_en: This Japanese urology study compared four risk criteria for germ cell tumors in 12 patients treated with VAB-6 or PVeBV induction followed by VIP salvage chemotherapy between 1985 and 1991. Patients were grouped by whether they achieved complete remission within three cycles (good response) or not (poor response), and the groups were compared with each risk classification. The Indiana Staging System appeared most useful in this small series. The findings are limited by the small sample size and single-institution design.

pmid-1329610.summary_ja: ターナー症候群(45,XO)を有する23歳女性が卵巣腫瘍で受診し、組織学的に胎児性癌と診断された症例報告である。発生異常を伴う性腺から胎児性癌が生じることは稀で、純粋な45,XO核型ではさらに稀とされる。化学療法と外科的治療の役割が強調された。異形成性性腺の悪性転化リスクを文献的に概説し、予防的な性腺摘出の是非についても論じている。
pmid-1329610.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with Turner syndrome who presented with an ovarian neoplasm, histologically confirmed as embryonal carcinoma. Karyotype showed pure 45,XO. Embryonal carcinoma arising in a dysgenetic gonad is uncommon, and even rarer with a pure 45,XO karyotype. The report highlights the roles of chemotherapy and surgery in management. The authors also review the clinical features, genetic variants, and malignant transformation risk in dysgenetic gonads, and discuss prophylactic removal of these gonads.

pmid-1329910.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎および絨毛癌の患者40例を対象に、化学療法開始前に子宮動脈のドップラー超音波検査を行い、薬剤耐性との関連を前向きに検討した研究である。拍動指数1.1以下の患者で薬剤耐性が有意に多かった。拍動指数は転移や子宮出血とは関連しなかった。治療前の子宮動脈評価は薬剤耐性の予測に有用と結論された。
pmid-1329910.summary_en: This prospective study assessed uterine artery Doppler ultrasound in 40 consecutive patients with invasive mole or choriocarcinoma before chemotherapy. Patients with a pulsatility index of 1.1 or less were significantly more likely to develop drug resistance (P < 0.04). Pulsatility index was not associated with metastatic disease or uterine bleeding. Of eight patients who developed resistance, five could potentially have avoided inadequate initial treatment if Doppler findings were included in the scoring system for selecting chemotherapy. The authors conclude pre-treatment uterine artery Doppler assessment helps predict drug resistance.

pmid-1330244.summary_ja: 直径3〜7cmの片側性卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の生殖年齢女性18例に対する腹腔鏡手術の成績を報告したものである。9例は嚢胞摘出術、9例は片側卵巣摘出術または卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。大きな手術合併症はなく、入院期間も短かった。腹腔鏡手術は卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に対する安全で有効な方法と結論された。症例数が少なく、長期成績は示されていない。
pmid-1330244.summary_en: This clinical series reports laparoscopic management of unilateral benign ovarian cystic teratoma measuring 3 to 7 cm in 18 women of reproductive age. Nine underwent pelviscopic cyst enucleation and nine underwent unilateral oophorectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy. No major surgical complications occurred, and hospital stays were short. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a safe and effective approach for benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The series is small, and the abstract reports no long-term follow-up.

pmid-1330448.summary_ja: 1983年から1990年に治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍87例を対象としたフランスの後方視的研究である。セミノーマ23例では22例(96%)が治療後無病となり、2年生存率は86%だった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍64例では52%が無病となり、2年生存率は53%であった。他部位原発の非セミノーマより予後は不良だが、治療の有効性は確認された。
pmid-1330448.summary_en: This French retrospective study analyzed 87 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors treated between 1983 and 1990. Among 23 with pure seminoma, 96% were disease-free after treatment, with a two-year survival of 86%. Among 64 with nonseminomatous tumors, 52% became disease-free and two-year survival was 53%, rising to 87% in those achieving complete response. Seven patients relapsed after complete response. The authors conclude that prognosis is worse than for nonseminomatous tumors from other primary sites, but that therapy is effective.

pmid-1331547.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた113例を解析し、残存腫瘍の分布を検討した。残存腫瘍の大部分は大動脈周囲に存在した。残存病変を有する60例中14例で腫瘍が縮小郭清範囲外にあったが、残存腫瘤切除と縮小郭清の併用で後腹膜に腫瘍が残るのは8%のみであった。選択された患者では縮小郭清が適切と結論している。
pmid-1331547.summary_en: This study of 113 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who had bulky retroperitoneal disease and underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy mapped where residual tumor lay. Most residual tumor was in the para-aortic area on the left and interaortocaval area on the right. Only 14 of 60 patients with residual disease had tumor outside the modified template, and removing the residual mass plus modified dissection would have left tumor in just 8% of patients. The authors conclude modified RPLND is appropriate for selected patients.

pmid-1332066.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍45例で8つの多型マーカーを用い、生殖系列と腫瘍のゲノム型を比較して12番染色体長腕の欠失を解析した。12q13と12q22に高頻度の欠失が認められ、候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在部位と考えられた。KITとMGFの発現はセミノーマと非セミノーマで異なり、胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆された。
pmid-1332066.summary_en: This study mapped chromosome 12 deletions in 45 male germ cell tumor patients by comparing germline and tumor genotypes at eight polymorphic loci. Frequent losses occurred at 12q13 and 12q22, which the authors propose as sites of candidate tumor suppressor genes. One tumor showed a homozygous deletion including the MGF gene at 12q22. KIT and MGF expression differed between seminomatous and nonseminomatous tumors in 24 biopsies and three cell lines, implicating these genes in germ cell tumorigenesis and differentiation.

pmid-1332835.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は、境界悪性の胞状奇胎から高度に侵襲性の絨毛癌までの疾患スペクトラムである。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定、臨床経過、病変の進展様式を統合して管理し、予後因子を適切に適用することが重要とされる。統合的管理により、毒性を最小限に抑えつつ完全寛解の可能性を最大化できると述べている。
pmid-1332835.summary_en: This review covers gestational trophoblastic tumours, a spectrum ranging from hydatidiform mole, a borderline malignancy, to highly aggressive choriocarcinoma. The authors argue that management should integrate serial hCG measurements, clinical history, and the pattern of disease spread to apply prognostic variables appropriately. Such an integrated approach maximizes the chance of complete remission with minimal toxicity, and they suggest death from trophoblastic tumour should be uncommon. The title refers to the immune system, but the abstract focuses on clinical management.

pmid-1333336.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍115例を、精巣摘除術後の監視療法で管理した成績である。約30%が再発し、大半は1年以内であった。再発例の大部分は白金製剤を含む化学療法で救済され、2例が死亡した。血管・リンパ管侵襲が再発と関連したが、組織型や術前の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は関連しなかった。腫瘍マーカーのみで発見された再発が多く、十分なフォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-1333336.summary_en: This report describes 115 patients with clinical Stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumours managed by orchiectomy and surveillance, with median follow-up of 36 months. About 30% relapsed, most within a year, and most were salvaged with platinum-based chemotherapy. Two patients died, both with intermediate malignant teratoma and vascular or lymphatic invasion. Vascular or lymphatic invasion predicted relapse, while histology, T stage, and preorchiectomy AFP did not. Tumour marker alone detected many relapses, underscoring the need for thorough follow-up.

pmid-1333851.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍39例と胚・胎児8例で中間径フィラメントタンパク質などのマーカーを免疫組織化学的に検討し、腫瘍発生と胚発生の類似点と相違点を比較した。未分化胚細胞に相当するセミノーマと胎児性癌は中間径フィラメントの発現に乏しかった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の不均一な成分を明らかにし、混合型胚細胞腫瘍には2つの型が存在し発生機序が異なると考察している。
pmid-1333851.summary_en: This study examines intermediate filament proteins and special markers in 39 testicular germ cell tumors and eight embryos or fetuses, comparing tumor development with embryogenesis. Seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, the tumoral counterparts of undifferentiated germ cells, showed little intermediate filament expression. Tumorigenesis appeared to skip normal maturation steps. Immunostaining revealed heterogeneous elements in nonseminomatous tumors, and the authors propose combined and diffuse patterns in mixed germ cell tumors, suggesting different tumorigenic mechanisms.

pmid-1334606.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する術中凍結切片診断の正確性を後方視的に検討した研究。1962〜1991年に行われた30例を検証し、悪性24例・良性2例のすべてを正しく診断した。誤診は精巣温存手術の判断に影響しうるため、診断の信頼性は重要である。凍結切片診断は精巣がんの診断に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-1334606.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated the accuracy of frozen section examination for testicular masses. Thirty frozen sections performed between 1962 and 1991 were reviewed, and 26 cases had the entire testicle available for histologic evaluation. Frozen sections correctly identified all 24 malignant and 2 benign masses. The authors conclude that frozen section can accurately diagnose testicular cancer. Because misdiagnosis could lead to inappropriate testis-sparing surgery, the findings are relevant to surgical decision-making in testicular tumors.

pmid-1334607.summary_ja: 閉経後の54歳女性に発生した後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。右側の腎疝痛で受診し、3か月後に後腹膜腫瘍が確認された。開腹生検で胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、体外照射による放射線療法を受けたが、9か月後に転移により死亡した。閉経後女性では稀な発生例であり、鑑別診断として念頭に置くべきことを示している。
pmid-1334607.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman who presented with right renal colic. A retroperitoneal tumor was found three months later, and laparotomy with biopsy revealed a germ cell tumor. She received external beam radiotherapy but died of metastatic spread nine months later. The authors consider this an uncommon occurrence of germ cell tumor in a postmenopausal woman. The report highlights that retroperitoneal germ cell tumors, though rare in this age group, should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-1335156.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で精巣摘除術と腹部放射線療法を受けた患者の性機能を、アンケートで調べた研究。放射線療法群は対照群より勃起・射精・性欲で有意に低下し、約24%が身体的な障害を感じていた。早期セミノーマに対する放射線療法の意義を疑問視している。
pmid-1335156.summary_en: This questionnaire study assessed sexual function in patients with testicular germ cell tumors after orchidectomy with or without abdominal radiotherapy. Responses from 137 irradiated patients, 18 surveillance patients and 121 controls were compared.
